Private Sub RefreshMe()
Dim f As Form

  Me!level = Right(Screen.ActiveControl.Name, 1)
  Set f = Me!frmaccacc_official_chart_of_accounts_sub.Form
  If Screen.ActiveControl.Name = "cmdChartOfAccountsLevel1" Then
    Me!cmdChartOfAccountsLevel1.BackStyle = 1
  Else
    Me!cmdChartOfAccountsLevel1.BackStyle = 0
  End If
  
  If Screen.ActiveControl.Name = "cmdChartOfAccountsLevel2" Then
    Me!cmdChartOfAccountsLevel2.BackStyle = 1
   Else
    Me!cmdChartOfAccountsLevel2.BackStyle = 0
  End If
  
  If Screen.ActiveControl.Name = "cmdChartOfAccountsLevel3" Then
    Me!cmdChartOfAccountsLevel3.BackStyle = 1
  Else
    Me!cmdChartOfAccountsLevel3.BackStyle = 0
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
On Error Resume Next
Dim GLAccID As String, frmName As String, frm As Form
  
  frmName = "frmAccGL_Postings"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm.frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form!GLAccountID.Requery
    frm.frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form!bstGLAccountID.Requery
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmAccGL_Posting"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm.frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form!GLAccountID.Requery
    frm.frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form!bGLAccountID.Requery
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub lstDocuments_AfterUpdate()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim varItm As Variant, frm As Form, frmsum As Form
Dim strSQL As String, rowIndex As Integer, Yr As Long

  Set frm = Me
  Set frmsum = frm!frmAccARAP_Sums.Form
  
  frm!documentSum = 0
  frm!documentPaymentsSum = 0
  frm!documentDiffSum = 0

  For Each varItm In frm!lstDocuments.ItemsSelected
    frm!documentSum = Round(frm!documentSum + n(frm!lstDocuments.Column(5, varItm)), 2)
    frm!documentPaymentsSum = Round(frm!documentPaymentsSum + n(frm!lstDocuments.Column(6, varItm)), 2)
    frm!documentDiffSum = Round(frm!documentDiffSum + n(frm!lstDocuments.Column(7, varItm)), 2)
  Next varItm

  frm!linkID = frm!lstDocuments.Column(0)
  
  If frm!docType = 1 Then
    If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, "frmAccGL_Posting") Then
      Call OpenPosting(frm!lstDocuments.Column(8), frm!lstDocuments.Column(9))
    End If
  
    Me!balanceMonth = frm!lstDocuments.Column(4)
    
    If (Me!balanceYear > Yr) Or (Me!balanceYear = 0) Then
      Me!balanceYear = DLookup("fiscalYear", "tblAccGL_Postings", "postingID=" & frm!lstDocuments.Column(8))
    Else
      Me!balanceYear = currentFiscalYear()
    End If
    
    If IsNull(Me!balanceYear) Then Me!balanceYear = currentFiscalYear()
    
    If YearIsOpened(Me!balanceYear) = 0 Then
      Me!balanceYear = currentFiscalYear()
    End If
  
  End If
  
  If postingType.Column(2) = 222 Then
    If frm!lstPayments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
      Me!balanceDueDate = CDate(frm!lstDocuments.Column(2))
    Else
      Me!balanceDueDate = CDate(frm!lstPayments.Column(2))
    End If
  Else
    If frm!lstDocuments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
      Me!balanceDueDate = CDate(frm!lstPayments.Column(2))
    Else
      Me!balanceDueDate = CDate(frm!lstDocuments.Column(2))
    End If
  End If
  
  Call ARAP_CreateQryPayments(frm, frmsum)
 
  frm!lstPayments.RowSource = "qryAccARAP_Payments"
  frm!lstPayments.Requery
  frm!lstPayments = ""
  frm!paymentSum = 0
    
End Sub

Private Sub lstDocuments_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If Me!docType = 1 Then
    Call OpenPosting(Me!lstDocuments.Column(8), Me!lstDocuments.Column(9))
  Else
    If Left(Me!frmAccARAP_Sums!glAccountNumber, 1) = "1" Then
      DoCmd.OpenForm "frmTourSales_ggInvoicePaymentTerms", acFormDS, , "ggInvoiceID=" & Me!lstDocuments.Column(0)
      Forms!frmTourSales_ggInvoicePaymentTerms.Form.Move 5000, 3000, 10000, 5000
    Else
      DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPurchaseInvoice", acNormal, , "purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!lstDocuments.Column(0), acFormEdit
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub CmdGroupPayments_Click()
Dim frm As Form, varItm As Variant, i As Integer

  Set frm = Me
  
  If frm!lstPayments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Nobeno pla ilo ni izbrano. Program bo prekinjen.", vbInformation
    End
  End If

 If frm!lstPayments.Column(7) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izbrano pla ilo mora imeti docID=0"
    Exit Sub
  End If

  Call CreateQry(167, frm!lstPayments.Column(8), frm!lstPayments.Column(3))
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry(168, frm!lstPayments.Column(8), frm!lstPayments.Column(3))
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry(169, frm!lstPayments.Column(8), frm!lstPayments.Column(3))
  Call RunMySQL
  
  frm!lstPayments.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdReleasePayment_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, m1 As Integer, strWhere As String, frm As Form
Dim rowIndex As Integer

  Set frm = Me
  
  If frm!lstPayments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Nobeno pla ilo ni izbrano. Program bo prekinjen.", vbInformation
    End
  End If
  
  For Each varItm In frm!lstPayments.ItemsSelected

    Call RunMySQL("UPDATE tblAccGL_PostingSubs SET tblAccGL_PostingSubs.documentID=0 WHERE postingSubID=" & frm!lstPayments.Column(0, varItm) & ";")

  Next varItm
  
  rowIndex = frm!lstDocuments.ListIndex
  frm!lstDocuments.Requery
  frm!lstDocuments.Selected(rowIndex + 1) = True
  frm!lstPayments.Requery
  
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub lstPayments_AfterUpdate()
Dim varItm As Variant, frm1Name As String, frm1 As Form, Yr As Long
Dim frm As Form

  Set frm = Me
  frm!paymentSum = 0
  
  For Each varItm In frm!lstPayments.ItemsSelected
    frm!paymentSum = Round(frm!paymentSum + n(frm!lstPayments.Column(6, varItm)), 2)
  Next varItm

  frm1Name = "frmAccGL_Posting"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frm1Name) Then
    Call OpenPosting(frm!lstPayments.Column(8), frm!lstPayments.Column(0))
  End If
  
  If frm!lstDocuments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Me!balanceMonth = frm!lstPayments.Column(5)
    Yr = DLookup("fiscalYear", "tblAccGL_Postings", "postingID=" & frm!lstPayments.Column(8))
    If Me!balanceYear < Yr Then
      Me!balanceYear = Yr
      If YearIsOpened(Me!balanceYear) = 0 Then
        Me!balanceYear = currentFiscalYear()
      End If
    End If
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub ReleasePaymentFromCanceledInvoices()
Dim strSQL As String, cmpyID As Long

  cmpyID = currentCompanyID()
  If cmpyID = 11 Then
    Call CreateQry1(281, cmpyID)
    Call RunMySQL
    
    strSQL = "UPDATE ((tblAccGL_PostingSubs LEFT JOIN tblTourSales_ggInvoices ON tblAccGL_PostingSubs.documentID = tblTourSales_ggInvoices.ggInvoiceID) " & _
             "INNER JOIN tblAccGL_Postings ON tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingID = tblAccGL_Postings.postingID) " & _
             "INNER JOIN tblAccAcc_GLAccounts ON tblAccGL_PostingSubs.GLAccountID = tblAccAcc_GLAccounts.GLAccountID " & _
             "SET tblAccGL_PostingSubs.documentID = 0 " & _
             "WHERE (((tblAccGL_PostingSubs.documentID)>2 And (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.documentID)<300000000) AND ((tblAccGL_Postings.companyID)=" & cmpyID & ") " & _
             "AND ((tblTourSales_ggInvoices.ggInvoiceID) Is Null) AND ((tblAccGL_Postings.parentTableID)=19) AND ((Left(tblAccAcc_GLAccounts.glAccountNumber,2))=12));"
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
    Beep
  
    Call CreateQry1(280, cmpyID)
    Call RunMySQL
    
  End If
End Sub

Public Sub PreparePostingData()
Dim frm As Form, txt1 As String, txt2 As String
  
  Set frm = Forms("frmAccARAP")
  
  If IsNull(frm!frmAccARAP_Sums!partnerID) Then Exit Sub
  
  If frm!lstPayments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 And frm!lstDocuments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi vsaj en dokument oz. pla ilo!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(frm!balancePartnerID) Then frm!balancePartnerID = frm!frmAccARAP_Sums!partnerID
  
  If Me!postingType = 7 Then
  
    If frm!Difference < 0 Then
        frm!balanceGLAccountID = FindGLAccountID("789000")
    Else
        frm!balanceGLAccountID = FindGLAccountID("759000")
    End If
    frm!balanceDescriptionDebit = "Uskladitev salda"
    frm!balanceDescriptionCredit = "Uskladitev salda"
  Else
    If Me!postingType <> 3 Then
       If frm!lstDocuments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
            txt1 = frm!frmAccARAP_Sums!partnerName
            txt2 = frm!balancePartnerID.Column(1)
            frm!balanceDescriptionDebit = "Prenos sr. iz " & txt1 & "->" & txt2 & " " & frm!lstDocuments.Column(3)
            frm!balanceDescriptionCredit = "Prenos sr. iz " & txt1 & "->" & txt2 & " " & frm!lstDocuments.Column(3)
          Exit Sub
        End If
        If IsNull(frm!balanceGLAccountID) Then frm!balanceGLAccountID = frm!frmAccARAP_Sums!GLAccountID
        If frm!balancePartnerID = frm!frmAccARAP_Sums!partnerID Then
            frm!balanceDescriptionDebit = "Prenos sredstev iz " & frm!lstDocuments.Column(3)
            frm!balanceDescriptionCredit = "Prenos sredstev iz " & frm!lstDocuments.Column(3)
        Else
            txt1 = frm!frmAccARAP_Sums!partnerName
            txt2 = frm!balancePartnerID.Column(1)
            frm!balanceDescriptionDebit = "Prenos " & frm!lstDocuments.Column(3) & " " & txt1 & "->" & txt2
            frm!balanceDescriptionCredit = "Prenos " & frm!lstDocuments.Column(3) & " " & txt1 & "->" & txt2
        End If
    Else
        If frm!lstDocuments.ItemsSelected.Count <> 0 Then
          Beep
          MsgBox "Za kreiranje lastnega dokumenta je dovoljeno izbrati samo pla ilo!"
          Exit Sub
        End If
        If frm!lstPayments.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
          Beep
          MsgBox "Izberi vsaj eno pla ilo!"
          Exit Sub
        End If
        If IsNull(frm!balanceGLAccountID) Then frm!balanceGLAccountID = frm!frmAccARAP_Sums!GLAccountID
        End If
  End If
End Sub
Private Sub CmdRefreshBalancePostingData_Click()
  
  Call PreparePostingData
  
End Sub

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdBalanceIsZero_Click()
Dim strFilter As String
'On Error Resume Next
    
  DoCmd.Echo False
  strFilter = "(preDocAm=0 AND preDocPayments=0 AND rpDocAm=0 AND rpPayments=0 AND notAssignedPayments=0) OR "
  strFilter = strFilter & "((rpDocAm <> 0 AND rpPayments <> 0) AND Abs(rpBalance)<=" & Me!fltrTotalBalance & ")"
  Me.Filter = strFilter
  If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  
  DoCmd.Echo True
End Sub

Private Sub CmdFltrBalance_Click()
Dim n1 As Double, n2 As Double, strFilter As String
'On Error Resume Next
  n1 = Replace(Me!Am1, ",", ".")
  n2 = Replace(Me!Am2, ",", ".")
  DoCmd.Echo False
  strFilter = "((rpBalance >= " & n1 & ") AND (rpBalance <= " & n2 & ")) OR "
  strFilter = strFilter & "((notAssignedPayments >= " & n1 & ") AND (notAssignedPayments <= " & n2 & "))"
  Me.Filter = strFilter
  If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  DoCmd.Echo True

End Sub

Private Sub fltrCountryID_AfterUpdate()
On Error Resume Next
    
  DoCmd.Echo False
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!fltrCountryID) Then
    Me.Filter = "countryID=" & Me!fltrCountryID
  Else
    Me.Filter = ""
  End If
  
  If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  DoCmd.Echo True
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
  Call ARAP_SelectRecordFrmSums(Forms!frmAccARAP.Form, Me)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
Dim accID As Long, ptrID As Long
  
  If hasValue(Me!GLAccountID) And hasValue(Me!partnerID) Then
    accID = Me!GLAccountID
    ptrID = Me!partnerID
  Else
    accID = 0
    ptrID = 0
  End If
  
  Me!strFilterBP = Null
  Me!strFilterGLAccount = Null
  Me.Filter = ""
  Me.FilterOn = False
  
  Me.Requery
  
  With Me.RecordsetClone
    .FindFirst "(GLAccountID=" & accID & ") AND (partnerID=" & ptrID & ")"
    If Not .NoMatch Then
      Me.Bookmark = .Bookmark
    End If
  End With
  
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
  Call RequeryFormSums
End Sub

Private Sub optIsLinked_AfterUpdate()
  Call RequeryFormSums
End Sub

Private Sub optIsNotLinked_AfterUpdate()
  Call RequeryFormSums
End Sub

Private Sub partnerName_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BP", acNormal, , "partnerID=" & Me!partnerID
End Sub

Private Sub strFilterGLAccount_AfterUpdate()
  Call FltrOn
End Sub

Private Sub strFilterBP_AfterUpdate()
  Call FltrOn
End Sub

Public Sub FltrOn()
On Error Resume Next
    
  DoCmd.Echo False
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!strFilterBP) Then
    If Not IsNull(Me!strFilterGLAccount) Then
      Me.Filter = "GLAccountNumber Like '*" & Me!strFilterGLAccount & "*' And partnerName Like '*" & Me!strFilterBP & "*'"
    Else
      Me.Filter = "partnerName Like '*" & Me!strFilterBP & "*'"
    End If
  Else
    If Not IsNull(Me!strFilterGLAccount) Then
      Me.Filter = "GLAccountNumber Like '*" & Me!strFilterGLAccount & "*'"
    Else
      Me.Filter = ""
    End If
  End If
  
  If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  
  DoCmd.Echo True
  
End Sub

Public Sub RequeryFormSums()
On Error Resume Next
Dim frm As Form, frmSUMS As Form, compID As Long, accID As Long, ptrID As Long, accID1 As Long, ptrID1 As Long, strFilter As String
Dim isNotLinked As Integer, isLinked As Integer

  Set frm = Forms!frmAccARAP.Form
  Set frmSUMS = Me
  
  compID = currentCompanyID
  accID = Me!GLAccountID
  ptrID = Me!partnerID

  If IsNull(Me.Filter) Or Me.Filter = "" Then
    strFilter = ""
  Else
    strFilter = Me.Filter
  End If

  DoCmd.Echo False
  DoCmd.GoToRecord
  accID1 = Me!GLAccountID
  ptrID1 = Me!partnerID
    
    If frmSUMS!optIsNotLinked = 0 Then
      If frmSUMS!optIsLinked = 0 Then
        isNotLinked = 5
        isLinked = 5
      Else
        isNotLinked = 1
        isLinked = 1
      End If
    Else
      If frmSUMS!optIsLinked = 0 Then
        isNotLinked = 0
        isLinked = 0
      Else
        isNotLinked = 0
        isLinked = 1
      End If
    End If

  If Forms!frmAccARAP.Form!OptPR = True Then
    Call CreateQry(111, isNotLinked, isLinked, compID, , frmSUMS!Yr1 & Format(frmSUMS!m1, "00"), frmSUMS!Yr2 & Format(frmSUMS!m2, "00"))
    Call CreateQry(162, , , , , compID, frmSUMS!Yr1 & Format(frmSUMS!m1, "00"), frmSUMS!Yr2 & Format(frmSUMS!m2, "00"))
    Call CreateQry(163, , , , , compID, frmSUMS!Yr1 & Format(frmSUMS!m1, "00"), frmSUMS!Yr2 & Format(frmSUMS!m2, "00"))
    Call ARAP_CreateQryDocuments(frm, frmSUMS)
    Call ARAP_CreateQryPreDocuments(frm, frmSUMS)
    Call ARAP_CreateQryPayments(frm, frmSUMS)
    Me.RecordSource = "qryAccARAP_Sums"
  Else
    Call CreateQry(95, isNotLinked, isLinked)
    Me.RecordSource = "qryAccLinkAccptsPIs"
  End If
  
  If Not (strFilter = "") Then
    Me.Filter = strFilter
    If Not Me.FilterOn = True Then Me.FilterOn = True
  End If
  
  With Me.RecordsetClone
    .FindFirst "(GLAccountID=" & accID & ") AND (partnerID=" & ptrID & ")"
    If Not .NoMatch Then
      Me.Bookmark = .Bookmark
    Else
      .FindFirst "(GLAccountID=" & accID1 & ") AND (partnerID=" & ptrID1 & ")"
      Me.Bookmark = .Bookmark
    End If
  End With

  DoCmd.Echo True
  
  Beep
  
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdCreatePR11_Click()
Dim db As DAO.Database, rs As DAO.Recordset, rs1 As DAO.Recordset, varItm As Variant
Dim bpID As String, invDt As Date, SD1 As Date, SD2 As Date, invID As Long, invSum As Double, invVatSum As Double
Dim qDef As QueryDef
Dim paymentDelay, dueDate As Date
  
  If Me!lstAcceptances.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Noben zapis ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
   
  bpID = Me!lstAcceptances.Column(3)
    
  For Each varItm In Me!lstAcceptances.ItemsSelected
    If bpID <> Me!lstAcceptances.Column(3, varItm) Then
      Beep
      MsgBox "Izbrani morajo biti prevzemi enega dobavitelja.", vbExclamation
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next varItm


  If Me!lstAcceptances.Column(7) = "" Then
    
    invDt = CDate(Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2))
    SD1 = invDt
    SD2 = invDt
    paymentDelay = DLookup("paymentDelay", "tblPtr_bpCmpyPaymentTerms", "partnerID=" & bpID)
    If IsNull(paymentDelay) Then paymentDelay = 0
    If CDate(invDt + paymentDelay) < Date Then
      dueDate = Date
    Else
      dueDate = invDt + paymentDelay
    End If
      
    For Each varItm In Me!lstAcceptances.ItemsSelected
      If invDt < CDate(Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2, varItm)) Then
        invDt = CDate(Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2, varItm))
        If CDate(invDt + paymentDelay) < Date Then
          dueDate = Date
        Else
          dueDate = invDt + paymentDelay
        End If
      End If
      
      If SD1 > CDate(Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2, varItm)) Then SD1 = CDate(Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2, varItm))
      If SD2 < CDate(Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2, varItm)) Then SD2 = CDate(Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2, varItm))
    Next varItm
    
    Set db = CurrentDb()
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices", dbOpenDynaset, dbSeeChanges)
    Set rs1 = db.OpenRecordset("tblDocGoods_Acceptances", dbOpenDynaset)
    
    rs.AddNew
    rs("purchaseInvoiceNumber") = NewDocumentNumber("tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices", "purchaseInvoiceNumber", "PR", currentFiscalYear(), currentCompanyID(), True)
    rs("partnerID") = Me!lstAcceptances.Column(3)
    rs("purchaseInvoiceDate") = Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2)
    rs("dueDate") = dueDate
    rs("vatDate") = CDate(Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2)) + 2
    rs("serviceFirstDate") = Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2)
    rs("serviceLastDate") = Me!lstAcceptances.Column(2)
    rs("supplierInvoiceNumber") = InputBox("Dobaviteljeva  tevilka ra una?")
    rs("supplierRefInformation") = InputBox("Referenca za pla ilo?")
    rs("supplierRef") = Me!lstAcceptances.Column(12)
      
    invSum = 0
    If Me!lstAcceptances.Column(13) = "1" Then                  'slovenija
      For Each varItm In Me!lstAcceptances.ItemsSelected
        invSum = invSum + Me!lstAcceptances.Column(6, varItm)
      Next varItm
      rs("purchaseInvoiceAmount") = invSum / 100
    Else
      For Each varItm In Me!lstAcceptances.ItemsSelected
        invSum = invSum + Me!lstAcceptances.Column(5, varItm)
      Next varItm
      rs("purchaseInvoiceAmount") = invSum / 100
      rs("vatIncluded") = 0
    End If

    rs("documentTypeID") = 5
    rs("documentStatusID") = 3
    rs("postingTypeID") = 1
    rs("creditGLAccountID") = Me!lstAcceptances.Column(10)
    rs("meansOfPaymentGroupID") = Me!lstAcceptances.Column(11)
    rs("templateNumber") = 1
    rs("fiscalYear") = currentFiscalYear()
    rs("companyID") = currentCompanyID()
    rs.Update
 
    rs.Bookmark = rs.LastModified
    invID = rs("purchaseInvoiceID")

    For Each varItm In Me!lstAcceptances.ItemsSelected
      rs1.FindFirst "acceptanceID=" & Me!lstAcceptances.Column(0, varItm)
      If Not rs1.NoMatch Then
        rs1.Edit
        rs1("purchaseInvoiceID") = invID
        rs1.Update
      End If
    Next varItm
      
    Set qDef = db.QueryDefs("qappAccDoc_CreatePIFromAcceptance_Vat")
    qDef.Parameters("invID") = invID
    qDef.Execute
    
    Set qDef = db.QueryDefs("qappPurchaseInvoicePostingDetails_S2")
    qDef.Parameters("invID") = invID
    qDef.Execute

    Call CreatePurchaseInvoicePosting(invID, False, 1, 5)
    Call CreatePurchaseInvoicePaymentOrder(invID)
    
    rs.Close
    rs1.Close
    db.Close
  
  End If

  Me!lstAcceptances.Requery
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
  If Not IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
    Me!partnerID = Null
    Me!lstAcceptances.RowSource = "qryDocAcc_CreatePIFromAcceptance"
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
  Me!lstAcceptances.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub lstAcceptances_AfterUpdate()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form

  frmName = "frmPurchaseInvoice"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    If Not Me!lstAcceptances.Column(14) = "" Then
      frm.Filter = "purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!lstAcceptances.Column(14)
      If frm.FilterOn = False Then frm.FilterOn = True
    End If
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmDocGoods_Acceptance"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    If Not Me!lstAcceptances.Column(0) = "" Then
      frm.Filter = "acceptanceID=" & Me!lstAcceptances.Column(0)
      If frm.FilterOn = False Then frm.FilterOn = True
    End If
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub lstAcceptances_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)

If Me!OptOpenInvoice Then
  If Not Me!lstAcceptances.Column(7) = "" Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPurchaseInvoice", , , "purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!lstAcceptances.Column(7), acFormEdit
  Else
    Beep
  End If
Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDocGoods_Acceptance", , , "acceptanceID=" & Me!lstAcceptances.Column(0), acFormEdit
End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub optOpenAcceptance_AfterUpdate()
  If Me!OptOpenAcceptance Then
    Me!OptOpenInvoice = False
  Else
    Me!OptOpenInvoice = True
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub optOpenInvoice_AfterUpdate()
  If Me!OptOpenInvoice Then
    Me!OptOpenAcceptance = False
  Else
    Me!OptOpenAcceptance = True
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!lstAcceptances.RowSource = "qryDocAcc_CreatePIFromAcceptancePartner"
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdAddCmpyYears_Click()

  If IsNull(Me!companyID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi podjetje!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappAccFiscalPeriods_CmpyYears")
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  Me!frmAccFiscalPeriods_CmpyYears.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdAddMonths_Click()

  If DCount("fiscalMonthID", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalYear=" & [Forms]![frmAccFiscalPeriods].[Form]![fiscalYear]) <> 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Mesci so  e dodani!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappAccFiscalPeriods_ShrdMonths")
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  Me!frmAccFiscalPeriods_ShrdMonths.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdUnlock_Click()
Dim pswd As String

  Beep
  pswd = InputBox("Geslo za odklepanje:")
  
  If pswd = "271898" Then
    Me!frmAccFiscalPeriods_ShrdYears.Locked = False
    Me!frmAccFiscalPeriods_ShrdMonths.Locked = False
    Me!frmAccFiscalPeriods_ShrdMonths.Form.AllowDeletions = True
  Else
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napa no geslo!", vbExclamation
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub companyID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!openedAt = Me!companyID.Column(2)
End Sub

Private Sub closedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim i
  If IsNull(Me!closedAt) Then
    Me!closedAt = Now()
  Else
    i = InputBox("GESLO:")
    If i = "271898" Then
      Me!closedAt.Locked = False
    Else
      MsgBox "Geslo ni pravilno.", vbInformation
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
  Forms!frmAccFiscalPeriods.Form!cmpyFiscalYearID = Me!cmpyFiscalYearID
End Sub

Private Sub monthExists_Click()

  If Not IsNull(Me!monthExists) Then
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappAccFiscalPeriods_CmpyMonths"
    DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  End If
  
  Forms!frmAccFiscalPeriods!frmAccFiscalPeriods_CmpyYears.Requery
  Forms!frmAccFiscalPeriods!frmAccFiscalPeriods_CmpyMonths.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub statementHeadingAccountID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset

  If IsNull(Me!statementHeadingAccountID) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblAccFS_StatementHeadingAccounts", dbOpenDynaset)

  rs.FindFirst "statementHeadingAccountID = " & Me!statementHeadingAccountID
  rs.delete
  rs.Close
  Set rs = Nothing
  
  Call ChkBS_AfterUpdate
End Sub

Private Sub statementID_AfterUpdate()

  Me!ChkBS = Me!statementID.Column(2)
  Me!ChkPL = Me!statementID.Column(3)
  
  Me!statementHeadingID.Requery
  Me!statementHeadingID = Null
  
  Call ChkBS_AfterUpdate
  
End Sub

Private Sub ChkBS_AfterUpdate()
  Me!unassignedOfficialAccountID.Requery
  Me!unassignedOfficialAccountID = Null
  Me!statementHeadingAccountID.Requery
  Me!statementHeadingAccountID = Null
End Sub

Private Sub ChkPL_AfterUpdate()
  Call ChkBS_AfterUpdate
End Sub

Private Sub unassignedOfficialAccountID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer, rs As DAO.Recordset
  
  If IsNull(Me!statementHeadingID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Izberi naslovno vrstico iz finan nega poro ila h kateri  eli  dodati konto!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblAccFS_StatementHeadingAccounts", dbOpenDynaset)
  rs.AddNew
  rs("statementHeadingID") = Me!statementHeadingID
  rs("officialAccountID") = Me!unassignedOfficialAccountID
  rs.Update
  rs.Close
  Set rs = Nothing

  Call ChkBS_AfterUpdate
End Sub

Private Sub companyStatementID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer, rs As DAO.Recordset

  Beep
  If IsNull(Me!companyStatementID) Then
    resp = MsgBox("Izberi finan no poro ilo!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblAccFS_Reports", dbOpenDynaset)
  rs.AddNew
  rs("companyStatementID") = Me!companyStatementID
  rs("reportTitle") = Me!companyStatementID.Column(2)
  rs("fromMonth") = 0
  rs("toMonth") = 12
  rs("fiscalYear") = Me!Yr
  rs.Update
  
  Me!frmAccFSRpts_Reports.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub Text43_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If Me!chkShowBusinessFS.visible = True Then
    Me!chkShowBusinessFS.visible = False
    Me!chkShowBusinessFS = True
    Me!frmAccFSRpts_Reports.Form.Requery
  Else
    Me!chkShowBusinessFS.visible = True
  End If
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
Dim strWhere As String

    Call FilterOptions
    
    strWhere = "reportID=" & Me!reportID
    
    If Not Me.Filter = "" Then
      strWhere = strWhere & " And " & Me.Filter
    End If
    
    DoCmd.OpenForm Me.Name, acPreview, , strWhere, acFormReadOnly, acDialog
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRecalculate_Click()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim strFilter

  If Not IsNull(Forms!frmAccFSRpts!frmAccFSRpts_Reports.Form!lockedAt) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Poro ilo: " & Forms!frmAccFSRpts!frmAccFSRpts_Reports.Form.reportTitle & " je zaklenjeno.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Forms!frmAccFSRpts!frmAccFSRpts_Reports.Form!createdAt = Now()
  DoCmd.Echo False
  Call CalculateFSReport
  strFilter = Me.Filter
  Me.Requery
  Me.Filter = strFilter
  Beep
  DoCmd.Echo True
  
End Sub

Private Sub OptCopy_AfterUpdate()
  
  If Me!OptCopy = True Then
    Me.RecordSelectors = True
  Else
    Me.RecordSelectors = False
  End If
  
  Me.Repaint
  
End Sub

Private Sub OptionHideAccounts_AfterUpdate()
  Call FilterOptions
End Sub

Private Sub OptionHideZero_AfterUpdate()
  Call FilterOptions
End Sub

Private Sub FilterOptions()

  If Me!OptionHideZero Then
    If Me!OptionHideAccounts Then
       Me.Filter = "((Total <> 0) OR (m00 <> 0)) AND IsNull(GLAccountID) AND IsNull(officialAccountID)"
    Else
       Me.Filter = "(Total <> 0) OR (m00 <> 0)"
    End If
  Else
    If Me!OptionHideAccounts Then
      Me.Filter = "IsNull(GLAccountID) AND IsNull(officialAccountID)"
    Else
      Me.Filter = ""
    End If
  End If
    
  Me.FilterOn = True
  
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, rs As DAO.Recordset

  If Not IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Poro ilo je zaklenjeno. Brisanje ni mogo e.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Me!ID = Me!reportID
  
  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati izbrano poro ilo?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  
  If resp = vbYes Then
    Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblAccFS_Reports", dbOpenDynaset)
    rs.FindFirst "(reportID)=" & Me!reportID

    If Not rs.NoMatch Then rs.delete
    rs.Close
  
    Me.Requery
    
  End If
  
  Beep

End Sub

Private Sub createdAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
 If Me!createdAt.Locked = True Then
    Me!createdAt.Locked = False
 Else
    Me!createdAt.Locked = True
 End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
Dim frm As Form

  If Not IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    Me.AllowEdits = False
  Else
    Me.AllowEdits = True
  End If
  
  Set frm = Forms!frmAccFSRpts.Form
  Me!ID = Me!reportID
  Call CreateQry(92, Me!reportID)
  frm!frmAccFSRpts_ReportDetails.Form.RecordSource = "qryAccFSRpts_ReportDetails"
  frm!frmAccFSRpts_ReportDetails.Form.Filter = "((Total <> 0) OR (m00 <> 0)) AND IsNull(GLAccountID) AND IsNull(officialAccountID)"
  frm!frmAccFSRpts_ReportDetails.Form.FilterOn = True
  
End Sub

Private Sub lockedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As String
  If IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    Me!lockedAt = Now()
    Me.AllowEdits = False
  Else
    resp = InputBox("Geslo:")
    If resp = "271898" Then
      Me!lockedAt = Null
      Me.AllowEdits = True
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub chkShowBusinessAccount_AfterUpdate()
   
  Call ShowBusinessData(Me!frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form, Me!chkShowBusinessAccount, 3000)
  
  If Me!chkShowBusinessAccount = True Then
    DoCmd.Maximize
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
  
  Call DeletePosting(Me)
  DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdUnlock_Click()
Dim resp, frm As Form

  resp = InputBox("GESLO:")
  If resp = "271898" Then
    Me.AllowAdditions = True
    Me.AllowDeletions = True
    Me.AllowEdits = True
    Set frm = Me!frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form
    frm.AllowAdditions = True
    frm.AllowDeletions = True
    frm.AllowEdits = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub fiscalDate_AfterUpdate()
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
  Call CloseFormPosting(Me)
End Sub

Private Sub Form_KeyPress(KeyAscii As Integer)
  
  If KeyAscii = 13 And Me.ActiveControl.Name = "postingName" Then
    Me!frmAccGL_PostingSub.SetFocus
    Me!frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form!postingDescription.SetFocus
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frm As Form, Yr As Long, b As Boolean

  Set frm = Me!frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form
  
  frm!postName.ColumnHidden = True
  frm!bGLAccountID.ColumnHidden = True
  frm!bPartnerID.ColumnHidden = True
  frm!bDebitAmount.ColumnHidden = True
  frm!bCreditAmount.ColumnHidden = True
  
  If IsNull(Me!fiscalYear) Then
    Yr = currentFiscalYear()
  Else
    Yr = Me!fiscalYear
  End If
  
  If YearIsOpened(Yr) = 0 Then
    b = True
  Else
    b = False
  End If
  
  Me!postingName.Locked = b
  Me!fiscalDate.Locked = b
  Me!fiscalYear.Locked = b
  frm.AllowAdditions = Not b
  frm.AllowDeletions = Not b
  frm.AllowEdits = Not b
  Me!cmdDelete.visible = Not b
  Me!LblLocked.visible = b
    
End Sub

Private Sub parentTableID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If Me!parentTableID = 19 Then
    Me!parentTableID = 222
  Else
    Me!parentTableID = 19
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub postingName_AfterUpdate()
  If Not IsNull(Me!postingName) Then Me.Caption = "Temeljnica: " & Me!postingName Else Beep: MsgBox "Manjka naziv!": Me.Caption = "(nova temeljnica)"
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim strSQL As String, resp As Integer, strFilter As String
    
  resp = MsgBox("Ali resni no  eli  brisati knji bo " & Me!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form!postingName & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form!postingID) Then
    strSQL = "DELETE *, postingID FROM tblAccGL_Postings WHERE postingID=" & Me!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form!postingID & ";"
    Call RunSQL(strSQL)
    strFilter = Me!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form.Filter
    Me!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form.Requery
    Me!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form.Filter = strFilter
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDoublePostings_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim T As DAO.Recordset, db As DAO.Database, strFilter As String, i As Integer, noOfRecords, f As Form
  
  noOfRecords = DCount("postingName", "qryAccGL_ErrDuplicatePostings")
  If Not noOfRecords > 0 Then Beep: MsgBox "Podvojene temeljnice ne obstajajo!": Exit Sub
  Set db = CurrentDb()
  Set T = db.OpenRecordset("qryAccGL_ErrDuplicatePostings")
  
  i = 1
  
  T.MoveFirst
  Do While Not T.EOF And i < 33
    If i = noOfRecords Or i = 32 Then
        strFilter = strFilter & "postingName = '" & T("postingname") & "'"
    Else
        strFilter = strFilter & "postingName = '" & T("postingname") & "' or "
    End If
    i = i + 1
    T.MoveNext
  Loop

  Set f = Me!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form
  f.Filter = strFilter
  f.FilterOn = True
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdGrossBalance_Click()
  If DCount("postingName", "qryAccGL_MonthIsNull") = 0 Then
    Call CreateQry1(5, currentCompanyID(), currentFiscalYear(), Me!m1, Me!m2)
    DoCmd.OpenReport "rptAccGL_GrossBalance", acViewReport
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "qryAccGL_MonthIsNull"
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPostningsNotZero_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim T As DAO.Recordset, db As DAO.Database, strFilter As String, i As Integer, noOfRecords, f As Form
    
  noOfRecords = DCount("postingID", "qryAccGL_ErrNotZeroPostings")
  If Not noOfRecords > 0 Then Beep: MsgBox "Temeljnice razli ne od ni  ne obstajajo!": Exit Sub
  Set db = CurrentDb()
  Set T = db.OpenRecordset("qryAccGL_ErrNotZeroPostings")
  
  i = 1
  
  T.MoveFirst
  Do While Not T.EOF And i < 33
    If i = noOfRecords Or i = 32 Then
        strFilter = strFilter & "postingID = " & T("postingid")
    Else
        strFilter = strFilter & "postingID = " & T("postingid") & " or "
    End If
    i = i + 1
    T.MoveNext
  Loop

  Set f = Me!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form
  f.Filter = strFilter
  f.FilterOn = True

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
Dim b As Boolean
  Call PostingErrorsFltr
  
  If YearIsOpened(currentFiscalYear()) = 0 Then
    b = False
  Else
    b = True
  End If
  
  Me!cmdDelete.visible = b
  Me!cmdNew.visible = b
  
End Sub

Private Sub copyLine_Click()
Dim strSQL As String

  Beep
  If Me.AllowEdits = False Then Exit Sub
  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblAccGL_PostingSubs ( postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth, dueDate, costCenterID, debitAmount, creditAmount ) " & _
           "SELECT tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingID, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.sequence, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.GLAccountID, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingDescription, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.partnerID, " & _
           "tblAccGL_PostingSubs.fiscalMonth, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.dueDate, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.costCenterID, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.debitAmount, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.creditAmount " & _
           "FROM tblAccGL_PostingSubs " & _
           "WHERE (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingSubID=" & Me!postingSubID & ");"
'  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblAccGL_PostingSubs ( postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth, dueDate, costCenterID, debitAmount, creditAmount ) " & _
'           "SELECT tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingID, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.sequence, 1110, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingDescription, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.partnerID, " & _
'           "tblAccGL_PostingSubs.fiscalMonth, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.dueDate, 134,  tblAccGL_PostingSubs.creditAmount, 0 " & _
'           "FROM tblAccGL_PostingSubs " & _
'           "WHERE (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingSubID=" & Me!postingSubID & ");"
  
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "postingSubID", Me!postingSubID)

End Sub

Private Sub creditAmount_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If Me.AllowEdits = False Then Exit Sub
  If IsNull(Forms!frmAccGL_Posting.Form!Difference) Then
    Me!creditAmount = 0
  Else
    Me!creditAmount = Forms!frmAccGL_Posting.Form!Difference
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub debitAmount_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If Me.AllowEdits = False Then Exit Sub
  If IsNull(Forms!frmAccGL_Posting.Form!Difference) Then
    Me!debitAmount = 0
  Else
    Me!debitAmount = -Forms!frmAccGL_Posting.Form!Difference
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub documentID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If Me!parentTableID = 19 Then
    Me!documentID = 0
  Else
    If Me!parentID = 0 Or IsNull(Me!parentID) Then
      Me!documentID = Me!postingSubID
    Else
      Me!documentID = Me!parentID
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub fiscalMonth_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
  If IsNull(Me!fiscalMonth) Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Polje je obvezno!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If Me!fiscalMonth < 0 Or Me!fiscalMonth > 12 Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Mesec mora biti med 0 in 12!"
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_AfterUpdate()
  If IsNull(Me!GLAccountID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Polje konto je obvezno!", vbInformation
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!fiscalMonth) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Polje mesec je obvezno!", vbInformation
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
On Error Resume Next
Dim i

  If IsNull(Forms!frmAccGL_Posting.Form!postingID) Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Vnesi ime temlejnice!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  i = DMax("sequence", "tblAccGL_PostingSubs", "postingID = " & Forms.frmAccGL_Posting.Form!postingID)
  If IsNull(i) Then sequence = 1 Else sequence = i + 1

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.MoveSize 100, 100, 27000, 10000
End Sub

Private Sub isLinked_AfterUpdate()
  Me!isLinked = Abs(Me!isLinked)
End Sub

Private Sub order_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strSQL As String

  Call RunSQL("DELETE *.* FROM tblTempAccGLPostings;")
  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblTempAccGLPostings ( postingSubID, postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth,  costCenterID, debitAmount, creditAmount, bGLAccountID, bPartnerID) " & _
           "SELECT postingSubID, postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth, costCenterID, debitAmount, creditAmount, " & FindGLAccountID("500000") & ", 37027 " & _
           "FROM tblAccGL_PostingSubs " & _
           "WHERE (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingSubID=" & Me!postingSubID & ");"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblTempAccGLPostings ( postingSubID, postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth,  costCenterID, debitAmount, creditAmount, bGLAccountID, bPartnerID) " & _
           "SELECT postingSubID, postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth, costCenterID, debitAmount, creditAmount, " & FindGLAccountID("500000") & ", 37089 " & _
           "FROM tblAccGL_PostingSubs " & _
           "WHERE (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingSubID=" & Me!postingSubID & ");"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdSave_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, frm As Form, db As Double, cr As Double

  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
  Beep
  If Me!bDebitAmount = 0 And Me!bCreditAmount = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Vsaj eden b znesek mora biti razli en od 0.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!bGLAccountID) Then
    MsgBox "B konto ne sme biti prazen.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!bPartnerID) Then
    MsgBox "B partner ne sme biti prazen.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set frm = Forms!frmAccGL_Posting!frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form
  db = Me!debitAmount1
  cr = Me!creditAmount1

  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblAccGL_PostingSubs ( postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth, costCenterID, debitAmount, creditAmount, bGLAccountID, bPartnerID, bDebitAmount, bCreditAmount ) " & _
           "SELECT postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth,  costCenterID, bDebitAmount, bCreditAmount, bGLAccountID, bPartnerID, bDebitAmount, bCreditAmount " & _
           "FROM tblTempAccGLPostings " & _
           "WHERE (tblTempAccGLPostings.tempID=" & Me!tempID & ");"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  frm!debitAmount = db
  frm!creditAmount = cr
  
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "postingSubID", Me!postingSubID)

End Sub

Private Sub fiscalMonth_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
  If IsNull(Me!fiscalMonth) Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Polje je obvezno!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If Me!fiscalMonth < 0 Or Me!fiscalMonth > 12 Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Mesec mora biti med 0 in 12!"
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_AfterUpdate()

  If IsNull(Me!GLAccountID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Polje konto je obvezno!", vbInformation
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!fiscalMonth) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Polje mesec je obvezno!", vbInformation
  End If

End Sub

Option Compare Database

Private Sub cmdCalculateInterest_Click()

  If IsNull(Me!fromDate) Or IsNull(Me!toDate) Then Beep: MsgBox "Manjka datum!": Exit Sub
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappAccLoansIntCalc"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  Me!frmAccLoansInterest.Requery
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
  If IsNull(Me!fromDate) Or IsNull(Me!toDate) Then Beep: MsgBox "Manjka datum!": Exit Sub
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptAccLoansInterest", acViewReport, , "(loanID = " & Me!loanID & ") AND (CLng(startDate) >= " & CLng(Me!fromDate) & " AND CLng(endDate) <= " & CLng(Me!toDate) & ")"
End Sub

Private Sub CmdFinishLock_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, frm As Form, frmsum As Form
Dim strSQL As String, rowIndex As Integer

  Set frm = Me
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices SET tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.lockedAt = Now(), tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.finishedAt = Now() " & _
           "WHERE tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.purchaseInvoiceID="

  For Each varItm In frm!lstDocuments.ItemsSelected
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL & frm!lstDocuments.Column(0, varItm))
  Next varItm
  Beep
  frm!lstDocuments.Requery

End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True

Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdAddFileName_Click()
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset, strPath As String, strFileName As String, dtFileDate As Date

  On Error GoTo Exit_sub
  'get the first filename
  strPath = Me!BankStatementsPath
  strFileName = Dir(Me!BankStatementsPath, vbNormal)
  dtFileDate = FileDateTime(Me!BankStatementsPath & strFileName)
  
  On Error GoTo Err_text
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblTempAccPmt_BankStatementXmlFiles", dbOpenDynaset)

  'Loop through the balance of files
  Do
    'check to see if you have a filename
    If strFileName = "" Then GoTo Exit_sub
    rs.AddNew
    If Right(strFileName, 3) = "xml" Then
        If IsNull(DFirst("bankStmtXmlFileID", "tblTempAccPmt_BankStatementXmlFiles", "(xmlFilePath = '" & strPath & "') AND (xmlFileName = '" & strFileName & "')")) Then
          rs("xmlFilePath") = Me!BankStatementsPath
          rs("xmlFileName") = strFileName
          rs("createdAT") = dtFileDate
          rs.Update
        End If
    End If
    'try for next filename
    strFileName = Dir()
  Loop
  Beep
      rs.Close
      Set rs = Nothing
        
Exit_sub:
  Me!frmAccPmtBankStImportSub.Requery
  Exit Sub
    
Err_text:
  MsgBox Error
  Resume Exit_sub

End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeleteSelected_Click()
Dim resp As Integer

  Beep
  If DCount("*", "tblTempAccPmt_BankStatementXmlFiles", "isSelected<>0") = 0 Then
    resp = MsgBox("Nobeno ime ni izbrano!", vbExclamation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati izbrana imena XML datotek?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp = vbYes Then
    Call RunSQL("DELETE *.* FROM tblTempAccPmt_BankStatementXmlFiles WHERE isSelected<>0;")
    Me!frmAccPmtBankStImportSub.Requery
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdImportXML_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_text
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset, strSQL As String
Dim fso As Object, sourceFile As String, targetFile As String, frm As Form

  strSQL = "SELECT * FROM tblTempAccPmt_BankStatementXmlFiles WHERE (isSelected<>0);"

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
  
  If rs.BOF And rs.EOF Then Beep: MsgBox "Nobena XML datoteka ni izbrana!": Exit Sub
  
  rs.MoveFirst
  Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
  Do While Not rs.EOF
    Call ImportBankSepaXml(rs("xmlFilePath") & rs("xmlFileName"), rs("bankStmtXmlFileID"))
    rs.Edit
      rs("IsSelected") = 0
      rs("importedAt") = Now()
    rs.Update
    
    sourceFile = rs("xmlFilePath") & rs("xmlFileName")                              'premakne XML v mapo Imported
    targetFile = "c:\Companies\Applications\XMLFiles\BankStatements\imported\" & rs("xmlFileName")
    If fso.FileExists(targetFile) Then Kill targetFile
    fso.MoveFile sourceFile, targetFile
        
    rs.MoveNext
  Loop

  Set frm = Forms.frmAccPmtJournals.Form
  frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Names.Requery
  frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Journals.Requery
  
Exit_sub:
  rs.Close
  Set rs = Nothing
  Set fso = Nothing
  Me!lblImportedPath.visible = True
  Beep
  Exit Sub
    
Err_text:
  MsgBox Error
  Resume Exit_sub
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSelectAll_Click()
  Call RunSQL("UPDATE tblTempAccPmt_BankStatementXmlFiles SET isSelected = 1;")
  Me!frmAccPmtBankStImportSub.Form.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
'On Error Resume Next
'Dim frm As Form
'
'  Set frm = Forms.frmAccPmtJournals.Form
'  frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Names.Requery
'  frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Journals.Requery
'
  Call RunSQL("DELETE *, impotredAt FROM tblTempAccPmt_BankStatementXmlFiles WHERE importedAt Is Not Null;")
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  Call cmdAddFileName_Click
  Me!frmAccPmtBankStImportSub.Form.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub CmdExportToPaymentJournal_Click()
Dim frm As Form

  If DCount("*", "qryAccPmtGG_PaymentAssignementsDuplicates") <> 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka. Obstajajo podvojeni zapisi!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set frm = Forms!frmAccPmtJournals.Form
  If IsNull(frm!paymentJournalID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izpisek ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qupdAccPmtGG_PaymentAssignementsExportPaymentJournal1"
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qupdAccPmtGG_PaymentAssignementsExportPaymentJournal2"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True

  frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Transactions.Requery
  
  Beep

End Sub

Private Sub cmdImportInvoices_Click()

  Me!status = "Sinhroniziram  ifrante ..."
  Me.Repaint
  Call HarmonizeCatalogues
  
  Me!status = "Uva am ra une ..."
  Me.Repaint
  Call ImportGagarinSalesInvoices(Me)
  
  Me!status = Null
  Call RefreshPaymentAssignements
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdToBeExported_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, b As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!ggPaymentAssignementID) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  
  If Me!toBeExported = 0 Then b = 1 Else b = 0
    
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccPmtGG_PaymentAssignements SET toBeExported = " & b & " " & _
           "WHERE ggPaymentAssignementID=" & Me!ggPaymentAssignementID & ";"

  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Beep
  Call RequeryMe
  
End Sub

Private Sub documentTypeID_AfterUpdate()
  Call RequeryMe
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
On Error Resume Next
Dim frm As Form

  Call RefreshPaymentAssignements
  Set frm = Forms!frmAccPmtJournalsMain!frmAccPmtJournalsJournals.Form
  Me.Requery
  Me.Caption = "Razporejanje pla il (" & frm!paymentJournalNumber & " - " & frm!paymentJournalDate & ")"
  
End Sub

Public Sub RequeryMe()
On Error GoTo err_exit
    
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "ggPaymentAssignementID", Me!ggPaymentAssignementID)
    
  Exit Sub

err_exit:
  Me.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub instalment1_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strWhere As String
  
  If IsNull(Me!instalment1) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  strWhere = "(instalment1>" & Round(0.9 * Me!instalment1) & ") And (instalment1<" & Round(1.1 * Me!instalment1) & ")"
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmSalesGGInv_Invoices", , , strWhere

End Sub

Private Sub instalment2_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strWhere As String
  
  If IsNull(Me!instalment2) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  strWhere = "(instalment2>" & Round(0.9 * Me!instalment2) & ") And (instalment2<" & Round(1.1 * Me!instalment2) & ")"
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmSalesGGInv_Invoices", , , strWhere
  

End Sub

Private Sub ptAmount_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strWhere As String

  strWhere = "(instalment1>" & Round(0.9 * ptAmount) & ") And (instalment1<" & Round(1.1 * ptAmount) & ") or "
  strWhere = strWhere & "(instalment2>" & Round(0.9 * ptAmount) & ") And (instalment2<" & Round(1.1 * ptAmount) & ")"
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmSalesGGInv_Invoices", , , strWhere
  
End Sub

Private Sub bpNm_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strWhere As String

  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  strWhere = "(partnerID)=" & (Me!partnerID)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmSalesGGInv_Invoices", , , strWhere

End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub chkNotPosted_AfterUpdate()
  If Me!chkNotPosted Then
    Me.Filter = "IsNull(postingID)"
    If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  Else
    Me.Filter = ""
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String, frmName As String, frm As Form

  Beep
  If Not IsNull(Me!postingID) Then
    resp = MsgBox("Ali naj izbri em izpisek " & Me!paymentJournalNumber & " / " & Me!paymentJournalDate & " in pripadajo o knji bo?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
  Else
    resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  brisati izpisek " & Me!paymentJournalNumber & " / " & Me!paymentJournalDate & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  End If
  
  If Not resp = vbYes Then Exit Sub

  Set frm = Forms!frmAccPmtJournals.Form

  If Not IsNull(Me!postingID) Then
    strSQL = "DELETE * FROM tblAccGL_Postings WHERE postingID=" & Me!postingID & ";"
    Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  End If
  
  strSQL = "DELETE * FROM tblAccPmt_PaymentJournals WHERE paymentJournalID=" & Me!paymentJournalID & ";"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  frmName = "frmAccGL_Postings"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!frmAccGL_PostingsSub.Form.Requery
  End If

  frmName = "frmAccPmtJournals"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Journals.Requery
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub cmdOpenPosting_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, rs As DAO.Recordset, frm As Form, resp As Integer, qDef As QueryDef, ID As Long

  ID = Me!paymentJournalID
    
  Set frm = Forms!frmAccPmtJournals.Form

  If IsNull(Me!postingID) Then
    strSQL = "SELECT paymentTransactionID " & _
             "FROM tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions " & _
             "WHERE (paymentJournalID=" & Me!paymentJournalID & ") AND (GLAccountID Is Null);"
    
    Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
    If rs.RecordCount <> 0 Then
      Beep
      MsgBox "Manjka konto. Ne morem nadaljevati!", vbInformation
      Exit Sub
    End If
    
    strSQL = "SELECT paymentTransactionID " & _
             "FROM tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions " & _
             "WHERE (paymentJournalID=" & Me!paymentJournalID & ") AND (partnerID Is Null) ;"
    
    Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
    If rs.RecordCount <> 0 Then
      Beep
      resp = MsgBox("Manjka poslovni partner. Ali nadaljujem?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
      If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If (frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Names.Form!isBankJournal = 1) And DLookup("diff", "qryAccPmtJournals_JournalsSums") <> 0 Then
      Beep
      resp = MsgBox("Vsota postavk za knji enje ni enaka znesku izpiska! Naj izpisek vseeno poknji im?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
      If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    End If
  
    Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempAccGL_Posting WHERE computerID=" & computerID())
    
    Set qDef = CurrentDb.QueryDefs("qappAccPmtJournalPosting_1")
    qDef.Parameters("ID") = ID
    qDef.Execute

    Set qDef = CurrentDb.QueryDefs("qappAccPmtJournalPosting_2")
    qDef.Parameters("ID") = ID
    qDef.Execute

    Set qDef = CurrentDb.QueryDefs("qappAccPmtJournalPosting_3")
    qDef.Parameters("ID") = ID
    qDef.Execute
    
    Call CreatePostingMySQL(, True)
    
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "paymentJournalID", ID)
    Beep
    
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & Me!postingID
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSums_Click()
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qupdAccPmt_payJournalsCreditCardSums"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  Me.Requery
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form, strSQL As String

  Me!ID = Me!paymentJournalID
  strSQL = "SELECT tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions.* " & _
  "FROM tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions " & _
  "WHERE (((tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions.paymentJournalID)=" & [Forms]![frmAccPmtJournals]![frmAccPmtJournals_Journals].[Form]![ID] & ")) " & _
  "ORDER BY tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions.sequence, tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions.paymentTransactionID;"
  Forms!frmAccPmtJournals!frmAccPmtJournals_Transactions.Form.RecordSource = strSQL

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
On Error Resume Next
Dim frm As Form
Dim b As Boolean

  Me!ID = Me!paymentJournalNameID
  Call CreateQry1(82, currentFiscalYear(), Me!paymentJournalNameID)
  Set frm = Forms!frmAccPmtJournals.Form
  frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Journals.Form.RecordSource = "qryAccPmtJournals_Journals"
  
  Set frm = frm!frmAccPmtJournals_Transactions.Form
  
  If Me!isBankJournal = 0 Then
    b = False
  Else
    b = True
  End If
  
  frm.AllowAdditions = Not b
  frm!ptDescription.SetFocus
  frm!bpName1.visible = b
  frm!meansOfPaymentID.visible = Not b
  frm!lblmeansOfPaymentID.visible = Not b
  frm!sequence.Locked = b
  frm!lblPayer.visible = b
  If b Then
    frm!meansOfPaymentID.RowSource = ""
  Else
    frm!meansOfPaymentID.RowSource = "qryAccPmt_MeansOfPayments"
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCashJournals_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccPmtJournals_CashJournals", acFormDS
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdConfirmPaidProFormas_Click()
Dim journalID As Long, cmpyID As Long, i, str
  
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Call bookingErr
  
  journalID = Forms!frmAccPmtJournals!frmAccPmtJournals_Journals.Form!paymentJournalID
  cmpyID = currentCompanyID()
  
  Call CreateQry(229, , , , , journalID)           'repaire ref information
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry(228, , , , , cmpyID, journalID)   'qryAccPmt_NoOfBookingsToBeConfirmed  i = DLookup("noOfOKBookings", "qryAccPmt_NoOfBookingsToBeConfirmed")
  i = DLookup("noOfOKBookings", "qryAccPmt_NoOfBookingsToBeConfirmed")
  
  Beep
  
  If IsNull(i) Then
    MsgBox "Prvi obrok je bil pla an za: 0 bookingov.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If i <> 0 Then
    str = DLookup("OKBookings", "qryAccPmt_NoOfBookingsToBeConfirmed")
    MsgBox "Prvi obrok je bil pla an za: " & i & " bookingov (" & str & ").", vbInformation
    Call CreateQry1(164, cmpyID, journalID)
    Call RunMySQL
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub cmdFindDocuments_Click()
Dim journalID As Long, i As Integer, cmpyID As Long
  Beep
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
  Call bookingErr

  journalID = Me!paymentJournalID
  cmpyID = currentCompanyID()
  
  Beep

  Me!partnerID.Requery
  Call CreateQry(229, , , , , journalID)
  Call RunMySQL
  Call CreateQry(120, , , , , cmpyID, journalID)
  Call RunMySQL
  Call CreateQry(230, , , , , cmpyID, journalID)
  Call RunMySQL
  If IsNull(Me!paymentTransactionID) Then Exit Sub
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "paymentTransactionID", Me!paymentTransactionID)
End Sub

Private Sub ptAmount_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Me!ptAmount = Me!ptAmountInCurrency
End Sub

Private Sub sequence_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer
DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  If Not IsNull(Forms!frmAccPmtJournals!frmAccPmtJournals_Journals.Form!postingID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Izpisek je  e knji en v GK. Nadaljujem? ( e bo  kopiral vrstico, ponovno knji i izpisek ali ro no dodaj vrstico tudi na knji bi.)", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call CopyTransaction(Me!paymentTransactionID, Me!ourRefInformation, Me!ptAmount, Me!ptAmountInCurrency, Me!accAmount, 0, "")
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "paymentTransactionID", Me!paymentTransactionID)
End Sub

On Error GoTo err_exit
Dim strWhere As String, poID
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  If IsNull(Me!paymentTransactionID) Then Beep: MsgBox "Manjkajo podatki!": Exit Sub
  
  strWhere = "(parentID=" & Me!paymentTransactionID & ") And (parentTableID=21)"
  
  poID = DLookup("paymentOrderID", "tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders", strWhere)
  
  If IsNull(poID) Then
    poID = NewPOID(Me!paymentTransactionID, 21, "REFU", "Vra ilo denarja", Date, Me!ptAmount, (Me!partnerID), Me!bpName, Me!bpStreet, Me!bpPlace, Me!bpBIC, Me!bpIBAN, "00", "1", Me!GLAccountID, "", Me!documentID)
  End If
  
  strWhere = "paymentOrderID=" & poID
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccPmtPO_PaymentOrder", , , strWhere, acFormEdit
  
  Exit Sub

err_exit:
  MsgBox "Napaka: " & err.description
  Resume Next
End Sub

  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccPmt_CreditorDebtorDetails", acNormal, , "paymentTransactionID=" & Me!paymentTransactionID

Private Sub ourRefInformation_AfterUpdate()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim ID, strWhere As String, PR As String
  
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Me!partnerID.Requery
  If Not IsNull(Me!ourRefInformation) Then
    strWhere = "refInformation='" & Me!ourRefInformation & "'"
  Else
    Beep
    MsgBox "Referenca je prazna.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  ID = DLookup("ggInvoiceID", "tblTourSales_ggInvoices", strWhere)
  If Not IsNull(ID) Then
    strWhere = "ggInvoiceID=" & ID
    Me!documentID = ID
    Me!linkName = DLookup("ggInvoiceNumber", "tblTourSales_ggInvoices", strWhere)
    Me!partnerID = DLookup("partnerID", "tblTourSales_ggInvoices", strWhere)
    If Me!ptAmountInCurrency < 0 Then PR = "P" Else PR = "R"
    If IsNull(Me!GLAccountID) Then Me!GLAccountID = FindCountryGAccountID(Me!partnerID, PR)
  End If
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
Dim i

  If IsNull(Forms!frmAccPmtJournals.Form!paymentJournalID) Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka. Izpisek oz. blagajni ki dnevnik ni izbran!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  i = DMax("sequence", "tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions", "paymentJournalID = " & Forms!frmAccPmtJournals!frmAccPmtJournals_Journals.Form!paymentJournalID)
  If IsNull(i) Then sequence = 1 Else sequence = i + 1
  
End Sub

Private Sub bookingErr()
Dim journalID As Long, noOfErr, errBookings, cmpyID As Long
  
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  journalID = Forms!frmAccPmtJournals!frmAccPmtJournals_Journals.Form!paymentJournalID
  
  cmpyID = currentCompanyID()
  
  Call CreateQry(229, , , , , journalID)           'repaire ref information
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry(228, , , , , cmpyID, journalID)   'qryAccPmt_NoOfBookingsToBeConfirmed
  
  noOfErr = DLookup("noOfErrBookings", "qryAccPmt_NoOfBookingsToBeConfirmed")
  
  If noOfErr <> 0 Then
    Beep
    errBookings = DLookup("errBookings", "qryAccPmt_NoOfBookingsToBeConfirmed")
    MsgBox "Obstajajo bookingi z napako.  t. napa nih bookingov: " & noOfErr & ". Bookingi z napako: " & errBookings & ". Izvajanje programa bo prekinjeno.", vbExclamation
    End
  End If
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdBanks_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmShrdAccBanks", acFormDS, , , , acDialog
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeletePaymentOrder_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String, poID As Long

  poID = Me!paymentOrderID
  Beep
  If Not DFirst("unitedPaymentOrderID", "tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders", "unitedPaymentOrderID=" & Me!paymentOrderID) = 0 Then
    resp = MsgBox("Zdru eni pla ilni nalog ni mogo e izbrisati! Izbrisati ga je mo no preko forme Zdru evanje pla ilnih nalogov.", vbExclamation)
    Exit Sub
  Else
    If Not IsNull(Me!exportedAt) Then
      resp = MsgBox("Pla ilni nalog je  e bil izvo en.  e bo izbrisan lahko nastopijo te ave pri knji enju ban nega izpiska! Ali naj pla ilni nalog vseeno izbri em?", vbExclamation + vbYesNo)
      If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    Else
      resp = MsgBox("Ali naj izbri em izbrani pla ilni nalog?", vbExclamation + vbYesNo)
      If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    End If
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
    strSQL = "DELETE *, paymentOrderID FROM tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders WHERE paymentOrderID=" & poID & ";"
    Call RunSQL(strSQL)
    Beep
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub documentID_AfterUpdate()
Dim docName

  'docName = DLookup("docName", "qryDoc_Documents", "docID=" & Me!documentID)
  'If Not IsNull(docName) Then Me!relationshipName = docName
  
End Sub

Private Sub exportedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  
  If IsNull(Me!exportedAt) Then
    Me!exportedAt = Now()
  Else
    Me!exportedAt = Null
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub isPermanentOrder_AfterUpdate()
  Me!isPermanentOrder = Abs(Me!isPermanentOrder)
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BPNew"
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BP", , , "(PartnerID)=" & (Me!partnerID)
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub debtorRefInformation_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Me!debtorRefInformation = PaymentReference((Me!paymentOrderID))
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
On Error Resume Next
Dim resp As Integer
  If IsNull(Me!paymentOrderID) Then Exit Sub
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  If IsNull(Me!debtorRefInformation) Then
    Me!debtorRefInformation = PaymentReference(Me!paymentOrderID)
  Else
    If Me!debtorRefInformation <> PaymentReference(Me!paymentOrderID) Then
      resp = MsgBox("Pla nikova (na a) referenca se razlikuje od tiste, ki ra unalnik generira sam. Ali naj obstoje o referenco prepi em z avtomatsko generirano?", vbExclamation + vbYesNo)
      If resp = vbYes Then Me!debtorRefInformation = PaymentReference(Me!paymentOrderID)
    End If
  End If
  
  Call RequeryFrmPaymentOrders(Forms!frmAccPmtPO_PaymentOrders.Form)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Forms!frmPurchaseInvoice!frmPurchaseInvoicePaymentOrders.Form, "paymentOrderID", Me!paymentOrderID)
  
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
Dim resp As Integer
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then Exit Sub
  resp = MsgBox("Posodobim podatke o prejemniku na pla ilnem nalogu?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  Me!creditorName = Me!partnerID.Column(1)
  Me!creditorStreet = Me!partnerID.Column(2)
  Me!creditorPlace = Me!partnerID.Column(3)
  Me!creditorIBAN = Me!partnerID.Column(4)
  Me!creditorBIC = Me!partnerID.Column(5)
End Sub

Private Sub toBePayed_AfterUpdate()
Me!toBePayed = Abs(Me!toBePayed)
End Sub

End Sub

Private Sub cmdCreateXML_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_text
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset, i As Integer, strSQL As String, Response As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!BankAccountToBePaidFrom) Then Beep: MsgBox "Banka (TRR) ni izbrana !!!": Exit Sub
  
  strSQL = "SELECT IIf([paymentExecutionDate]<Date(),-1,IIf([paymentExecutionDate]>Date(),1,0)) AS status " & _
           "FROM tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders " & _
           "WHERE (toBePayed = 1) AND (companyID= currentCompanyID()) " & _
           "GROUP BY IIf([paymentExecutionDate]<Date(),-1,IIf([paymentExecutionDate]>Date(),1,0));"
  
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
  If rs.RecordCount = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Pla ilni nalogi za izvoz ne obstajajo!"
    Exit Sub
  Else
    rs.MoveFirst
    Do Until rs.EOF
      If rs(0) = -1 Then
        Beep
        Response = MsgBox("Med nalogi izbranimi za izvoz, obstajajo nalogi z datumom izvedbe pla ila pred dana njim dnem. Ali naj nadaljujem s kreiranjem XML?", vbYesNo)
        If Response <> 6 Then Beep: Exit Sub
      End If
      If rs(0) = 1 Then
        Beep
        Response = MsgBox("Med nalogi izbranimi za izvoz, obstajajo kasnej i datumi izvedbe pla ila. Ali naj nadaljujem s kreiranjem XML?", vbYesNo)
        If Response <> 6 Then Beep: Exit Sub
      End If
      rs.MoveNext
    Loop
  End If

  If CreateSEPAXML = True Then
    
    strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders " & _
             "SET exportedAt = Now(), toBePayed = 0 " & _
             "WHERE (toBePayed=1) AND (companyID=CurrentCompanyID());"
             
    Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
    strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders AS tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders_1 " & _
             "INNER JOIN tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders ON tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders_1.paymentOrderID = tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders.unitedPaymentOrderID " & _
             "SET tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders.exportedAt = tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders_1.exportedAt WHERE tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders_1.exportedAt Is Not Null;"

    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)

   Me!lstToBeExecutedPO.Requery
   Me!lstExecutedPO.Requery
    
  End If
  
Exit_exp:
  Exit Sub
    
Err_text:
  MsgBox Error
  Resume Exit_exp

End Sub

Private Sub cmdToday_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, resp As Integer
Dim varItm As Variant
 
  Beep
  If Me!lstToBeExecutedPO.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Noben zapis ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  resp = MsgBox("Ali naj spremenim pla ilnim nalogom za prenos datum izvedbe pla ila v " & Me!ExecutionDate & "?", vbYesNo)
  If resp <> 6 Then Exit Sub
  
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstToBeExecutedPO.ItemsSelected

    strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders SET paymentExecutionDate = " & CLng(Me!ExecutionDate) & " WHERE paymentOrderID=" & Me!lstToBeExecutedPO.Column(0, varItm) & ";"
    Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  Next varItm
  Call RequeryFrmPaymentOrders(Me)

End Sub

Option Compare Database

Private Sub bpID1_AfterUpdate()
  Me!LeadingPaymentOrders.Requery
  Me!LeadingPaymentOrders = Null
  Me!IncludedPaymentOrders.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub bpID2_AfterUpdate()
 Me!ExportedPaymentOrders.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeletePaymentOrder_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
  
  Beep
  If IsNull(Me!LeadingPaymentOrders) Then MsgBox ("Izberi pla ilni nalog, ki bi ga rad izbrisal!"): Exit Sub
  
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders SET unitedPaymentOrderID = Null WHERE unitedPaymentOrderID=" & Me!LeadingPaymentOrders.Column(0)
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders WHERE paymentOrderID=" & Me!LeadingPaymentOrders.Column(0)
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)

  Me!LeadingPaymentOrders.Requery
  Me!LeadingPaymentOrders = ""
  Me!NotUnitedPaymentOrders.Requery
  Me!IncludedPaymentOrders.Requery
  Me!partnerID.Requery
  Me!partnerID = Me!bpID1
  Me!bpID1.Requery
  Me!LeadingPaymentOrders = Null
  Me!NotUnitedPaymentOrders = Null
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptAccPmtPO_UnitedPayments", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRefreshList_Click()
  Call CreateQry1(242, SQLDate(Me!fromDate), SQLDate(toDate), currentCompanyID())
  Me!bpID2.RowSource = "qryAccPmtPO_unitedPOCreditors"
  Me!ExportedPaymentOrders.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdUniteOrders_Click()
Dim db As Database, varItm As Variant, poID As Long, description As String, amount As Double, strSQL As String
    
  If Me!NotUnitedPaymentOrders.ItemsSelected.Count < 2 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izbrati je potrebno vsaj dva pla ilna naloga!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  poID = NewPOID(0, 20, "GDSV", "united payment " & Date, Date, Me!AmountSum, Me!partnerID, Me!partnerID.Column(2), Me!partnerID.Column(3), Me!partnerID.Column(4), Me!partnerID.Column(5), Me!partnerID.Column(6), "SI00", "1", 0, "")

 
  For Each varItm In Me!NotUnitedPaymentOrders.ItemsSelected
    strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders SET unitedPaymentOrderID= " & poID & " WHERE paymentOrderID=" & Me!NotUnitedPaymentOrders.Column(0, varItm)
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Next varItm
  
  Me!bpID1.Requery
  Me!bpID1 = Me!partnerID
  Me!partnerID.Requery
  Me!LeadingPaymentOrders.Requery
  Me!NotUnitedPaymentOrders.Requery
  Me!NotUnitedPaymentOrders = Null
  Me!AmountSum = 0

  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_Click()
Dim frm As Form, PR As String
  
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "PartnerID ne sme biti Null.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set frm = [Forms]![frmAccPmtJournals]![frmAccPmtJournals_Transactions].[Form]
  frm!partnerID = Me!partnerID
  If frm!ptAmountInCurrency < 0 Then PR = "P" Else PR = "R"
  frm!GLAccountID = FindCountryGAccountID(Me!partnerID, PR)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "paymentTransactionID", frm!paymentTransactionID)
  
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdCancel_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String

  If IsNull(Me!paymentTransactionID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Predra un bo prestavljen med potekle predra une. Nadaljujem?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  End If
  
  strSQL = "UPDATE      tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices SET     tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices.canceledAt = Now() "
  strSQL = strSQL & " WHERE     tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices.proFormaInvoiceID=" & Me!proFormaInvoiceID

  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  Me.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdConfirm_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String

  If IsNull(Me!paymentTransactionID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Predra un ni povezan z nobenim pla ilom. Ali ga  eli  potrditi brez pla ila?", vbYesNo + vbInformation)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    strSQL = "UPDATE    tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices SET     tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices.confirmedAt = Now()"
  Else
    strSQL = "UPDATE    tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices SET     tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices.confirmedAt = Now(),    tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices.paymentTransactionID =" & Me!paymentTransactionID
  End If
  
  strSQL = strSQL & " WHERE     tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices.proFormaInvoiceID=" & Me!proFormaInvoiceID

  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  Me.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "proFormaInvoiceID", Me!proFormaInvoiceID)
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
  Me!pfID = Me!proFormaInvoiceID
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frm As Form, strSQL As String
  
  If IsNull(Me!paymentTransactionID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka! Program bo prekinjen.", vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  strSQL = "UPDATE      tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices SET     tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices.businessPartnerID = " & Me!partnerID
  strSQL = strSQL & " WHERE     tblTourSales_ggProformaInvoices.proFormaInvoiceID=" & Me!proFormaInvoiceID

  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblTourSales_Bookings SET tblTourSales_Bookings.businessPartnerID = " & Me!partnerID
  strSQL = strSQL & " WHERE tblTourSales_Bookings.bookingID=" & Me!bookingID

  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "proFormaInvoiceID", Me!proFormaInvoiceID)
End Sub

Private Sub refInformation_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frm As Form, strSQL As String

  Set frm = Forms!frmAccPmtJournals!frmAccPmtJournals_Transactions.Form
  
  If IsNull(frm!paymentTransactionID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka! Izberi vrstico na pla ilih.", vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions SET tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions.ourRefInformation = '" & Me!refInformation
  strSQL = strSQL & "' WHERE tblAccPmt_PaymentTransactions.paymentTransactionID=" & frm!paymentTransactionID
  
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "paymentTransactionID", frm!paymentTransactionID)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "proFormaInvoiceID", Me!proFormaInvoiceID)

End Sub

Private Sub cmdAutoLink_Click()
      
  Call DeleteLinkErrors(Me!OptPR)
  
  If Me!OptPR = True Then
    Call AutoLinkPR(Me)
  Else
    Call AutoLinkAcceptancePIbyLinkName(Me)
  End If
  
  Me!frmAccPR_Sums.SetFocus
  Me!frmAccPR_Sums.Form.RequeryFormSums
End Sub

Private Sub CmdAutoLink2_Click()

  Call DeleteLinkErrors(Me!OptPR)
  If Me!OptPR = True Then
    Call AutoLinkPRbyAmount
  Else
    Call AutoLinkAcceptancePIbyAmount(Me)
  End If

  Me!frmAccPR_Sums.SetFocus
  Me!frmAccPR_Sums.Form.RequeryFormSums
  
End Sub

End Sub

  Call RefreshData
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdNewARAP_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, docID As Long, strWhere As String
  
  If Me!lstPostingSubID.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Noben zapis ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstPostingSubID.ItemsSelected
    
    strWhere = " WHERE postingSubID=" & Me!lstPostingSubID.Column(0, varItm)
    
    docID = 0
    
    If Me!lstPostingSubID.Column(11, varItm) <> "19" Then
      docID = Me!lstPostingSubID.Column(12, varItm)
    End If
    
    Call RunMySQL("UPDATE tblAccGL_PostingSubs SET documentID= " & docID & strWhere & ";")

  Next varItm
  
  Me!lstPostingSubID.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdPostAcceptances_Click()
Dim iMax As Integer, i As Integer, cmptrID As Long
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
  
  iMax = DCount("acceptanceID", "qryAccLinkAccptsPIs_NotPostedAcceptances")
  If iMax = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Vsi prevzemi so knji eni!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  cmptrID = computerID()
  
  i = 0
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("qryAccLinkAccptsPIs_NotPostedAcceptances")
  rs.MoveFirst
  
  Do While Not rs.EOF
    i = i + 1
    Me!status = i & "/" & iMax & " ..."
    Me.Repaint
    
    Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempAccGL_Posting WHERE computerID=" & cmptrID & ";")
    
    Call CreateQry(93, rs("acceptanceID"), , , , cmptrID)
    Call RunMySQL
         
    Call CreateQry(94, rs("acceptanceID"), , , , cmptrID)
    Call RunMySQL

    Call CreatePostingMySQL
    rs.MoveNext
  Loop
  
  Beep
  Me!status = Null
  Me.Repaint

End Sub

Private Sub CmdPrint_2_Click()
  If IsNull(Me!frmAccPR_Sums.Form.Filter) Or Me!frmAccPR_Sums.Form.Filter = "" Then
    DoCmd.OpenReport "rptAccPR_Sums", acViewReport
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenReport "rptAccPR_Sums", acViewReport, , Me!frmAccPR_Sums.Form.Filter
  End If
End Sub

End Sub

Private Sub copyPostingSub_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, remainder As Double
  
  Beep
  If Me!lstPostingSubID.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Noben zapis ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Me!postSubAm > n(Me!lstPostingSubID.Column(5)) Then
    MsgBox "Znesek je prevelik."
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  remainder = n(Me!lstPostingSubID.Column(5)) - Me!postSubAm
  
  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblAccGL_PostingSubs ( postingID, sequence, GLAccountID, postingDescription, partnerID, fiscalMonth, dueDate, costCenterID, creditAmount, linkName, documentID ) " & _
           "SELECT tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingID, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.sequence, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.GLAccountID, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingDescription, " & _
           "tblAccGL_PostingSubs.partnerID, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.fiscalMonth, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.dueDate, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.costCenterID, '" & Me!postSubAm & "' as x2, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.linkName, -1 as x3 " & _
           "FROM tblAccGL_PostingSubs " & _
           "WHERE (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingSubID=" & Me!lstPostingSubID.Column(0) & ");"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccGL_PostingSubs SET tblAccGL_PostingSubs.creditAmount ='" & remainder & "' " & _
           "WHERE (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingSubID=" & Me!lstPostingSubID.Column(0) & ");"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  Me!lstPostingSubID.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdBalanceIsZero_Click()
On Error Resume Next
    
  DoCmd.Echo False
  Me.Filter = "Abs(TotalBalance)<=" & Me!fltrTotalBalance
  If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  
  DoCmd.Echo True
End Sub

  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "zzzQdelTransfer"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  Call RequeryFormSums
End Sub

  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qryAccPR_partnerIsNull", acViewNormal, acEdit
