Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
Dim accID As Long, ptrID As Long
  
  If hasValue(Me!GLAccountID) And hasValue(Me!partnerID) Then
    accID = Me!GLAccountID
    ptrID = Me!partnerID
  Else
    accID = 0
    ptrID = 0
  End If
  
  Me!strFilterBP = Null
  Me!strFilterGLAccount = Null
  Me.Filter = ""
  Me.FilterOn = False
  
  Me.Requery
  
  With Me.RecordsetClone
    .FindFirst "(GLAccountID=" & accID & ") AND (partnerID=" & ptrID & ")"
    If Not .NoMatch Then
      Me.Bookmark = .Bookmark
    End If
  End With
  
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
  Call RequeryFormSums
End Sub

Private Sub ptrID_AfterUpdate()
    Call CreateQry(35, Me!ptrID, , , , SQLDate(Date))
    Me.RecordSource = "qryAccPR_Sums"
End Sub

Private Sub strFilterGLAccount_AfterUpdate()
  Call FltrOn
End Sub

Private Sub strFilterBP_AfterUpdate()
  Call FltrOn
End Sub

Public Sub FltrOn()
On Error Resume Next
    
  DoCmd.Echo False
    
  If Not IsNull(Me!strFilterBP) Then
    If Not IsNull(Me!strFilterGLAccount) Then
      Me.Filter = "GLAccountNumber Like '*" & Me!strFilterGLAccount & "*' And partnerName Like '*" & Me!strFilterBP & "*'"
    Else
      Me.Filter = "partnerName Like '*" & Me!strFilterBP & "*'"
    End If
  Else
    If Not IsNull(Me!strFilterGLAccount) Then
      Me.Filter = "GLAccountNumber Like '*" & Me!strFilterGLAccount & "*'"
    Else
      Me.Filter = ""
    End If
  End If
  
  If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  
  DoCmd.Echo True
  
End Sub

Public Sub RequeryFormSums()
On Error Resume Next
Dim accID As Long, ptrID As Long, accID1 As Long, ptrID1 As Long, strFilter As String
  
  accID = Me!GLAccountID
  ptrID = Me!partnerID

  If IsNull(Me.Filter) Or Me.Filter = "" Then
    strFilter = ""
  Else
    strFilter = Me.Filter
  End If

  DoCmd.Echo False
  DoCmd.GoToRecord
  accID1 = Me!GLAccountID
  ptrID1 = Me!partnerID
  
  If Forms!frmAccPR!OptPR = True Then
    Me.RecordSource = "qryAccPR_Sums"
  Else
    Me.RecordSource = "qryAccLinkAccptsPIs"
  End If
  
  If Not (strFilter = "") Then
    Me.Filter = strFilter
    If Not Me.FilterOn = True Then Me.FilterOn = True
  End If
'me.Requery
  With Me.RecordsetClone
    .FindFirst "(GLAccountID=" & accID & ") AND (partnerID=" & ptrID & ")"
    If Not .NoMatch Then
      Me.Bookmark = .Bookmark
    Else
      .FindFirst "(GLAccountID=" & accID1 & ") AND (partnerID=" & ptrID1 & ")"
      Me.Bookmark = .Bookmark
    End If
  End With
  

  DoCmd.Echo True
  
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String, rs As Recordset
  
  Call CheckDDVO

  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati obstoje i obra un DDV?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then End
  
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblAccVat_DDVOSub WHERE ddvoID=" & Me!ddvoID & ";")
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblAccVat_DDVODetails WHERE ddvoID=" & Me!ddvoID & ";")
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblAccVat_DDVO_KIR WHERE ddvoID=" & Me!ddvoID & ";")
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblAccVat_DDVO_KPR WHERE ddvoID=" & Me!ddvoID & ";")
  Me!vatReport.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
Dim m As Integer, strSQL As String, rs As Recordset
Dim resp As Integer
  
  Call CheckDDVO

  If DCount("DDVOSubID", "tblAccVat_DDVOSub", "ddvoID=" & Me!ddvoID) <> 0 Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Obra un  e obstaja. Ali  eli  izbrisati obstoje i obra un DDV in ustvariti novega?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then End
  End If
  
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblTourSales_ggInvoices SET fiscalDate = serviceLastDate " & _
           "WHERE (tblTourSales_ggInvoices.documentTypeID <> 20) AND (tblTourSales_ggInvoices.documentStatusID = 3) AND (tblTourSales_ggInvoices.fiscalDate IS NULL);"
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblTourSales_ggInvoices SET fiscalDate = DATE(InvoiceDate) " & _
           "WHERE (tblTourSales_ggInvoices.documentTypeID = 20);"
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  DoCmd.Hourglass True
  Call RunMySQL("CALL P_AccVat_Create_DDVO(" & Me!ddvoID & ", " & Me!companyID & ", '" & XMLDate(Me!Dt1) & "', '" & XMLDate(Me!Dt2) & "');")
  Call RunMySQL("CALL P_AccVat_Create_KIRKPR(" & Me!ddvoID & ", " & Me!companyID & ", '" & XMLDate(Me!Dt1) & "', '" & XMLDate(Me!Dt2) & "');")
  Call CreateQry1(275, Me!ddvoID)
  
  Me!vatReport.Requery
  DoCmd.Hourglass False
  Beep
End Sub

Public Sub DDVOID_AfterUpdate()

  If IsNull(Me!ddvoID) Then
    Call CreateQry1(275, 0)
  Else
    Me!m1 = Me!ddvoID.Column(2)
    Me!m2 = Me!ddvoID.Column(3)
    Me!Dt1 = Me!ddvoID.Column(5)
    Me!Dt2 = Me!ddvoID.Column(6)
    Call CreateQry1(275, Me!ddvoID)
    Me!vatReport.Requery
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub ShowDetails_AfterUpdate()
On Error Resume Next
Dim rpt As Report

  Set rpt = Me!vatReport.Report
  If Me!ShowDetails Then
    rpt.Detail.visible = True
    rpt.vatBaseDDVONumberHeader.visible = True
    rpt.FooterTotal.BackColor = 16380396
    rpt.Filter = "isDDVOItem=1 OR isDDVOItem=0"
  Else
    rpt.Detail.visible = False
    rpt.vatBaseDDVONumberHeader.visible = False
    rpt.FooterTotal.BackColor = 16777215
    rpt.Filter = "isDDVOItem=1"
  End If
End Sub

Public Sub CheckDDVO()
Dim m As Integer, strSQL As String, rs As Recordset
Dim resp As Integer
  
  If IsNull(Me!companyID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Podjetje ni izbrano!", vbExclamation
    End
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!ddvoID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Obdobje ni izbrano!", vbExclamation
    End
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!Dt1) Or IsNull(Me!Dt2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Obdobje ni izbrano!", vbExclamation
    End
  End If
  
  If Not Me!ddvoID.Column(4) = "" Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Obra un je zaklenjen! Brisanje ni mogo e", vbExclamation)
    End
  End If
  
  For m = Month(Me!Dt1) To Month(Me!Dt2)
    If MonthIsOpened(CDate("01." & m & "." & currentFiscalYear()), Me!companyID) = 0 Then
      Beep
      MsgBox "Mesec " & m & "." & currentFiscalYear() & " je zaklenjen (oz. ne obstaja). Program bo prekinjen."
      End
    End If
  Next m
End Sub

Private Sub fiscalMonth1ID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!fiscalMonth2ID = Me!fiscalMonth1ID
  Me!DDVONumber = "DDV" & Right(currentFiscalYear(), 2) & "." & Left([fiscalMonth1ID].[Column](1), 2) & "-" & Left([fiscalMonth2ID].[Column](1), 2)
  Me!OBDOBJE_OD = Me!fiscalMonth1ID.Column(2)
  Me!OBDOBJE_DO = Me!fiscalMonth1ID.Column(3)
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
End Sub

Private Sub fiscalMonth2ID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!DDVONumber = "DDV" & Right(currentFiscalYear(), 2) & "." & Left([fiscalMonth1ID].[Column](1), 2) & "-" & Left([fiscalMonth2ID].[Column](1), 2)
  Me!OBDOBJE_DO = Me!fiscalMonth2ID.Column(2)
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim frm As Form, ID

  Set frm = Forms!frmAccVat_DDVO.Form
  frm!ddvoID.Requery

    
  If Not IsNull(frm!ddvoID) Then Exit Sub
  
  ID = DMax("DDVOID", "tblAccVat_DDVO", "companyID=" & currentCompanyID())
  
    frm!m1 = Null
    frm!m2 = Null
    frm!Dt1 = Null
    frm!Dt2 = Null
    
  If Not IsNull(ID) Then
    frm!ddvoID = ID
    frm!m1 = frm.ddvoID.Column(2)
    frm!m2 = frm.ddvoID.Column(3)
    frm!Dt1 = frm.ddvoID.Column(5)
    frm!Dt2 = frm.ddvoID.Column(6)
    Call CreateQry1(275, ID)
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub lockedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    Me!lockedAt = Now()
  Else
    Me!lockedAt = Null
  End If
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdChangeNoOfPurchases_Click()
  
  If IsNull(Me!newNoOfPurchases) Or DFirst("NoOfP", "qryAccVAT_tourismPurchaseInv_control_DDVO") = Me!newNoOfPurchases Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka."
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call CreateQry1(250, Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.Column(0), Me!newNoOfPurchases)
  Call RunMySQL
  Me!lstDDVO.RowSource = "qryAccVAT_tourismPurchaseInv_control_DDVO"
End Sub

Private Sub documentStatusID_AfterUpdate()

  If Me!documentTypeID = 23 Then
    Call CreateQry(232, Me!documentTypeID, Me!documentStatusID)
  Else
    Call CreateQry(1, Me!documentTypeID, Me!documentStatusID)
  End If
  Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.RowSource = "qryAccPI"

End Sub

Private Sub documentTypeID_AfterUpdate()
  
  If Me!documentTypeID = 23 Then
    Call CreateQry(232, Me!documentTypeID, Me!documentStatusID)
  Else
    Call CreateQry(1, Me!documentTypeID, Me!documentStatusID)
  End If
  Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.RowSource = "qryAccPI"
  
End Sub

Private Sub bDisableBypassKey_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
'Once you have created the module, then you will need to attach the following code to a command button (or label, graphic etc.):
'Assign this to the OnClick event of a command button (or double-click event of a label or graphic) named "bDisableBypassKey"
'Change the "TypeYourBypassPasswordHere" default password to your password

    On Error GoTo Err_bDisableBypassKey_Click
    'This ensures the user is the programmer needing to disable the Bypass Key
    Dim strInput As String
    Dim strMsg As String
    Beep
    strMsg = "Do you want to enable the Bypass Key?" & vbCrLf & vbLf & _
             "Please key the programmer's password to enable the Bypass Key."
    strInput = InputBox(Prompt:=strMsg, title:="Disable Bypass Key Password")
    If strInput = "271898" Then
        SetProperties "AllowBypassKey", dbBoolean, True
        Beep
        MsgBox "The Bypass Key has been enabled." & vbCrLf & vbLf & _
               "The Shift key will allow the users to bypass the startup " & _
               "options the next time the database is opened.", _
               vbInformation, "Set Startup Properties"
    Else
        Beep
        SetProperties "AllowBypassKey", dbBoolean, False
        MsgBox "Incorrect ''AllowBypassKey'' Password!" & vbCrLf & vbLf & _
               "The Bypass Key was disabled." & vbCrLf & vbLf & _
               "The Shift key will NOT allow the users to bypass the" & _
               "startup options the next time the database is opened.", _
               vbCritical, "Invalid Password"
        Exit Sub
    End If
Exit_bDisableBypassKey_Click:
    Exit Sub
Err_bDisableBypassKey_Click:
    MsgBox "bDisableBypassKey_Click", err.Number, err.description
    Resume Exit_bDisableBypassKey_Click
End Sub

Private Sub cmdClose_Click()

  If computerPrivileges() = 10 Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmApp_OfficeMainForm"
    DoCmd.Close acForm, "frmApp_Login"
  Else
    DoCmd.Quit
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub curCompanyGroupID_AfterUpdate()
  
  Call SetSelected("tblSet_CompanyGroup", "companyGroupID", Me!curCompanyGroupID)
  Me!curCompanyID = Null
  Me!curCompanyID.Requery
  Me!yrNotOpened.visible = False
  
End Sub

Private Sub curCompanyID_AfterUpdate()
  Call SetSelected("tblSet_Company", "companyID", Me!curCompanyID)
  Me.Caption = Me!curCompanyID.Column(1) & " (" & Me!curFiscalYear & ")"
  Call SaveAllCurrentSettings
    
  If YearIsOpened(Me!curFiscalYear) = 0 Then
    Me!yrNotOpened.visible = True
  Else
    Me!yrNotOpened.visible = False
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub curFiscalYear_AfterUpdate()
  Call SetSelected("tblSet_FiscalYear", "fiscalYear", Me!curFiscalYear)
  Me.Caption = Me!curCompanyID.Column(1) & " (" & Me!curFiscalYear & ")"
  Call SaveAllCurrentSettings
  
  If YearIsOpened(Me!curFiscalYear) = 0 Then
    Me!yrNotOpened.visible = True
  Else
    Me!yrNotOpened.visible = False
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  
  SetProperties "AllowBypassKey", dbBoolean, False ' shiftkey=disabled
      
  If IsNull(Me!curCompanyID.Column(1)) Then
    Me.Caption = "(izberi podjetje)"
  Else
    Me.Caption = Me!curCompanyID.Column(1) & " (" & Me!curFiscalYear & ")"
  End If
    
  If IsNull(Me!curFiscalYear) Then Exit Sub
  
  If YearIsOpened(Me!curFiscalYear) = 0 Then
    Me!yrNotOpened.visible = True
  Else
    Me!yrNotOpened.visible = False
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub lstApplications_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)

  If Not (Me!lstApplications.Column(3) = "") Then
     DoCmd.OpenForm "frmApp_LoginPassword"
  Else
    If Me!lstApplications.Column(2) = "" Then Exit Sub
    If Me!lstApplications.Column(0) = 10 Then
      DoCmd.OpenForm Me!lstApplications.Column(2), acFormDS
    Else
      DoCmd.OpenForm Me!lstApplications.Column(2)
    End If
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  End If
    
  
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdEnter_Click()
  Call txtPassword_AfterUpdate
End Sub

Private Sub txtPassword_AfterUpdate()
Dim frm As Form

  Set frm = Forms!frmApp_Login.Form

  If Not (frm!lstApplications.Column(3) = txtPassword) Then
    MsgBox "Napa no geslo! Po treh napa nih poskusih bo celoten sistem blokiran.", vbInformation
    Me!txtPassword = Null
    Quit
  Else
    If frm!lstApplications.Column(2) = "" Then Exit Sub
    DoCmd.OpenForm frm!lstApplications.Column(2)
    DoCmd.Close acForm, frm.Name
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  End If
      
End Sub

Private Sub CmdGLOpeningBalance_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, Yr As Integer

  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  narediti otvoritev za leto " & currentFiscalYear() & "?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  DoCmd.Hourglass True
  Call RunMySQL("Delete From tblTempAccGL_Posting;")
  Yr = currentFiscalYear()
  Call CreateQry(129, Yr - 1, , , , Yr, computerID())
  Call RunMySQL
  Call CreatePostingMySQL
  DoCmd.Hourglass False
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdLinkTables_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)

  If Me!cmdEmpWC.visible = True Then
    Me!cmdEmployees.visible = 0
    Me!cmdEmpWC.visible = 0
    Me!cmdCRSales.visible = 0
    Me!CmdFiscalStatements.visible = 0
    Me!CmdTimeclock.visible = 0
    Me!pwd.visible = 0
    Me!cmdUnhide.visible = 0
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
   If currentComputerName = "ntbmitja4" Then
    Me!cmdUnhide.visible = True
    Exit Sub
   End If
   
   Me!pwd.Locked = False
   Me!pwd.visible = -1
       
End Sub

Private Sub CmdTourPurch_WrongNoPurchases_Click()
Dim D1 As Date, D2 As Date

  D1 = IIf(Month(Date) < 7, CDate("01.07." & Year(Date) - 1), CDate("01.07." & Year(Date)))
  D2 = IIf(Month(Date) < 7, CDate("30.06." & Year(Date)), CDate("30.06." & Year(Date) + 1))
  Call CreateQry1(298, currentCompanyID, SQLDate(D1), SQLDate(D2), "diff<>0", "1=1", "1=1")
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmTourPurchaseErr_WrongNoOfPurchases", acNormal
End Sub

Private Sub cmdTourSales_ggInvoices_Click()
Dim D1 As Date, D2 As Date

  D1 = IIf(Month(Date) < 7, CDate("01.07." & Year(Date) - 1), CDate("01.07." & Year(Date)))
  D2 = IIf(Month(Date) < 7, CDate("30.06." & Year(Date)), CDate("30.06." & Year(Date) + 1))
  Call CreateQry1(207, currentCompanyID, 2, 3, SQLDate(D1), SQLDate(D2))
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmTourSales_ggInvoices", acNormal

End Sub

    Beep

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
Dim pswd As String
 
  If IsNull(Me!curCompanyID.Column(1)) Then
    Me.Caption = "(izberi podjetje)"
  Else
    Me.Caption = Me!curCompanyID.Column(1) & " (" & Me!curFiscalYear & ")"
  End If
    
  If IsNull(Me!curFiscalYear) Then Exit Sub
  
  If YearIsOpened(Me!curFiscalYear) = 0 Then
    Me!yrNotOpened.visible = True
  Else
    Me!yrNotOpened.visible = False
  End If
    
  Me!CurrentAppName = Mid(CurrentDb.Name, InStrRev(CurrentDb.Name, "\") + 1, InStrRev(CurrentDb.Name, ".") - InStrRev(CurrentDb.Name, "\") - 1)
    
  Call HideShowCommands
      
End Sub

Private Sub pwd_AfterUpdate()
  If Me!pwd = "mc..03" Then
    Me!cmdUnhide.visible = True
  Else
    Me!cmdUnhide.visible = False
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdUnhide_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)

  If Me!pwd = "mc..03" Then
    Call HideShowCommands
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub HideShowCommands()
  
  If Me!pwd = "mc..03" Or computerPrivileges() = 9 Or computerPrivileges() = 10 Then
    Me!cmdEmployees.visible = True
    Me!cmdEmpWC.visible = True
    Me!cmdCRSales.visible = True
    Me!CmdFiscalStatements.visible = True
    Me!CmdTimeclock.visible = True
    Me!CmdDailyReport.visible = True
    Me!CmdCRAnalyses.visible = True
    Me!pwd = Null
  Else
    Me!cmdEmployees.visible = 0
    Me!cmdEmpWC.visible = 0
    Me!cmdCRSales.visible = 0
    Me!CmdFiscalStatements.visible = 0
    Me!CmdTimeclock.visible = 0
    Me!CmdDailyReport.visible = 0
    Me!CmdCRAnalyses.visible = True
  End If
  
  Me!pwd.Locked = 0
  Me!pwd.visible = 0
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdAddProductivityDepartments_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, i As Integer, iMax  As Integer

  iMax = Me!crDateID.ItemsSelected.Count
  
  If iMax = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Noben datum ni izbran. Izberi vsaj en datum!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If

  For Each varItm In Me!crDateID.ItemsSelected

    Me!progress = "   " & i + 1 & " / " & iMax & "   "
    Me.Repaint
    If Me!crDateID.Column(1, varItm) = "" Then
        Call CreateQry1(321, SQLDate(Me!crDateID.Column(0, varItm)))
        Call RunMySQL
        Call CreateQry1(322, SQLDate(Me!crDateID.Column(0, varItm)))
        Call RunMySQL
    End If
    i = i + 1
  
  Next varItm
  
  Me!progress = Null
  Beep
  Me!crDateID.Requery

End Sub

Private Sub CmdAddProductivityEmployees_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, i As Integer, iMax  As Integer

  iMax = Me!crDateID.ItemsSelected.Count
  
  If iMax = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Noben datum ni izbran. Izberi vsaj en datum!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If

  For Each varItm In Me!crDateID.ItemsSelected

    Me!progress = "   " & i + 1 & " / " & iMax & "   "
    Me.Repaint
    If Me!crDateID.Column(2, varItm) = "" Then
        Call CreateQry1(323, SQLDate(Me!crDateID.Column(0, varItm)))
        Call RunMySQL
        Call CreateQry1(324, SQLDate(Me!crDateID.Column(0, varItm)))
        Call RunMySQL
    End If
    i = i + 1
  
  Next varItm
  
  Me!progress = Null
  Beep
  Me!crDateID.Requery

End Sub

Private Sub costCenterID_AfterUpdate()
  Call CmdRequery_Click
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
  Me!crDateID.Requery
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub CmtUnselect_Click()
  Me!crDateID = Null
  Call CmdRequery_Click
End Sub

Private Sub cmpyName_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Call SetSelected("tblSet_Company", "companyID", Me!companyID)
  Call SaveAllCurrentSettings
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmCmpy_Company"
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
On Error Resume Next
    If currentCompanyID() <> CLng(Forms!frmapp_OfficeMainForm.Form!curCompanyID) Then
      
      Call SetSelected("tblSet_Company", "companyID", CLng(Forms!frmapp_OfficeMainForm.Form!curCompanyID))
      Call SaveAllCurrentSettings
    End If
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdAddCustomer_Click()
  
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmCR_crInvoiceCustomers", acNormal, , , acFormAdd
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmCR_crInvoiceCustomers", acNormal, , "crInvoiceID=" & Me!crInvoiceID, acFormEdit
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub CmdDeleteCustomer_Click()
Dim resp As Integer

    resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  odstraniti kupca z ra una?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblCRSales_crInvoiceCustomers WHERE crInvoiceID=" & Me!crInvoiceID)
    Me.Requery
    MsgBox "Ko bo  kon al s spreminjanjem ra una, ne pozabi potrditi ra un."

End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
  FollowHyperlink ("https://mv.skifun.si/loaInvoice.php?iid=" & Me!crInvoiceID & "&fromApp=1")
End Sub

Private Sub customerID_AfterUpdate()
Dim iID As Long

  Me!customerData = Me!customerID.Column(2)
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  iID = Me!crInvoiceID
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Forms!frmSalesCRInvoices.Form, "crinvoiceID", iID)
  Beep
  
  MsgBox " e si spremenil kupca, je potrebno ponovno potrditi ra un na FURSu!", vbInformation

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strWhere As String, invTotal, payTotal, resp As Integer
  
  strWhere = "IsNull(deletedAt) AND crInvoiceID=" & Me!crInvoiceID
  
  invTotal = DSum("(1-discount)*qty*salesPrice", "tblCRSales_crInvoiceDetails", strWhere)
  payTotal = DSum("paymentAmount", "tblCRSales_crInvoicePayments", strWhere)
  
  If IsNull(invTotal) Then
    resp = MsgBox("Ra un je brez postavk. Ali vseeno zaprem formo?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Cancel = True
  End If
  
  If IsNull(payTotal) Then
    resp = MsgBox("Ra un je brez pla ilnih sredstev. Ali vseeno zaprem formo?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Cancel = True
  Else
    If payTotal <> invTotal Then
      resp = MsgBox("Znesek ra una iz znesek pla il se razlikujeta. Ali vseeno zaprem formo?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
      If resp <> vbYes Then Cancel = True
    End If
  End If
  
  
  
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
Dim strWhere As String
  
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then Exit Sub
  strWhere = "partnerID=" & Me!partnerID.Column(0)
  Me!partnerData = Me!partnerID.Column(1) & ";;" & DLookup("street", "tblPtr_Partners", strWhere) & ";" & DLookup("place", "tblPtr_Partners", strWhere)
    
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub ChkShowHideRecordSelector_AfterUpdate()
  Me.RecordSelectors = Me!ChkShowHideRecordSelector
End Sub


Private Sub CmdRefresh_Click()
  If IsNull(Me!fltrCashRegisterID) Or IsNull(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1) Or IsNull(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka. Blagajna in/ali datum nista izbrana.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
    
  Call CreateQry(127, Me!fltrCashRegisterID, Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1, Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2)
  Me.RecordSource = "qryCR_crInvoices"
End Sub

  If IsNull(Me!fltrCashRegisterID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi blagajno!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Me.RecordSource = "qryCR_crInvoices" Then
    Call CreateQry(138, Me!fltrCashRegisterID)
    Me.RecordSource = "qryCR_crInvoices_differences"
    Me!paymentTotal.visible = True
  Else
    Me.RecordSource = "qryCR_crInvoices"
    Me!paymentTotal.visible = False
  End If
  
End Sub

  FollowHyperlink ("https://mv.skifun.si/loaInvoice.php?iid=" & Me!crInvoiceID & "&fromApp=1")
End Sub

  FollowHyperlink ("https://mv.skifun.si/incReport4.php?cdi=" & Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1 & "&id=&pr=")
End Sub

  Call CreateQry1(315, currentCompanyID(), SQLDate(Me!D1), SQLDate(Me!D2))
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpDR_Tip", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub crInvoiceNumber_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
On Error Resume Next

  DoCmd.OpenForm frmName, , , "crInvoiceID=" & Me!crInvoiceID, acFormEdit

Private Sub fltrCashRegisterID_AfterUpdate()
 
    Call CreateQry(127, 0, 0, 0)
    Call cmdFilterOff_Click
    Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1.Requery
    Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2.Requery
    
End Sub

Private Sub fltrCRFiscalDateID1_AfterUpdate()

  If IsNull(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka. Datum ni izbra.", vbInformation
    Call CreateQry(127, 0, 0, 0)
  Else
    Me!D1 = CDate(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1.Column(1))
    Me!cmdPrintDayEnd.Caption = " Zaklju ek:" & vbCrLf & " " & Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1.Column(1)
    If IsNull(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2) Then
      Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2 = Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1
      Me!D2 = CDate(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1.Column(1))
    End If
    Call CreateQry(127, Me!fltrCashRegisterID, Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1, Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2)
  End If

   Call cmdFilterOff_Click
   Me.RecordSource = "qryCR_crInvoices"

End Sub

Private Sub fltrCRFiscalDateID2_AfterUpdate()

  If IsNull(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka. Datum ni izbra.", vbInformation
    Call CreateQry(127, 0, 0, 0)
  Else
    Me!D2 = CDate(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2.Column(1))
    If IsNull(Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1) Then
      Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1 = Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2
    End If
    Call CreateQry(127, Me!fltrCashRegisterID, Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID1, Me!fltrCRFiscalDateID2)
  End If

   Call cmdFilterOff_Click
   Me.RecordSource = "qryCR_crInvoices"
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCrInvNoFltrAdd_Click()
  
  If IsNull(Me!fltrCRInvoiceNumber) Then Exit Sub
  If IsNull(Me!strFilter) Then
    Me!strFilter = "(crInvoiceNumber Like '*" & Me!fltrCRInvoiceNumber & "*')"
  Else
    Me!strFilter = Me!strFilter & " And (crInvoiceNumber Like '*" & Me!fltrCRInvoiceNumber & "*')"
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdBPFltrAdd_Click()
  
  If IsNull(Me!fltrCustomer) Then Exit Sub
  If IsNull(Me!strFilter) Then
    Me!strFilter = "(customer Like '*" & Me!fltrCustomer & "*')"
  Else
    Me!strFilter = Me!strFilter & " And (customer Like '*" & Me!fltrCustomer & "*')"
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdMeansOfPaymentFltrAdd_Click()
  
  If IsNull(Me!fltrMeansOfPaymentName) Then Exit Sub
  If IsNull(Me!strFilter) Then
    Me!strFilter = "(meansOfPayments Like '*" & Me!fltrMeansOfPaymentName & "*')"
  Else
    Me!strFilter = Me!strFilter & " And (meansOfPayments Like '*" & Me!fltrMeansOfPaymentName & "*')"
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()

  Me!fltrCRInvoiceNumber = Null
  Me!fltrCustomer = Null
  Me!fltrMeansOfPaymentName = Null
  
  Me!strFilter = Null
  Me.Filter = ""
  Me.FilterOn = False
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdFilterOn_Click()
  
  If IsNull(Me!strFilter) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  Me.Filter = Me!strFilter
  If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  
End Sub

  End If
  
  Me!cmdPrintInvoice.Caption = " " & Me!crInvoiceNumber
    
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
  Call RunSQL("DELETE *.* FROM tblCR_DailyMenu WHERE productID=" & Me!productID)
  Me.Requery
  Forms!frmCR_DailyMenu.Form!lstProductID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdConfirm_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim frm As Form, strSQL As String, ID As Long
  
  Set frm = Forms!frmCR_LoginIPs.Form
  If IsNull(frm!loginIPID) Then
    MsgBox "Napaka. Noben zapis ni izbran."
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Then
    MsgBox "Restavracija ni izbrana!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!employeeID) Then
    MsgBox "Delavec ni izbran!"
    Exit Sub
  End If

  If Me!password = Me!employeeID.Column(2) Or Me!password = "271898" Then

    ID = frm!loginIPID
    strSQL = "UPDATE tblCR_LoginIPs SET costCenterID=" & Me!costCenterID & ", partnerID =" & Me!employeeID & ", loginConfirm = 1, confirmedAt = Now() " & _
             "WHERE loginIPID= " & ID

'    frm!costCenterID = Me!costCenterID
'    frm!partnerID = Me!employeeID
'    frm!loginConfirm = 1
'    frm!confirmedAt = Now()
'    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
    
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "loginIPID", ID)
    
    DoCmd.Close acForm, "frmCR_LoginIPconfirm"
    
  Else
    MsgBox "Napa no geslo!", vbInformation
    Me!password = Null
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.MoveSize 12300, 6000, 7500, 7000
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub confirm_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim resp As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!confirmedAt) Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmCR_LoginIPConfirm", acNormal
  Else
    resp = MsgBox("Odjavim IP naslov?", vbYesNo + vbInformation)
    If resp = vbYes Then
      
      Me!costCenterID = Null
      Me!partnerID = Null
      Me!loginConfirm = 0
      Me!confirmedAt = Null
      
      DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
    End If
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form
  
  frmName = "frmApp_OfficeMainForm"
'  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
'    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
'    Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "purchaseInvoiceID", Me!purchaseInvoiceID)
'  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.MoveSize 8000, 2000, 16000, 6000
End Sub

Private Sub loginText_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)

  If IsNull(Me!confirmedAt) Then
    Me!confirmedAt = Now()
    Me!loginConfirm = 1
  Else
    Me!confirmedAt = Null
    Me!loginConfirm = 0
  End If
  
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCreatePDF_Click()
Dim invID As Long
Dim rptName As String

  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
  If IsNull(Me!officeInvoiceID) Then
    invID = 0
  Else
    invID = Me!officeInvoiceID
  End If

  Call CreateQry1(151, invID)
  Call CreateQry(152, invID)
  Call CreateQry(153, invID)
  Call CreateQry1(154, invID)

  If currentCountryID = 53 Then
    rptName = "rptDocAcc_OfficeInvoice_HR"
  Else
    rptName = "rptDocAcc_OfficeInvoice"
  End If
  
  Call CreateReportPDF(Me!officeInvoiceNumber & "_" & currentCompanyID() & "_" & Me!partnerID.Column(1), rptName)
End Sub

  Shell "C:\WINDOWS\explorer.exe """ & "c:\Companies\Applications\PDFFiles\", vbNormalFocus
End Sub

Private Sub officeInvoiceDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
  
  If YearIsOpened(Year(Me!officeInvoiceDate)) = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Leto je zaprto oz. ne obstaja!", vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
  End If
  
  If MonthIsOpened(Me!officeInvoiceDate) = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Mesec je zaprt oz. ne obstaja!", vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
  Call UpdateBPDataOnOfficeInvoice
End Sub

Public Sub UpdateBPDataOnOfficeInvoice()
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT partnerName, street, place FROM qryPtr_cmpyBusinessPartners WHERE (partnerID= " & Me!partnerID & " );")
  Me!businessPartnerData = rs("partnerName") & ";;" & rs("street") & ";" & rs("place")
  
End Sub

  End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPost_Click()
Dim invID As Long, postID
  
  invID = Me!officeInvoiceID
  postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "(parentID=" & invID & ") And (parentTableID=63)")
  
  If IsNull(postID) Then
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
    Call RunSQL("DELETE * FROM tblTempAccGLPostings;")
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappDocAcc_officeInvoicePosting_120"
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappDocAcc_officeInvoicePosting_260"
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappDocAcc_officeInvoicePosting_760"
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    Call CreatePosting
    postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "(parentID=" & invID & ") And (parentTableID=63)")
  End If
  
  If Not IsNull(postID) Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", acNormal, , "postingID=" & postID
  End If
  
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
Dim invID As Long, rep As Report
Dim rptName As String

  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
  If IsNull(Me!officeInvoiceID) Then
    invID = 0
  Else
    invID = Me!officeInvoiceID
  End If

  Call CreateQry1(151, invID)
  Call CreateQry(152, invID)
  Call CreateQry(153, invID)
  Call CreateQry1(154, invID)

  If currentCountryID = 53 Then
    rptName = "rptDocAcc_OfficeInvoice_HR"
  Else
    rptName = "rptDocAcc_OfficeInvoice"
  End If
  
  DoCmd.OpenReport rptName, acViewReport
  Reports(rptName)!cmdPrint.visible = True

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim bpID As String, frmName As String, frm As Form
  
  frmName = "frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoices"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!partnerID.Requery
    If Not IsNull(Me!officeInvoiceID) Then
      Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form, "Clng(officeInvoiceID)", Me!officeInvoiceID)
    End If
  End If

End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub delete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer
  If IsNull(Me!officeInvoiceDetailID) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  
  resp = MsgBox("Bri em vrstico?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp = vbYes Then
    Me!deletedAt = Now()
    Me.Requery
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
'On Error Resume Next
Dim i

  If IsNull(Forms.frmDocAcc_officeInvoice.Form!officeInvoiceID) Or (Forms.frmDocAcc_officeInvoice.Form!officeInvoiceID = 0) Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Najprej izpolni podatke v glavi ra una!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  i = DMax("sequence", "tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoiceDetails", "officeInvoiceID = " & Forms!frmDocAcc_officeInvoice.Form!officeInvoiceID)
  If IsNull(i) Then sequence = 1 Else sequence = i + 1
  
  
End Sub

Private Sub productID_AfterUpdate()
On Error GoTo err_handle

  Me!productName = Me!productID.Column(8)
  Me!purchasePrice = Me!productID.Column(2)
  If Me!productID.Column(5) = True Then Me!salesPrice = Me!productID.Column(3) / (1 + Me!productID.Column(6)) Else Me!salesPrice = Me!productID.Column(3)
  If Not Me!productID.Column(4) = "" Then
    Me!vatRateID = Me!productID.Column(4)
  End If
  If Not Me!productID.Column(7) = "" Then
    Me!unitID = Me!productID.Column(7)
  End If
  
err_exit:
  Exit Sub
  
err_handle:
  Beep
  MsgBox ("Napaka v osnovnih podatkih! Popravi artikel!")
  Resume err_exit
  
End Sub

Private Sub unitOfMeasureID_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer

  If DCount("productUoMID", "tblProdProductUoMs", "productID=" & (Me!productID) & " And unitOfMeasureID = " & (Me!unitOfMeasureID)) = 0 Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Izbrana enota mere pri artiklu " & Me!productID.Column(1) & " ne obstaja! Double Click na polje enota mere za pregled obstoje ih enot mere.", vbExclamation)
    Cancel = True
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub unitOfMeasureID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdProductUoMs", acFormDS, , "productID=" & (Me!productID), , acDialog
  Forms.frmProdProductUoMs.Form.Caption = "Enote mere za: " & Me!productID.Column(1) & "              (DblClick za izbiro)"
  Forms.frmProdProductUoMs.Form!productID.DefaultValue = (Me!productID)
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Private Sub cmdCopy_Click()
Dim rs1 As DAO.Recordset, rs2 As DAO.Recordset, db As DAO.Database, m1 As Integer, y1 As Long, oldInvID As Long, newInvID As Long
Dim strSQL As String, resp As Integer

  Set db = CurrentDb
  Set rs1 = db.OpenRecordset("tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoices")
  Set rs2 = db.OpenRecordset("tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoices", dbOpenDynaset, dbSeeChanges)
  
  oldInvID = Me!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form!officeInvoiceID
  
  rs1.FindFirst "officeInvoiceID=" & oldInvID
  
  m1 = Month(rs1("serviceFirstDate"))
  
  If m1 = 12 Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Ali naj izdam ra un za obdobje januar " & Year(rs1("serviceFirstDate")) + 1 & "? (Yes = naslednje leto, No = teko e leto, Cancel = prekini program", vbInformation + vbYesNoCancel)
    If resp = vbYes Then y1 = Year(rs1("serviceFirstDate")) + 1
    If resp = vbNo Then y1 = Year(rs1("serviceFirstDate"))
    If resp = vbCancel Then Exit Sub
  Else
    y1 = Year(rs1("serviceFirstDate"))
  End If
  
  If m1 = 12 Then m1 = 1 Else m1 = m1 + 1
  
  rs2.AddNew
  rs2("officeInvoiceNumber") = NewDocumentNumber("tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoices", "officeInvoiceNumber", "IR", y1, currentCompanyID, True)
  rs2("vatStatusID") = rs1("vatStatusID")
  rs2("documentTypeID") = rs1("documentTypeID")
  rs2("documentTypeSubID") = rs1("documentTypeSubID")
  rs2("officeInvoiceDate") = Date
  rs2("partnerID") = rs1("partnerID")
  rs2("partnerData") = rs1("partnerData")
  rs2("costCenterID") = IIf(IsNull(rs1("costCenterID")), Null, rs1("costCenterID"))
  rs2("GLAccountID") = IIf(IsNull(rs1("GLAccountID")), Null, rs1("GLAccountID"))
  rs2("serviceFirstDate") = CDate("1." & m1 & "." & y1)
  rs2("serviceLastDate") = LastDayInMonth(rs2("serviceFirstDate"), 0)
  rs2("dueDate") = CDate(Date + 8)
  rs2("issuedBy") = IIf(IsNull(rs1("issuedBy")), Null, rs1("issuedBy"))

  rs2("companyID") = rs1("companyID")
  rs2("fiscalYear") = y1
  rs2.Update
  'rs2.Bookmark = rs2.LastModified
  newInvID = DMax("officeInvoiceID", "tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoices")
  rs1.Close
  rs2.Close
  
  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoiceDetails (officeInvoiceID, sequence, productID, productName, qty, unitID, purchasePrice, salesPrice, vatRateID, discount )" & _
           "SELECT " & newInvID & " AS id, sequence, productID, productName, qty, unitID, purchasePrice, salesPrice, vatRateID, discount " & _
           "FROM tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoiceDetails " & _
           "WHERE (tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoiceDetails.deletedAt Is Null) AND (officeInvoiceID=" & oldInvID & ");"
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form, "officeInvoiceID", Me!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form!officeInvoiceID)
  
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCreatePDF_Click()
Dim frm As Form
Dim rptName As String

  If currentCountryID = 53 Then
    rptName = "rptDocAcc_OfficeInvoice_HR"
  Else
    rptName = "rptDocAcc_OfficeInvoice"
  End If
  
  Set frm = Me!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form

  Call CreateReportPDF(frm!officeInvoiceNumber & "_" & currentCompanyID() & "_" & frm!partnerName, rptName)

End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim frm As Form, resp As Integer, invID As Long, strSQL As String
  
  Set frm = Me!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form
  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Ali resni no  eli  izbrisati ra un " & frm!officeInvoiceNumber & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  
  If resp = vbYes Then
    invID = frm!officeInvoiceID
    Call DeleteChild("tblAccGL_Postings", invID, 63)                                                          'brisanje otrok
    
    strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblDocAcc_OfficeInvoices WHERE officeInvoiceID= " & invID & ";"     'brisanje dokumenta
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
    Me!officeInvoiceID = Null
    frm.Requery
    
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
  If Not IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
    Me!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form.Filter = "partnerID=" & Me!partnerID
    If Me!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form.FilterOn = False Then Me!frmDocAcc_OfficeInvoicesSub.Form.FilterOn = True
  End If
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub acceptanceDate_AfterUpdate()
  If Year(Me!acceptanceDate) <> currentFiscalYear() Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Datum je izven aktivnega leta?"
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub CmdAllProducts_Click()
  Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptanceSub.Form!productID.RowSource = "qryDocGoods_Acceptance_AllProducts"
  Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptanceSub.Form!productID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdBPProducts_Click()
  Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptanceSub.Form!productID.RowSource = "qryDocGoods_Acceptance_BPProducts"
  Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptanceSub.Form!productID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeleteDocument_Click()
Dim frm As Form, resp As Integer, strSQL As String
  
  resp = MsgBox("Bri em prevzem " & Me!acceptanceNumber & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  Call DeleteChild("tblAccGL_Postings", 69, Me!acceptanceID)
  
  strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblDocGoods_Acceptances WHERE acceptanceID=" & Me!acceptanceID & ";"
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPosting_Click()
Dim postID, cmptrID  As Long

  postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "(parentTableID=69) AND (parentID=" & Me!acceptanceID & ")")
  
  If IsNull(postID) Then
    cmptrID = computerID()
    Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempAccGL_Posting WHERE computerID=" & cmptrID & ";")
    
    Call CreateQry(93, Me!acceptanceID, , , , cmptrID)
    Call RunMySQL
         
    Call CreateQry(94, Me!acceptanceID, , , , cmptrID)
    Call RunMySQL

    Call CreatePostingMySQL
  End If
  
  postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "(parentTableID=69) AND (parentID=" & Me!acceptanceID & ")")
  
  If IsNull(postID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Knji ba ne obstaja!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
     DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & postID
 
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptDocGoods_Acceptance", acViewReport, , "acceptanceID=" & Me!acceptanceID
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSavePrices_Click()
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qupdDocGoods_Acceptance_UpdatePrices"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdViewOriginal_Click()
  Call OpenScan(69, Me!acceptanceID)
End Sub

Private Sub discount_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
  If Not IsNumeric(Me!discount) Then Beep: Cancel = True
  Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptanceSub.Form!discount.DefaultValue = Me!discount
End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
  Me.Caption = "Prevzem:"
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form

  frmName = "frmDocGoods_Acceptances"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) And Not IsNull(Me!acceptanceID) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    If Not IsNull(Me!acceptanceID) Then Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm!frmDocGoods_AcceptancesSub.Form, "acceptanceID", Me!acceptanceID)
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmDocGoods_CreatingAcceptancesFromOrders"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!lstOrders.Requery
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_KeyDown(KeyCode As Integer, Shift As Integer)
  If Screen.ActiveControl.Name = "deliveryNoteNumber" Then
    If KeyCode = 9 Or KeyCode = 13 Then
      Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptanceSub.SetFocus
      Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptanceSub.Form!productID.SetFocus
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  If IsNull(Me!acceptanceNumber) Then Me.Caption = "(novi prevzem)" Else Me.Caption = "Prevzem:"
  Me!acceptanceDate.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub newBP_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BPNew"
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptanceSub.Form!productID.Requery
End Sub

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim frm As Form, resp As Integer, strSQL As String
  
  Set frm = Me!frmDocGoods_AcceptancesSub.Form
  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Bri em prevzem " & frm!acceptanceNumber & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  Call DeleteChild("tblAccGL_Postings", 69, Me!acceptanceID)
  
  strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblDocGoods_Acceptances WHERE acceptanceID=" & Me!acceptanceID & ";"
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  frm.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
  Me.frmDocGoods_AcceptancesSub.Form.Filter = ""
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDocGoods_Acceptance", acNormal, , , acFormAdd
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub acceptanceNumber_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDocGoods_Acceptance", acNormal, , "acceptanceID=" & Me!acceptanceID, acFormEdit
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
  Forms!frmDocGoods_Acceptances.Form!acceptanceID = Me!acceptanceID
End Sub

Private Sub noOfScans_Click()
  Call OpenScan(69, Me!acceptanceID)
End Sub

Private Sub postID_Click()
Dim postID, cmptrID  As Long

  postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "(parentTableID=69) AND (parentID=" & Me!acceptanceID & ")")
  
  If IsNull(postID) Then
    cmptrID = computerID()
    Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempAccGL_Posting WHERE computerID=" & cmptrID & ";")
    
    Call CreateQry(93, Me!acceptanceID, , , , cmptrID)
    Call RunMySQL
         
    Call CreateQry(94, Me!acceptanceID, , , , cmptrID)
    Call RunMySQL

    Call CreatePostingMySQL
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "acceptanceID", Me!acceptanceID)
    Beep
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & postID
  End If
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdCreateAcceptances11_Click()
Dim db As DAO.Database, rs As DAO.Recordset, varItm As Variant, acceptanceID As Long, orderID As Long, cmpyID As Long
Dim qDef As QueryDef

  If Me!lstOrders.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Noben zapis ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
   
  cmpyID = currentCompanyID()
  Set db = CurrentDb()
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblDocGoods_Acceptances", dbOpenDynaset, dbSeeChanges)

  For Each varItm In Me!lstOrders.ItemsSelected
    
      If Me!lstOrders.Column(11, varItm) <> "" Then
          Beep
          MsgBox "Iz naro ila " & Me!lstOrders.Column(1, varItm) & " je  e bil narejen prevzem.", vbInformation
          GoTo nextItem
      End If
    
      If Me!lstOrders.Column(6, varItm) = "" Then
        Beep
        MsgBox "Pri naro ilu " & Me!lstOrders.Column(1, varItm) & " manjka datum prevzema!"
      
      Else

        rs.AddNew
        rs("acceptanceNumber") = NewDocumentNumber("tblDocGoods_Acceptances", "acceptanceNumber", "Prv", Year(Me!lstOrders.Column(6, varItm)), cmpyID, True)
        rs("purchaseOrderID") = Me!lstOrders.Column(0, varItm)
        rs("partnerID") = Me!lstOrders.Column(7, varItm)
        rs("acceptanceDate") = DateValue(Me!lstOrders.Column(6, varItm))
        rs("fiscalYear") = Year(Me!lstOrders.Column(6, varItm))
        rs("costCenterID") = Me!lstOrders.Column(8, varItm)
        rs("companyID") = cmpyID
        If Me!lstOrders.Column(12, varItm) <> "" Then rs("deliveryNoteNumber") = Me!lstOrders.Column(12, varItm)
        rs.Update
        rs.Bookmark = rs.LastModified
        acceptanceID = rs("acceptanceID")
    
        orderID = Me!lstOrders.Column(0, varItm)
        Set qDef = db.QueryDefs("qappDocGoods_CreatingAcceptanceFromOrderAddProducts")
        qDef.Parameters("orderID") = Me!lstOrders.Column(0, varItm)
        qDef.Parameters("acceptanceID") = acceptanceID
        qDef.Execute
      End If
    
nextItem:

  Next varItm

  rs.Close
  db.Close
  
  Me!lstOrders.Requery
  Me!lstOrders = orderID
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub CmdOpenAcceptance_Click()
  If Me!lstOrders.Column(10) = "" Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Povezan prevzem ne obstaja.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDocGoods_Acceptance", , , "acceptanceID=" & Me!lstOrders.Column(11), acFormEdit
End Sub

Private Sub CmdOpenOrder_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDoc_PurchaseOrder", , , "purchaseOrderID=" & Me!lstOrders.Column(0), acFormEdit
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
  Me!lstOrders.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub lstHiddenOrders_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Call hideOrder(Me!lstHiddenOrders.Column(0), 0)
End Sub

Private Sub lstOrders_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)

  Call hideOrder(Me!lstOrders.Column(0), 1)
  
End Sub

Private Sub hideOrder(ID As Long, hide As Integer)
Dim db As DAO.Database, rs As DAO.Recordset

  If hide = 1 And Me!lstOrders.Column(9) <> "" Then
    MsgBox ("Ni mogo e!")
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set db = CurrentDb()
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblDocGoods_PurchaseOrders", dbOpenDynaset)
  rs.FindFirst "purchaseOrderID=" & ID
  
  If Not rs.NoMatch Then
    rs.Edit
    rs("hide") = hide
    rs.Update
    Me!lstOrders.Requery
    Me!lstHiddenOrders.Requery
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub acceptedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Me!acceptedAt = Now()

Private Sub cmdEditSupplier_Click()
Dim frm As Form
  
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Dobavitelj ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDoc_PurchaseOrder_BusinessPartner"
  Set frm = Forms!frmDoc_PurchaseOrder_BusinessPartner.Form
  frm!txtBPName = Me!partnerID.Column(1)
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strWhere As String
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
  strWhere = "purchaseOrderID=" & Me!purchaseOrderID
  If DCount("*", "tblDocGoods_PurchaseOrdersubs", strWhere) = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Naro ilo je prazno!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  resp = MsgBox("Ali naj natisnem tudi prazna polja?", vbInformation + vbYesNoCancel)
  If resp = vbCancel Then Exit Sub
  
  If resp = vbYes Then
    DoCmd.OpenReport "rptDoc_PurchaseOrder", acViewReport, , strWhere
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenReport "rptDoc_PurchaseOrder", acViewReport, , strWhere & " And (Not IsNull(orderedPackagingQty))"
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSendEmail_Click()
Dim attachmentFile As String, eMailBody As String, resp As Integer, eID As Long
  
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
  If DCount("*", "tblDocGoods_PurchaseOrdersubs", "purchaseOrderID=" & Me!purchaseOrderID) = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Naro ilo je prazno!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!eMailAddress) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka e-mail naslov dobavitelja!", vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
  End If

  If InStr(Me!eMailAddress, "@") = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Preveri e-mail naslov dobavitelja!", vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterDepartmentID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka oddelek, ki naro a!", vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!toBeDeliveredAt) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka datum dostave!", vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!orderedAt) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Blago je  e bilo naro eno: " & Me!orderedAt & ", Ali  eli  naro ilo poslati  e enkrat?", vbExclamation + vbYesNo)
    If resp = vbNo Then Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Me!orderedAt = Now
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  attachmentFile = CreateReportPDF(Me!purchaseOrderNumber, "rptDoc_PurchaseOrder", "Not IsNull(orderedPackagingQty) AND purchaseOrderID=" & Me!purchaseOrderID)
  eMailBody = "Spo tovani," & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
  eMailBody = eMailBody & "V prilogi vam po iljamo naro ilo blaga  t. " & Me!purchaseOrderNumber & " za restavracijo " & Forms!frmDoc_PurchaseOrders.Form!costCenterID.Column(1) & "." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
  eMailBody = eMailBody & "Lep pozdrav," & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
  eMailBody = eMailBody & Me!orderedByEmployeeID.Column(1) & vbCrLf & vbCrLf

  eID = Me!costCenterDepartmentID.Column(2)
  
  If SendMail(False, eMailData("sendUserName", eID), eMailData("sendUsing", eID), eMailData("smtpServer", eID), eMailData("smtpServerPort", eID), _
              eMailData("smtpAuthenticate", eID), eMailData("sendPassword", eID), eMailData("smtpUsesSL", eID), Me!eMailAddress, "", Me!purchaseOrderNumber, eMailBody, attachmentFile) Then
     MsgBox "Naro ilo je bilo uspe no poslano!", vbInformation
  Else
     Me!orderedAt = Null
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub costCenterDepartmentID_AfterUpdate()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDoc_PurchaseOrder_Employees"
  Me!partnerID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form

  frmName = "frmDoc_PurchaseOrders"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    If Not IsNull(Me!purchaseOrderID) Then
      Set frm = Forms!frmDoc_PurchaseOrders!frmDoc_PurchaseOrdersSub.Form
      Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "purchaseOrderID", Me!purchaseOrderID)
    End If
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmDocGoods_CreatingAcceptancesFromOrders"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms!frmDocGoods_CreatingAcceptancesFromOrders.Form
    frm!lstOrders.Requery
  End If
    
  
End Sub

  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDoc_PurchaseOrder_Employees"
End Sub

    Cancel = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
Dim strSQL As String, rs As DAO.Recordset

  strSQL = "SELECT tblPtr_bpOrderAddresses.* FROM tblPtr_bpOrderAddresses " & _
           "WHERE (tblPtr_bpOrderAddresses.partnerID=" & Me!partnerID & _
           ") AND (tblPtr_bpOrderAddresses.costCenterDepartmentID= " & Me!costCenterDepartmentID & ");"

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
  Me!partnerID1 = Me!partnerID
  
  If rs.RecordCount = 1 Then
    Me!meansOfOrderID = rs("defaultMeansOfOrderID")
    Me!phoneNumber = rs("phoneNumber")
    Me!eMailAddress = rs("eMailAddress")
    Me!attentionPerson = rs("attentionPerson")
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub cmdAddSupplierProducts_Click()
  
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID1) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napaka. Manjka dobavitelj,  igar izdelke naj dodam.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  If IsNull(Me!purchaseOrderID) Then
    MsgBox "Napaka. Zapri in odpri naro ilo."
    Exit Sub
  End If

  Call CreateQry(134, Me!purchaseOrderID)
  Call CreateQry(135, Me!purchaseOrderID, Me!partnerID1)
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qryDocGoods_PurchaseOrder_AddProducts"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  
  Me!frmDoc_PurchaseOrder_Order.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDeleteAll_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String

  Beep
  resp = MsgBox(" eli  brisati vse artikle na naro ilu?", vbCritical + vbYesNo, "Brisanje artiklov:")
  
  If resp = vbYes Then
    strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblDocGoods_PurchaseOrderSubs WHERE purchaseOrderID= " & Me!purchaseOrderID & ";"
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
    Me!frmDoc_PurchaseOrder_Order.Requery
    Beep
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub acceptedAt_AfterUpdate()

  If IsNull(Year(Me!acceptedAt)) Then Exit Sub
   If Not (Year(Me!acceptedAt) = Me!fiscalYear) Then
     Me!fiscalYear = Year(Me!acceptedAt)
     Beep
     MsgBox "Naro ilo je bilo premaknjeno v leto " & Me!fiscalYear, vbInformation
   End If
 
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub ChkClosedOrders_AfterUpdate()
  
  If Me!ChkClosedOrders Then
    Me!LabelChkClosed.ForeColor = 0
  Else
    Me!LabelChkClosed.ForeColor = 8355711
  End If
  Call CreateQry(18, Me!costCenterID, Abs(Me!ChkOpenedOrders), currentCostCenterID(), Abs(Me!ChkClosedOrders))
  Me!frmDoc_PurchaseOrdersSub.Requery
    
End Sub

Private Sub ChkOpenedOrders_AfterUpdate()
  
  If Me!ChkOpenedOrders Then
    Me!LabelChkOpened.ForeColor = 0
  Else
    Me!LabelChkOpened.ForeColor = 8355711
  End If
  Call CreateQry(18, Me!costCenterID, Abs(Me!ChkOpenedOrders), currentCostCenterID(), Abs(Me!ChkClosedOrders))
  Me!frmDoc_PurchaseOrdersSub.Requery

End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
Dim frm As Form

  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Restavracija ni izbrana!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDoc_PurchaseOrder", , , , acFormAdd
  
  Set frm = Forms!frmDoc_PurchaseOrder.Form
  frm!costCenterID.DefaultValue = Me!costCenterID
  'frm!purchaseOrderNumber.DefaultValue = NewDocumentNumber("tblDocGoods_PurchaseOrders", "purchaseOrderNumber", "N", currentFiscalYear(), Me!costCenterID, 0)
  If Not IsNull(Me!costCenterDepartmentID) Then
    frm!costCenterDepartmentID.DefaultValue = Me!costCenterDepartmentID
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub costCenterDepartmentID_AfterUpdate()
  Call cmdFilterOn
End Sub

Private Sub costCenterID_AfterUpdate()
  Call CreateQry(18, Me!costCenterID, Abs(Me!ChkOpenedOrders), currentCostCenterID(), Abs(Me!ChkClosedOrders))
  Me!frmDoc_PurchaseOrdersSub.Requery
  Me!costCenterDepartmentID.Requery
  Call CreateQry(136, Me!costCenterID)
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
  Call CreateQry(18, currentCostCenterID(), 1, currentCostCenterID(), 0)
  Call CloseForm(Me.Name)
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.Maximize
  
  Call CreateQry(18, currentCostCenterID(), 1, currentCostCenterID(), 0)
  Call CreateQry(136, currentCostCenterID())
  Me!frmDoc_PurchaseOrdersSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryDocGoods_PurchaseOrders"
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOn()
Dim frm As Form

  If IsNull(Me!costCenterDepartmentID) And IsNull(partnerID) Then
    Call cmdFilterOff_Click
    Exit Sub
  Else
    If IsNull(Me!costCenterDepartmentID) Then
      Me!strFilter = "PartnerID=" & Me!partnerID
    Else
      If Not IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
        Me!strFilter = "costCenterDepartmentID=" & Me!costCenterDepartmentID
        Me!strFilter = Me!strFilter & " And " & "partnerID=" & Me!partnerID
      Else
        Me!strFilter = "costCenterDepartmentID=" & Me!costCenterDepartmentID
      End If
    End If
  End If
  
  Set frm = Me!frmDoc_PurchaseOrdersSub.Form
  frm.Filter = Me!strFilter
  
  If Not frm.FilterOn = True Then frm.FilterOn = True

End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
Dim frm As Form

  Set frm = Me!frmDoc_PurchaseOrdersSub.Form
  Me!costCenterDepartmentID = Null
  Me!partnerID = Null
  Me!strFilter = Null
  
  If frm.FilterOn = True Then frm.FilterOn = False
  
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
  Call cmdFilterOn
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer

  Beep
  resp = MsgBox(" eli  brisati izbrano naro ilo?", vbCritical + vbYesNo, "Brisanje naro ila:")
  
  If resp = vbYes Then
    Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblDocGoods_PurchaseOrders WHERE purchaseOrderID=" & Me!purchaseOrderID)
    Me.Requery
    Beep
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
'On Error Resume Next
  Me!poID = Me!purchaseOrderID
  Forms!frmDoc_PurchaseOrders.Form!purchaseOrderID = Me!purchaseOrderID
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer
  
  If IsNull(Me!bpOrderAddressID) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  
  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati zapis?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp = vbYes Then
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdDeleteRecord
    DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
Dim frm As Form

  If DCount("*", "qryDoc_PurchaseOrder_ccDepartments") = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Vsi oddelki so  e dodani!"
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDoc_PurchaseOrder_BusinessPartnerNew", , , , acFormAdd
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub CmdRefresh_Click()
  Me.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer
  
  If IsNull(Me!bpOrderAddressID) Then
    Beep
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati zapis?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp = vbYes Then
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdDeleteRecord
    DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSave_Click()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form

  If IsNull(Me!costCenterDepartmentID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka oddelek! Zapisa ni mogo e shraniti!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  
  frmName = "frmDoc_purchaseOrder_businessPartner"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm.Requery
  End If

  
End Sub

Private Sub acceptedPackagingQty_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Me!acceptedPackagingQty = Me!orderedPackagingQty

Private Sub productID_AfterUpdate()
Dim txt
  txt = DLookup("purchasePackaging", "tblProdCat_Products", "productID=" & Me!productID)
  If Not IsNull(txt) Then
    Me!packaging = txt
  End If
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdCreatePaymentOrder_Click()
Dim btID As Long, poID
  
  btID = Me!businessTripID
  poID = DLookup("paymentOrderID", "tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders", "(parentID=" & btID & ") And (parentTableID=81)")
  
  If IsNull(poID) Then
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
    Me!businessTripTotal.Requery
    Call NewPOID(btID, 81, "OTHR", Me!businessTripNumber, LastDayInMonth(Me!EndDate, 0), Me!businessTripTotal, Me!employeeID.Column(0), _
                           Me!employeeID.Column(1), Me!employeeID.Column(2), Me!employeeID.Column(3), Me!employeeID.Column(4), Me!employeeID.Column(5), _
                           "SI00", "1", Me!creditGLAccountID, Me!businessTripNumber, btID)
    Beep
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccPmtPO_PaymentOrder", , , "paymentOrderID=" & poID, acFormEdit
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub cmdPosting_Click()
Dim btID As String, postID
  
  btID = Me!businessTripID
  postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "(parentID=" & btID & ") And (parentTableID=81)")
  
  If IsNull(postID) Then
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
    Call RunSQL("DELETE * FROM tblTempAccGLPostings")
    Me!businessTripTotal.Requery
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    If Me!prepayment <> 0 Then DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappEmpBusinessTripPosting_100")
    DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappEmpBusinessTripPosting_285")
    DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappEmpBusinessTripPosting_414")
    DoCmd.SetWarnings True
    Call CreatePosting(currentCompanyID)
    Beep
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & postID, acFormEdit
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpBusinessTrip", acViewReport, , "businessTripID=" & Me!businessTripID
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRefreshTotal_Click()
  Me!businessTripTotal.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdViewOriginal_Click()
  Call OpenScan(81, Me!businessTripID)
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
On Error Resume Next
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Forms!frmEmpBusinessTrips.Form, "businessTripID", Me!businessTripID)
End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
On Error Resume Next
Dim i

  If IsNull(Forms!frmEmpBusinessTrip.Form!businessTripID) Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izpolni glavo PN!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  i = DMax("sequence", "tblEmpBT_BusinessTripCosts", "businessTripID = " & (Forms!frmEmpBusinessTrip.Form!businessTripID))
  If IsNull(i) Then sequence = 1 Else sequence = i + 1
  
End Sub

Private Sub businessTripNumber_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpBusinessTrip", acNormal, , "businessTripID=" & Me!businessTripID, acFormEdit
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim resp As Integer

  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati potni nalog  t. " & Me!businessTripNumber & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  Call DeleteChild("tblAccGL_Postings", Me!businessTripID, 81)
  Call DeleteChild("tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders", Me!businessTripID, 81)
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblEmpBT_BusinessTrips WHERE businessTripID=" & Me!businessTripID)
  Me.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpBusinessTrip", acNormal, , , acFormAdd
End Sub

Private Sub dailyReportSub_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim tip As Double, strSQL As String
On Error GoTo err_exit

tip = InputBox("Napitnina:")

strSQL = "UPDATE tblEmpDR_dailyReportSubs SET tblEmpDR_dailyReportSubs.tip = " & Replace(tip, ",", ".") & _
         " WHERE tblEmpDR_dailyReportSubs.dailyReportSubID= " & Me!dailyReportSub
         
Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
Me!dailyReportSub.Requery
Exit Sub
err_exit:
MsgBox "Napaka pri vnosu!"


End Sub

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdNewAbsence_Click()

  If Me!employeeID = 0 Or IsNull(Me!employeeID) Then
    MsgBox "izberi delavca!", vbInformation
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpRpts_Absence", acFormDS
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub cmdPassword_Click()
  If Me!employeeID <> 0 Then
    Me!employeeID = 0
    Call RequeryEmployeeReports(Me)
  End If
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!employeeName.Column(0)) Then
    If IsNull(Me!employeeName.Column(2)) Or (Me!employeeName.Column(2) = "") Then
      MsgBox "Geslo ne obstaja!"
      Exit Sub
    End If
    
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpRpts_Password"
    Forms!frmEmpRpts_Password.Form.Caption = Me!employeeName.Column(1)
    
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub employeeName_AfterUpdate()
  Call cmdPassword_Click
End Sub

Private Sub fiscalMonth_AfterUpdate()
  Call RequeryEmployeeReports(Me)
End Sub

Private Sub fiscalYear_AfterUpdate()
  Call RequeryEmployeeReports(Me)
  Me!fiscalMonth.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub isActive_AfterUpdate()
  Me!employeeName.Requery
  Me!employeeID = 0
  Call RequeryEmployeeReports(Me)
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub firstDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim D1 As Date, D2 As Date

  D1 = DLookup("monthFirstDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID)
  D2 = DLookup("monthLastDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID)

  If Not ((Me!firstDate >= D1) And (Me!firstDate <= D2)) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Datum mora biti med " & D1 & " in " & D2 & "!", vbInformation
    Cancel = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
  Forms!frmEmpRpts!rptEmpRpts_Absence1.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub jobID_AfterUpdate()
Dim r
  Me!multiplier = Me!jobID.Column(3)
  Me!unitOfMeasure = Me!jobID.Column(4)
  
  If Me!jobID.Column(2) = 1 Then
    r = DLookup("reminderPrevious", "qryEmpTime_Absence_AnnualHolidays_AvailableToMonth", "employmentID=" & Me!employmentID)
    If IsNull(r) Then r = 0
    Me!holidayReminderPreviousYr = r
    r = DLookup("reminderCurrent", "qryEmpTime_Absence_AnnualHolidays_AvailableToMonth", "employmentID=" & Me!employmentID)
    If IsNull(r) Then r = 0
    Me!holidayReminderCurrentYr = r
  Else
    Me!holidayReminderPreviousYr = 0
    Me!holidayReminderCurrentYr = 0
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub lastDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim D1 As Date, D2 As Date

  D1 = DLookup("monthFirstDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID)
  D2 = DLookup("monthLastDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID)

  If Not ((Me!lastDate >= D1) And (Me!lastDate <= D2)) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Datum mora biti med " & D1 & " in " & D2 & "!", vbInformation
    Cancel = True
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub fiscalMonthID_AfterUpdate()
  If Not IsNull(Me!firstDate) Then Me!firstDate = Null
  If Not IsNull(Me!lastDate) Then Me!lastDate = Null
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Load()
  Me.Move 500, 500, Width:=20000, Height:=5000
End Sub

Private Sub jobID_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)

 If IsNull(Me!employmentID) Then
   Beep
   MsgBox ("Izberi delavca!")
   Cancel = True
 End If

End Sub

Option Compare Database

Private Sub cmdClose_Click()
  DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
  Me!qty = Null
End Sub

Private Sub Qty_AfterUpdate()
Dim frm As Form

  Set frm = Forms!frmEmpRpts.Form
  
  If CStr(qty) = CStr(frm!employeeName.Column(2)) Or qty = "271898" Then
    frm!employeeID = frm!employeeName.Column(0)
    Call RequeryEmployeeReports(frm)
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  Else
    MsgBox "Napa no geslo!"
  End If
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database

Private Sub cmdJobEnd_Click()
Dim strSQL As String

  If IsNull(Me!timeclockID) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblEmpTimeDailyTimeclock SET tblEmpTimeDailyTimeclock.jobEnd = Now() " & _
           "WHERE (((tblEmpTimeDailyTimeclock.dailyTimeclockID)= " & Me!timeclockID & "));"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  Me!lstPresent.Requery
  Me!lstNotPresent.Requery
  Me!lstPresent = Null
  Me!lstNotPresent.Value = Me!timeclockID
  Me!lstNotPresent.Value = Me!lstNotPresent.Column(0, 0)
  Me!cmdJobEnd.enabled = False
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNewTimetable_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpTimeclockJobStart_1", acNormal
  Forms!frmEmpTimeclockJobStart_1.Form!companyID = Me!cmpyCostCenterID.Column(2)
  Forms!frmEmpTimeclockJobStart_1.Form!employeeID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRemark_Click()
  If IsNull(Me!timeclockID) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpTimeclockRemark", acNormal
  Forms!frmEmpTimeclockRemark.Form!remark = Me!currentRemark
End Sub

Private Sub cmpyCostCenterID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!lstPresent.Requery
  Me!lstNotPresent.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  Me!cmpyCostCenterID.Value = DFirst("(cmpyCostCenterID)", "tblSetCurrentCostCenter", "isSelected = True")
  Me!cmpyCostCenterID.Value = Me!cmpyCostCenterID.Column(0)
  Me!lstPresent.Requery
  Me!lstNotPresent.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub lstNotPresent_AfterUpdate()

  Me!lstPresent = Null
  Me!timeclockID = Me!lstNotPresent.Column(0)
  Me!currentRemark = Me!lstNotPresent.Column(6)
  Me!cmdJobEnd.enabled = False
  Me!cmdRemark.enabled = True
  
End Sub

Private Sub lstPresent_AfterUpdate()

  Me!lstNotPresent = Null
  Me!timeclockID = Me!lstPresent.Column(0)
  Me!currentRemark = Me!lstPresent.Column(6)
  Me!cmdJobEnd.enabled = True
  Me!cmdRemark.enabled = True
  
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
'On Error Resume Next
  If CurrentProject.AllForms("frmEmpTimeclock").IsLoaded Then
    Me!costCenterID.Value = Forms!frmEmpTimeclock.Form!costCenterID
  Else
    Me!costCenterID.Value = Forms!frmCRHome.Form!costCenterID
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub jobID_Click()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim db As Database, rs As DAO.Recordset

  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Or Me!costCenterID = "" Then Beep: Exit Sub
  Set db = CurrentDb
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock")
  rs.AddNew
  rs("employeeID") = Me!employeeID
  rs("costCenterID") = Me!costCenterID
  rs("jobId") = Me!jobID.Column(0)
  rs("jobStart") = Now()
  rs("hourlyRate") = Me!jobID.Column(2)
  rs.Update
  rs.Close
  Set rs = Nothing
  Set db = Nothing
  
  If CurrentProject.AllForms("frmEmpTimeclock").IsLoaded = True Then
    Forms!frmEmpTimeclock.Form!lstPresent.Requery
  Else
    Forms!frmCRHome!frmCRHome_TimeClock.Requery
    Forms!frmCRHome!frmCRHome_Employees.Requery
  End If
  
  DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  Beep
  
End Sub

Option Compare Database

Private Sub cmdCancel_Click()
  DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSaveRemark_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, f As Form
  
  Set f = Forms.frmCRTimeClock.frmCRTimeClockSub.Form
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblEmpTimeDailyTimeclock SET tblEmpTimeDailyTimeclock.remark = '" & Me!remark & "' WHERE (((tblEmpTimeDailyTimeclock.dailyTimeclockID)= " & (f!dailyTimeclockID) & "));"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  f!remark.Requery
  DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  Beep
  
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdDeleteTimetable_Click()
Dim odg As Integer, strSQL As String

  Beep
  odg = MsgBox("Ali resni no  lei  brisati urnik za obdobje " & Me!timetableID1.Column(1) & "?", vbYesNo)
  If odg <> 6 Then Exit Sub
  

  strSQL = "DELETE *, timetableID FROM tblEmpTime_Timetables WHERE timetableID=" & Me!timetableID1 & ";"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  Me!timetableID1.Requery
  Me.Requery
  Me!StartDate = DMax("startDate", "tblEmpTime_Timetables", "(costCenterID) = " & (costCenterID)) + 7
  Call cmdRefreshH_Click
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNewTimetable_Click()
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset, ttID As Long
  
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Then Beep: MsgBox "Stro kovno mesto ni izbrano!": Exit Sub
  If IsNull(Me!StartDate) Then Beep: MsgBox "Vpi i za etni datum!": Me!StartDate.BorderStyle = 1: Me!StartDate.SetFocus: Exit Sub Else Me!StartDate.BorderStyle = 0
  
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblEmpTime_Timetables", dbOpenDynaset, dbSeeChanges)
  rs.AddNew
  rs("costCenterID") = Me!costCenterID
  rs("startDate") = Me!StartDate
  rs.Update
  rs.Bookmark = rs.LastModified
  ttID = rs("timetableID")

  Me!StartDate = Me!StartDate + 7
  Me!timetableID1.Requery
  Me!timetableID1 = ttID
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qaddEmpTimetableSub"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True

  Me!departmentGroupID1 = Null
  Me.FilterOn = False
  Me.RecordSource = "qryEmpTimetable"
  Beep
  
  Call cmdRefreshH_Click
    
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrintTimetable_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpTimetable", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrintWishlist_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpTimetableWishlist", acNormal, , , , acDialog
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRefreshH_Click()
  If IsNull(Me!timetableID1.Column(2)) Then Beep: Exit Sub
  Call CreateQry(43, Month(Me!timetableID1.Column(2)), Year(Me!timetableID1.Column(2)))
  Call RunSQL("DELETE tblEmpTime_TimetableH.* FROM tblEmpTime_TimetableH;")
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappEmpTime_TimetableH1"
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappEmpTime_TimetableH2"
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappEmpTime_TimetableH3"
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappEmpTime_TimetableH4"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  Call RunSQL("DELETE tblEmpTime_TimetableH.* FROM tblEmpTime_TimetableH WHERE delete=1;")
  Me.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub costCenterID_AfterUpdate()
  
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Then Me!StartDate = Null: Exit Sub
  Me!StartDate = DMax("startDate", "tblEmpTime_Timetables", "(costCenterID) = " & (costCenterID)) + 7
  If IsNull(Me!StartDate) Then Beep: MsgBox "Manjka prvi dan naslednjega obdobja!": Me!StartDate.BorderStyle = 1: Me!StartDate.SetFocus Else Me!StartDate.BorderStyle = 0

End Sub

Private Sub departmentGroupID1_AfterUpdate()
  If IsNull(Me!departmentGroupID1) Then
    Me.FilterOn = False
  Else
    Me.Filter = "departmentGroupID = " & Me!departmentGroupID1
    If Not Me.FilterOn = True Then Me.FilterOn = True
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
    Call CloseForm(Me.Name)
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  Call RunSQL("DELETE tblEmpTime_TimetableH.* FROM tblEmpTime_TimetableH;")
End Sub

Private Sub timetableID1_AfterUpdate()
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Call cmdRefreshH_Click
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrintWishlist_Click()
Dim sd As Date
    
    sd = Me!start_date
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
    DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpTimetableWishlist", acViewReport
    Reports!rptEmpTimetableWishlist.Report!start_date = sd

End Sub

  Me!start_date = Forms!frmEmpTimetable.Form!StartDate

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub absenceEarningRate_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strWhere As String

  If IsNull(Me!employmentID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka delavec!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!appliesToYear) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka leto na katero se nana a postavka!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!jobID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka vrsta odsotnosti!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  strWhere = "AND yr=" & Me!appliesToYear & " AND employmentID=" & Me!employmentID.Column(0) & " AND wageCalculationTypeID=" & Me!employmentID.Column(2)
  
  If Me!jobID.Column(2) = 1 Then   'DOPUST
    Me!absenceEarningRate = DLookup("hRate", "qryEmpWC_Absence_HourlyRate", "rateType='holidayRate' " & strWhere)
  Else                              'BOLNI KA
    Me!absenceEarningRate = Round(Me!jobID.Column(3) * DLookup("hRate", "qryEmpWC_Absence_HourlyRate", "rateType='sickRate' " & strWhere), 2)
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub appliesToYear_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
  If (Me!appliesToYear = currentFiscalYear()) Or (Me!appliesToYear = currentFiscalYear() - 1) Then Exit Sub
  Beep
  MsgBox "Leto osnove je napa no!", vbInformation
  Cancel = True
End Sub

Private Sub costCenterID_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)

 If IsNull(Me!employmentID) Then
   Beep
   MsgBox ("Izberi delavca oz. zaposlitev!")
   Cancel = True
 End If
 
End Sub

Private Sub firstDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim D1 As Date, D2 As Date

  D1 = DLookup("monthFirstDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID)
  D2 = DLookup("monthLastDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID)

  If Not ((Me!firstDate >= D1) And (Me!firstDate <= D2)) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Datum mora biti med " & D1 & " in " & D2 & "!", vbInformation
    Cancel = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Load()
  Me.Move 500, 500, Width:=25000, Height:=12000
End Sub

Private Sub jobID_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)

 If IsNull(Me!employmentID) Then
   Beep
   MsgBox ("Izberi delavca!")
   Cancel = True
 End If

End Sub

Private Sub jobID_AfterUpdate()
Dim r
  Me!multiplier = Me!jobID.Column(3)
  Me!unitOfMeasure = Me!jobID.Column(4)
  
  If Me!jobID.Column(2) = 1 Then
    r = DLookup("leftPY", "qryEmpTime_Absence_AnnualHolidays_AvailableToMonth", "employmentID=" & Me!employmentID)
    If IsNull(r) Then r = 0
    Me!holidayReminderPreviousYr = r
    r = DLookup("leftCY", "qryEmpTime_Absence_AnnualHolidays_AvailableToMonth", "employmentID=" & Me!employmentID)
    If IsNull(r) Then r = 0
    Me!holidayReminderCurrentYr = r
  Else
    Me!holidayReminderPreviousYr = 0
    Me!holidayReminderCurrentYr = 0
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub lastDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim D1 As Date, D2 As Date

  D1 = DLookup("monthFirstDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID)
  D2 = DLookup("monthLastDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID)

  If Not ((Me!lastDate >= D1) And (Me!lastDate <= D2)) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Datum mora biti med " & D1 & " in " & D2 & "!", vbInformation
    Cancel = True
  End If

End Sub
