CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdAnnualHolidaysAdd_Click()
Dim resp As Integer
    
  If IsNull(Me!companyID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Podjetje ni izbrano!")
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!fiscalYear) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Leto ni izbrano!")
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!employmentType) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Vrsta zaposlitve ni izbrana!")
    Exit Sub
  End If
    
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappEmpTime_AnnualHolidays_Add"
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappEmpTime_AnnualHolidays_AddDetails"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  
  Call CmdRequery_Click
  
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp  As Integer, strSQL As String

  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Ali naj bri em delavca " & Me!frmEmpTime_AnnualHolidays_Summary.Form!empName & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If Not resp = vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  strSQL = "DELETE *, annualHolidayID " & _
           "FROM tblEmpTime_AnnualHolidays " & _
           "WHERE (annualHolidayID)=" & (Me!annualHolidayID) & ";"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  Call CmdRequery_Click
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
Dim strWhere As String
  
  strWhere = "companyID=" & Me!companyID & " And fiscalYear=" & Me!fiscalYear & " And employmentType='" & Me!employmentType & "'"
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpTime_AnnualHolidays_Summary", acViewPreview, , strWhere

End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
  'Me!annualHolidayID = Me!frmEmpTime_AnnualHolidays_Summary.Form!annualHolidayID
  If IsNull(Me!annualHolidayID) Then
    Me!frmEmpTime_AnnualHolidays_Summary.Form.Requery
  Else
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpTime_AnnualHolidays_Summary.Form, "annualHolidayID", Me!annualHolidayID)
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub companyID_AfterUpdate()
  Call CmdRequery_Click
End Sub

Private Sub employmentType_AfterUpdate()
  Call CmdRequery_Click
End Sub

Private Sub fiscalYear_AfterUpdate()
  Call CmdRequery_Click
End Sub

Private Sub cmdAddNew_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpTime_DailyPresenceNew", acNormal, , , acFormAdd
End Sub

Private Sub CmdFilter_Click()

  If IsNull(Me!m1) Or IsNull(Me!m2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi Mesec!", vbInformation
    Call CreateQry(103, 0, 0, , , " AND 1 = 3")
  Else
    If IsNull(Me!employeeID) Then
      Call CreateQry(103, Me!m1, Me!m2, , , " AND 1 = 1")
    Else
      Call CreateQry(103, Me!m1, Me!m2, , , " AND employeeName Like '" & Left(Me!employeeID.Column(2), Len(Me!employeeID.Column(2)) - 8) & "*'")
    End If
  End If
  Me!frmEmpTime_DailyPresenceSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpTime_DailyPresence"
  
End Sub
Private Sub cmdFilterErrors_Click()

  Call MarkErrors
  
  If IsNull(Me!m1) Or IsNull(Me!m2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi mesec 1 in mesec 2!", vbInformation
    Call CreateQry(103, 0, 0, , , " AND 1 = 3")
  Else
    If IsNull(Me!employeeID) Then
      Call CreateQry(103, Me!m1, Me!m2, , , " AND Not Isnull(autoRemark)")
    Else
      Call CreateQry(103, Me!m1, Me!m2, , , " AND Not Isnull(autoRemark) AND employeeName Like '" & Left(Me!employeeID.Column(2), Len(Me!employeeID.Column(2)) - 8) & "*'")
    End If
  End If
  Me!frmEmpTime_DailyPresenceSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpTime_DailyPresence"
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterErrorsUnchecked_Click()
Dim frm As Form

  Set frm = Forms!frmEmpTime_DailyPresence!frmEmpTime_DailyPresenceSub.Form
  frm.Filter = "(Not IsNull(autoRemark)) AND (manuallyChecked=0)"
  frm.FilterOn = True
  Call MarkErrors
  
  If IsNull(Me!m1) Or IsNull(Me!m2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi mesec 1 in mesec 2!", vbInformation
    Call CreateQry(103, 0, 0, , , " AND 1 = 3")
  Else
    If IsNull(Me!employeeID) Then
      Call CreateQry(103, Me!m1, Me!m2, , , " AND (Not IsNull(autoRemark)) AND (manuallyChecked=0)")
    Else
      Call CreateQry(103, Me!m1, Me!m2, , , " AND (Not IsNull(autoRemark)) AND (manuallyChecked=0) AND employeeName Like '" & Left(Me!employeeID.Column(2), Len(Me!employeeID.Column(2)) - 8) & "*'")
    End If
  End If
  Me!frmEmpTime_DailyPresenceSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpTime_DailyPresence"
  
End Sub

Private Sub MarkErrors()

  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock WHERE jobStart Is Null;")

  Call CreateQry(173)
  Call RunMySQL
  Call RunMySQL("UPDATE tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock SET autoRemark = NULL WHERE (autoRemark='');")
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdClearFilter_Click()
  
  Me!m1 = Month(Now())
  Me!m2 = Month(Now())
  
  Me!employeeID = Null
  Call CreateQry(103, 0, 0, , , " AND 1 = 3")
  Me!frmEmpTime_DailyPresenceSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpTime_DailyPresence"
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
Dim Yr As Integer
  
  If IsNull(Me!m1) Or IsNull(Me!m2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi mesec 1 in mesec 2!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!reportID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi poro ilo!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Yr = currentFiscalYear()
  Call CreateQry1(174, Yr, Me!m1, Me!m2)
  Call CreateQry1(239, Yr, Me!m1, Me!m2)
  
  If IsNull(Me!employeeID) Then
    DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpTime_DailyPresence_" & Me!reportID, acViewReport
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpTime_DailyPresence_" & Me!reportID, acViewReport, , "partnerID=" & (Me!employeeID)
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub cmdDoubleEntries_Click()

  Call RunSQL("DELETE * FROM tblTempEmp_TimeclockDoubled;")
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappEmpTime_TimeclockDoubled_1")
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpTime_TimeclockDoubled", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub autoChecked_AfterUpdate()
  Me!autoChecked = Abs(Me!autoChecked)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdEmployee_Click()
  If IsNull(Me!employmentID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Delavec ni izbran.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmp_Employee", , , "partnerID = " & Me!employmentID.Column(0), acFormEdit
End Sub

Private Sub deletedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If IsNull(Me!deletedAt) Then Me!deletedAt = Now() Else Me!deletedAt = Null
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
  If IsNull(Me!dailyTimeclockID) Then Exit Sub
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Call CreateQry(102, Me!dailyTimeclockID)
  Call RunMySQL
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Forms!frmEmpTime_DailyPresence!frmEmpTime_DailyPresenceSub.Form, "dailyTimeclockID", Me!dailyTimeclockID)
End Sub

Private Sub jobEnd_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Me!jobEnd = Now()
End Sub

Private Sub jobStart_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Me!jobStart = Now()
End Sub

Private Sub manuallyChecked_AfterUpdate()
  Me!manuallyChecked = Abs(Me!manuallyChecked)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdAddMissingEmployees_Click()
Dim pmt01 As Long, pmt02 As Long, pmt03 As String, pmt04 As String
  
  If fwcWcID() = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Napaka! Obra un ne obstaja!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  pmt01 = fwcMnthID()
  pmt02 = currentCompanyGroupID()
  pmt03 = SQLDate(DLookup("monthFirstDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & pmt01))
  pmt04 = SQLDate(DLookup("monthLastDate", "tblAccFP_FiscalMonths", "fiscalMonthID=" & pmt01))

  Call CreateQry1(311, pmt01, pmt02, pmt03, pmt04)          'doda zaposlene (employeeID) v wageCalcSubID
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry1(312, pmt01, pmt02, pmt03, pmt04)          'doda zaposlitve (employmentID) v wageCalcSubSubID
  Call RunMySQL

  Call CreateQry1(317, pmt01, pmt02)                        'spremeni  t. delovnih ur v mesecu v wageCalcSubID glede na za etek/konec zaposlitve
  Call RunMySQL

  Beep
  
  Call CmdRefresh_Click

End Sub


Private Sub cmdCreateREKa_Year_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, rs As Recordset, payrolCalcID As Long
  
  strSQL = "SELECT tblEmpWC_Payouts_PayrollCalculations.payrollCalculationID " & _
           "FROM (tblEmpWC_WageCalculations INNER JOIN tblAccFP_FiscalMonths ON tblEmpWC_WageCalculations.fiscalMonthID = tblAccFP_FiscalMonths.fiscalMonthID) INNER JOIN tblEmpWC_Payouts_PayrollCalculations ON tblEmpWC_WageCalculations.wageCalculationID = tblEmpWC_Payouts_PayrollCalculations.wageCalculationID " & _
           "WHERE (tblEmpWC_Payouts_PayrollCalculations.wageTypeID=4) AND (tblAccFP_FiscalMonths.fiscalYear=currentFiscalYear()) AND (tblEmpWC_WageCalculations.companyID=" & Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form!companyID & ");"
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
  
  If rs.RecordCount = 0 Then
    MsgBox "No record!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.Hourglass True

  rs.MoveFirst
  Call RunSQL("DELETE tblTempEmpWC_REK1a.* FROM tblTempEmpWC_REK1a;")
  
  Do While Not rs.EOF
    payrolCalcID = rs("payrollCalculationID")
    Call CreateQry(184, , , , , payrolCalcID)
    Call CreateQry(185, , , , , payrolCalcID)
    Call CreateQry(186, , , , , payrolCalcID)
    Call CreateQry1(241, payrolCalcID)
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappEmpWC_REK1a"
    rs.MoveNext
  Loop
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  DoCmd.Hourglass False
  Beep
  DoCmd.OpenTable "tblTempEmpWC_REK1a"
End Sub

Private Sub CmdHoursCalc_Click()
Dim i As Integer

  i = DCount("dailyTimeclockID", "tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock", "(Year(jobStart)=" & Me!fiscalYear & ") AND (Month(jobStart)=" & Me!fiscalMonth & ") AND (jobEnd1 Is Null) AND (deletedAt Is Null)")
  
  If i <> 0 Then
    i = MsgBox("jobEnd1 ne obstaja. Izra unaj ga?", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  i = DCount("*", "tblEmpWC_wcHours", "(Year(jobStart)=" & Me!fiscalYear & ") AND (Month(jobStart)=" & Me!fiscalMonth & ")")
  
  If i <> 0 Then
    i = MsgBox("Podatki  e obstajajo. Ali jih naj pobri em in dodam nove?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If i <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call wcHours
  
  MsgBox "Konec."
End Sub

Private Sub cmdJobEnd1_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, i As Integer


  i = DCount("dailyTimeclockID", "tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock", "(Year(jobStart)=" & Me!fiscalYear & ") AND (Month(jobStart)=" & Me!fiscalMonth & ") AND (jobEnd1 Is Not Null) AND (deletedAt Is Null)")
  
  If i <> 0 Then
    i = MsgBox("jobEnd1  e obstaja. Ali ga ponovno izra unam?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If i <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call RunMySQL("DROP VIEW  IF EXISTS qryEmpWC_jobEnd1sub;")
  Call RunMySQL("DROP VIEW  IF EXISTS qryEmpWC_jobEnd1;")
  Call CreateQry(182, , , , , Me!fiscalMonth, Me!fiscalYear)
  RunMySQL
  Call CreateQry(183, , , , , Me!fiscalMonth, Me!fiscalYear)
  RunMySQL
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock SET tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock.jobEnd1=  " & _
           "(select qryEmpWC_jobEnd1.jobEndNew from qryEmpWC_jobEnd1 where qryEmpWC_jobEnd1.dailyTimeclockID=tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock.dailyTimeclockID)"
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub fiscalMonthID_AfterUpdate()
Dim pmt01 As Long, pmt02 As Long, pmt03 As String, pmt04 As String

  If IsNull(Me!fiscalMonthID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Mesec ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
      
    Me!fiscalMonth = Month(Me!fiscalMonthID.Column(2))
    Me!fiscalYear = Year(Me!fiscalMonthID.Column(2))
    Me!monthFirstDate = Me!fiscalMonthID.Column(2)
    
    pmt01 = fwcMnthID()
    pmt02 = currentCompanyGroupID()
    pmt03 = SQLDate(Me!monthFirstDate)
    pmt04 = SQLDate(LastDayInMonth(Me!monthFirstDate, 0))
    Call CreateQry1(51, pmt01, pmt02, pmt03, pmt04)                                         'qryEmpWC_WageCalculations
    Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpWC_WageCalculations"
    
    If DCount("*", "qryEmpWC_WageCalculations") = 0 Then
      Call CreateQry1(52, 0)                                                                'qryEmpWC_PayrollCalculations"
      Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpWC_PayrollCalculations"
      Call CreateQry1(74, 0)                                                                'qryEmpWC_Sub
      Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpWC_Sub"
    End If
    
    Call CreateQry1(314, pmt01, pmt02)                                    'qryEmpWC_EmployeesAllActive dropdown v absence+earnings
    Call CreateQry1(313, pmt01, pmt02, Me!fiscalYear, Me!fiscalMonth)     'postavke za absence qryEmpWC_Absence_HourlyRate
    Call CreateQry1(144, Me!fiscalYear, Me!fiscalMonth)                   'preostanek dopusta qryEmpTime_Absence_AnnualHolidays_AvailableToMonth
    Call CreateQry(147, Me!fiscalMonth)                                   'odpis preko blagajne
      
'  If Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form.Recordset.RecordCount = 0 Then
'    Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.visible = False
'    Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.visible = False
'    Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.visible = False
'  Else
'    Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.visible = True
'    Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.visible = True
'    Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpWC_PayrollCalculations"
'    Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.visible = True
'  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdWageCalculationsAdd_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, resp As Integer
  
  If IsNull(Me!fiscalMonthID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Mesec ni izbran!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If DCount("wageCalculationID", "tblEmpWC_WageCalculations", "(companyID=" & currentCompanyID & ") AND (fiscalMonthID=" & Me!fiscalMonthID & ")") <> 0 Then
    resp = MsgBox("Obra un izbrani mesec  e obstaja. Ali naredim  e enega?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call AddCmpyGrpWageCalculation
  Call fiscalMonthID_AfterUpdate
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCommissionAdd_Click()
Dim strSQL As String

  If Me!isLocked Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Obra un pla  je zaklenjen! Spreminjanje podatkov ni mogo e.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  strSQL = "DELETE tblEmpWC_Earnings.* FROM tblEmpWC_Earnings INNER JOIN tblEmpWC_WageCalculationSubs ON tblEmpWC_Earnings.wageCalculationSubID = tblEmpWC_WageCalculationSubs.wageCalculationSubID " & _
           "WHERE tblEmpWC_Earnings.jobID = 2 AND tblEmpWC_WageCalculationSubs.wageCalculationID = " & Me!wageCalculationID
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  Call CreateQry1(271, Me!wageCalculationID)
  Call RunMySQL
  Beep
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form, "wageCalculationSubID", Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form!wageCalculationSubID)
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdAbsence_Click()
Dim frm As Form

  If IsNull(Me!fiscalMonthID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi mesec!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
    
  If Me!isLocked = True Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Obra un pla  je zaklenjen! Spreminjanje podatkov ni mogo e.", vbInformation
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpTime_Absence", acFormDS, , "(fiscalMonthID)=" & (Me!fiscalMonthID), acFormReadOnly
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpTime_Absence", acFormDS, , "(fiscalMonthID)=" & (Me!fiscalMonthID)
  End If
  
  Set frm = Forms!frmEmpTime_Absence.Form
  frm.Caption = "Bolni ke, dopusti, ... za mesec " & Me!fiscalMonthID.Column(1)
  frm!fiscalMonthID.DefaultValue = Me!fiscalMonthID

  frm!holidayReminderPreviousYr.ColumnHidden = False
  frm!holidayReminderCurrentYr.ColumnHidden = False

Private Sub cmdMonthlyEarningsAdd_Click()

  If IsNull(Me!wageCalculationID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi obra un pla e oz. podjetje!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
    
  If Me!isLocked Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Obra un pla  je zaklenjen! Spreminjanje podatkov ni mogo e.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form!noOfEarningEmp) Then
    Call EmployeeMonthlyEarnings(False, Me!wageCalculationID, Month(Me!fiscalMonthID.Column(2)))
  Else
    Call EmployeeMonthlyEarnings(True, Me!wageCalculationID, Month(Me!fiscalMonthID.Column(2)))
  End If
 
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form, "wageCalculationID", Me!wageCalculationID)
  
  Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form.Detail.visible = True
  Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpWC_Sub"
   
End Sub

Private Sub cmdMonthlyEarningsEdit_Click()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form, resp As Integer
  If IsNull(Me!wageCalculationID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi podjetje / obra un pla e!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call CreateQry(72, Me!wageCalculationID)
  frmName = "frmEmpWC_Earnings"
  
  If Me!isLocked Then
    resp = MsgBox("Obra un je zaklenjen. Ali naj vseeno omogo im spreminjanje zaslu kov?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp = vbYes Then
      DoCmd.OpenForm frmName, acFormDS, , "wageCalculationID=" & Me!wageCalculationID
    Else
      DoCmd.OpenForm frmName, acFormDS, , "wageCalculationID=" & Me!wageCalculationID, acFormReadOnly
      Forms(frmName).Caption = "Obra un pla  je zaklenjen! Spreminjanje podatkov ni mogo e."
    End If
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm frmName, acFormDS, , "wageCalculationID=" & Me!wageCalculationID
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPayrollEarningsAdd_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, frm As Form, isHA As Integer, txt As String, strSQL As String, i
  
  If Me!isLocked Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Obra un pla  je zaklenjen! Spreminjanje podatkov ni mogo e.", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set frm = Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form
  
  If IsNull(frm!payrollCalculationID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Vrsta izpla ila (pla a oz. regres) ni izbrana!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  i = DCount("*", "tblEmpWC_wcHours", "(Year(jobStart)=" & Me!fiscalYear & ") AND (Month(jobStart)=" & Me!fiscalMonth & ")")
  
  If i = 0 Then
    i = MsgBox("Ure za obra un ne obstajajo. Pripravi ure za obra un.", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If frm!isHolidayAllowance = 1 Then txt = "regres" Else txt = "pla o"
  
  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izra unati postavke za " & txt & " za mesec " & Me!fiscalMonthID.Column(1) & " (morebitni obstoje i podatki bodo pri tem izbrisani)?", vbYesNo + vbCritical)
   
  If resp = vbYes Then
    Call PayrollEarnings(Me, frm!payrollCalculationID, frm!isHolidayAllowance)
    Beep
  End If
  
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form, "payrollCalculationID", Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form!payrollCalculationID)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form, "wageCalculationSubID", Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form!wageCalculationSubID)

  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCalcPayrollTaxes_Click()
Dim frm As Form, resp As Integer

  Beep
 
  If Me!isLocked Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Obra un pla  je zaklenjen! Spreminjanje podatkov ni mogo e.", vbInformation)

  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  obra unati davke in prispevke postavke za pla o oz. regres za mesec " & Me!fiscalMonthID.Column(1) & " (morebitni obstoje i podatki bodo pri tem izbrisani)?", vbYesNo + vbCritical)

Private Sub cmdCreatePaymentOrders_Click()

Private Sub CmdCreatePosting_Click()
Dim strWhere, postingID, resp As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!wageCalculationID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Izberi obra un!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Not Me!isLocked Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Obra un mora biti kon an (zaklenjen) pred knji enjem!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
    
  postingID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "parentTableID=102 And parentID=" & Me!wageCalculationID)
  
  If Not IsNull(postingID) Then
    If currentCompanyID() = Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form!companyID Then
      DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & postingID
    Else
      Beep
      resp = MsgBox("Temeljnica obstaja, vendar je ne morem odpreti, ker je aktivno drugo podjetje!", vbInformation)
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.Hourglass True

  Call RunSQL("DELETE * FROM tblTempAccGLPostings;")
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappEmpWC_Posting_Credit")
  DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappEmpWC_Posting_DebitEmployerTaxes")
  DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappEmpWC_Posting_DebitGrossWage")
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  
  Call CreatePosting(Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form!companyID)
 
  DoCmd.Hourglass False
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form, "wageCalculationID", Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form!wageCalculationID)

  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRefresh_Click()
Dim id1 As Long, id2 As Long

  If Not hasValue(Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form!payrollCalculationID) Then
    Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpWC_PayrollCalculations"
  End If
  
  id1 = Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form!payrollCalculationID
  id2 = Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form!wageCalculationSubID

  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form, "wageCalculationID", Me!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form!wageCalculationID)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form, "payrollCalculationID", id1)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form, "wageCalculationSubID", id2)

End Sub

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub Form_Current()
  Forms!frmEmpWC_Edit.Form!wageCalculationID = Me!wageCalculationID
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Delete(Cancel As Integer)

  If Date - CDate(Me!createdAt) > 3 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Brisanje ni mogo e."
    Cancel = True
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Obra un je zaklenjen. Brisanje ni mogo e."
    Cancel = True
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub lockedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  If IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then Me!lockedAt = Now Else Me!lockedAt = Null
End Sub

Private Sub sumWageHAforTaxBase_AfterUpdate()
  Me!sumWageHAforTaxBase = Abs(Me!sumWageHAforTaxBase)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeleteEmployee_Click()
Dim f As Form, odg As Integer, rs As DAO.Recordset

  Set f = Me!frmEmpWC_EmployeesSub.Form
  Beep
  odg = MsgBox("Ali  eli  brisati delavca: (" & f!ln & ") - " & f!secondName & " " & f!firstName & "?", vbYesNo)
  If odg <> 6 Then Exit Sub

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblPtr_Partners", dbOpenDynaset)
  rs.FindFirst "(employeeID) = " & (f!employeeID)
  rs.delete
  rs.Close
  
  f.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNewEmployee_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmp_Employee", , , , acFormAdd
  Forms!frmEmpEmployee.Form.Caption = "(novi delavec)"
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRefresh_Click()
  Me!frmEmpWC_EmployeesSub.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub CmdWageData_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpWC_EmployeesWageData", acFormDS, , "companyID=" & fwcCmpyID()
End Sub

Private Sub wcGoalHA_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim netDecrease As Double
  
  netDecrease = InputBox("Neto zni anje pla e:")
  Me!wcGoalHA = Me!wcGoalHA - Round(netDecrease / 0.84, 2)
End Sub

Private Sub wcGoalWage_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim netDecrease As Double
  
  netDecrease = InputBox("Neto zni anje pla e:")
  Me!wcGoalWage = Me!wcGoalWage - Round(netDecrease / 0.679, 2)
  
End Sub

Private Sub payoutAmount_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Forms!frmEmpWC!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form, "wageCalculationSubID", Me!wageCalculationSubID)
  If Me!payoutAmount = 0 Then
    Me!payoutAmount = IIf(IsNull(Forms!frmEmpWC!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form!Difference), 0, Round(Forms!frmEmpWC!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form!Difference, 2))
  Else
    Me!payoutAmount = 0
  End If
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Forms!frmEmpWC!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form, "wageCalculationSubID", Me!wageCalculationSubID)
End Sub

Private Sub postingSubID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!channelPartnerID = Me!postingSubID.Column(2)
  Me!payoutAmount = Me!postingSubID.Column(3)
  Me!otherPayoutDescription = Me!postingSubID.Column(1)
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Me!postingSubID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub postingSubID_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer
  If Me!postingSubID.Column(4) <> "" Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Podatek je  e bil dodan na pla ilno listo " & Me!postingSubID.Column(4) & ". Naj ga dodam  e enkrat?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then
      Cancel = True
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub earningRate_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frm As Form

  Set frm = Forms!frmEmpWageCalc!frmEmpWagePayouts.Form
  Me!earningRate = Round((Me!total + frm!Difference) / (earningQty * multiplier), 4)
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "wagePayoutID", (frm!wagePayoutID))
  Forms!frmEmpWageCalc!frmEmpWagePayoutsWages.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub payrollCalculationID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strSQL As String

  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblEmpWC_Payouts_PayrollEarnings ( payrollID, wageTypeSubSubID ) " & _
           "SELECT tblEmpWC_Payouts_PayrollEarnings.payrollID, tblEmpWC_Payouts_PayrollEarnings.wageTypeSubSubID " & _
           "FROM tblEmpWC_Payouts_PayrollEarnings " & _
           "WHERE payrollEarningID=" & Me!payrollEarningID & ";"

  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Me.Requery
  
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdEMailPayrolls_Click()
Dim frm As Form, frm1 As Form, strSQL As String, varItem As Variant, attachmentFile As String, Subject As String, eMailBody As String
  
  Set frm = Forms!frmEmpWC.Form
  Set frm1 = frm!frmEmpWC_WageCalculations.Form

  
  If IsNull(Me!eMailID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi e-mail!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Subject = Me!Subject
  eMailBody = Me!Hello & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
  eMailBody = eMailBody & Me!Body & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
  eMailBody = eMailBody & Me!Goodbye & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
  eMailBody = eMailBody & Me!Author
  
  For Each varItem In Me!employeeID.ItemsSelected
  
    Me!status = "Priprava pla ilne liste za: " & Me!employeeID.Column(2, varItem) & " ..."
    
    If Me!employeeID.Column(2, varItem) = "" Then GoTo nextEmployee
    If InStr(Me!employeeID.Column(2, varItem), "@") = 0 Then GoTo nextEmployee
    
    If Me!rptName = "rptEmpWC_Payrolls" Then
      
      Call CreateQry(139, Me!employeeID.Column(0, varItem))
      Call CreateQry(140, Me!employeeID.Column(0, varItem))

Private Sub CmdSaveEmailAddress_Click()

  If IsNull(Me!employeeID.Column(2)) Then
    Beep

  End If

  Me!employeeID.Requery
  Me!employeeID.Value = empID
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdTaxEmployer_Click()

  Beep
  Exit Sub
End If

End Sub

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim resp As Integer, ID As Long, id1 As Long

  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  brisati delavca " & Me!employeeName & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  ID = Me!wageCalculationSubID
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblEmpWC_WageCalculationSubs WHERE wageCalculationSubID=" & ID & ";")
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdRecordsGoToPrevious
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "wageCalculationSubID", Me!wageCalculationSubID)
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdOK_Click()
Dim i As Integer

  If Me!isOK = 1 Then i = 0 Else i = 1
  Call RunMySQL("UPDATE tblEmpWC_WageCalculationSubs SET isOK = " & i & " WHERE wageCalculationSubID=" & Me!wageCalculationSubID & ";")
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "wageCalculationSubID", Me!wageCalculationSubID)
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRecordSelectors_AfterUpdate()
  Me.RecordSelectors = Me!CmdRecordSelectors
End Sub

Private Sub cmdStartBalance_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpWC_DeferedPaymentsStartBalance"
End Sub

Private Sub employeeName_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmp_Employee", , , "partnerID=" & Me!employeeID
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
Dim frm As Form, WC_id As Long

  Set frm = Forms!frmEmpWC.Form
  
  If IsNull(Me!wageCalculationID) Then
    WC_id = 0
  Else
    WC_id = Me!wageCalculationID
  End If
  
  Call CreateQry1(52, WC_id)                   'qryEmpWC_PayrollCalculations"
  frm!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpWC_PayrollCalculations"
  Call CreateQry1(74, WC_id)              'qryEmpWC_Sub
  frm!frmEmpWC_Sub.Form.RecordSource = "qryEmpWC_Sub"
    
  Me!wcID = Me!wageCalculationID
  If IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    frm!isLocked = False
  Else
    frm!isLocked = True
  End If
    
  'If frm!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.visible = False Then frm!frmEmpWC_PayrollCalculations.visible = True


End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim strSQL As String, frmName As String, frm As Form
  
  
  
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then Exit Sub
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblPtr_PartnersCmpys SET lockedAt=Now() WHERE IsNull(lockedAt) AND partnerID=" & Me!partnerID
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  Call CreateQry(100)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  frmName = "frmEmp_Employees"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm!frmEmp_EmployeesSub.Form, "employeeID", Me!partnerID)
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  If IsNull(Me!secondName) Then Me.Caption = "(novi delavec)" Else Me.Caption = Me!secondName & " " & Me!firstName
  Me!firstName.SetFocus
      
  If Me!usesTimeclock = 0 Then
      Me!frmEmp_EmployeeCostCenterSalaryShares.visible = True
      Me!monthlyEarning.visible = True
      Me!frmEmp_EmployeeWageRates.visible = False
  Else
      Me!frmEmp_EmployeeCostCenterSalaryShares.visible = False
      Me!monthlyEarning.visible = False
      Me!frmEmp_EmployeeWageRates.visible = True
  End If
    
  If Me!usesPublicTransport = 0 Then
      Me!monthlyPublicTransportPrice.enabled = False
      Me!dailyPublicTransportPrice.enabled = False
      Me!distance.enabled = True
  Else
      Me!monthlyPublicTransportPrice.enabled = True
      Me!dailyPublicTransportPrice.enabled = True
      Me!distance.enabled = False
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer, i As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then Exit Sub
  
  i = DCount("*", "tblPtr_PartnersCmpys", "(isEmployee=1) And (isActive=1) And partnerID=" & Me!partnerID)
  
  Select Case i
  Case 0
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Delavec mora imeti vsaj eno (zadnjo) zaposlitev. Delavec brez zaposlitve ne bo shranjen. Ali naj nadaljujem?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp = vbYes Then
      DoCmd.SetWarnings False
      DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdDeleteRecord
      DoCmd.SetWarnings True
    Else
      Cancel = True
    End If
  Case 1: Exit Sub
  Case Else
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Delavec ima ve  kot eno zaposlitev. Morda je pri lo do napake. Ali naj nadaljujem?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then
      Cancel = True
    End If
  End Select
  
End Sub

Private Sub password_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!password) Then
    resp = MsgBox("Ali spremenim geslo?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    Me!password = Format$(Int(100000 * Rnd()), "00000")
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Else
    Me!password = Format$(Int(100000 * Rnd()), "00000")
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub usesPublicTransport_AfterUpdate()

  Me!usesPublicTransport = Abs(Me!usesPublicTransport)
  If Me!usesPublicTransport = 0 Then
      Me!monthlyPublicTransportPrice.enabled = False
      Me!dailyPublicTransportPrice.enabled = False
      Me!distance.enabled = True
  Else
      Me!monthlyPublicTransportPrice.enabled = True
      Me!dailyPublicTransportPrice.enabled = True
      Me!distance.enabled = False
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub usesTimeclock_AfterUpdate()

  Me!usesTimeclock = Abs(Me!usesTimeclock)
  
    If Me!usesTimeclock = 0 Then
      Me!frmEmp_EmployeeCostCenterSalaryShares.visible = True
      Me!monthlyEarning.visible = True
      Me!frmEmp_EmployeeWageRates.visible = False
    Else
      Me!frmEmp_EmployeeCostCenterSalaryShares.visible = False
      Me!monthlyEarning.visible = False
      Me!frmEmp_EmployeeWageRates.visible = True
    End If
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub companyID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!positionID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub employmentTypeID_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim i As Integer
  If Not IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    Cancel = True
    i = MsgBox("Polje je zaklenjeno! Za spreminjanje mora biti polje lockedAt prazno.", vbInformation)
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub isActive_AfterUpdate()
  Me!isActive = Abs(Me!isActive)
End Sub

Private Sub lockedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    Me!lockedAt = Now()
  Else
  
    If IsNull(DFirst("wageCalculationSubSubID", "tblEmpWC_WageCalculationSubSubs", "employmentID=" & Me!partnerCmpyID)) Then
      Me!lockedAt = Null
      Me!employmentTypeID.Locked = False
      MsgBox "Polje vrsta zaposlitve je odklenjeno!"
    Else
      resp = MsgBox("Polje vrsta zaposlitve, se  e pojavi v obra unu pla ! Ali ga vseeno odklenem?", vbYesNo)
      If resp = vbYes Then Me!lockedAt = Null
    End If
  
  End If
  
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub ChkIsActive_AfterUpdate()
   Call frmFilter
End Sub

Private Sub ChkNotIsActive_AfterUpdate()
   Call frmFilter
End Sub

Private Sub cmdAnnualHolidays_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmpTime_AnnualHolidays"
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCreatePasswords_Click()
Dim resp As Integer

  resp = MsgBox("Dodam gesla delavcem, ki gesla  e nimajo?", vbYesNo + vbInformation)
  If Not resp = vbYes Then Exit Sub
  Call CreateEmployeesPasswords
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeleteEmployee_Click()
Dim f As Form, odg As Integer, rs As DAO.Recordset

  Set f = Me!frmEmp_EmployeesSub.Form
  Beep
  odg = MsgBox("Ali  eli  brisati delavca: (" & f!ln & ") - " & f!secondName & " " & f!firstName & "?", vbYesNo)
  If odg <> 6 Then Exit Sub

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblPtr_Partners", dbOpenDynaset)
  rs.FindFirst "employeeID = " & f!employeeID
  rs.delete
  rs.Close
  
  f.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
  Me!companyID = Null
   Call frmFilter
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNewEmployee_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BPNew"
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()

  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptEmpCat_Employees", acViewReport
  Reports!rptEmpCat_Employees.Report.Filter = Me!frmEmp_EmployeesSub.Form.Filter
  Reports!rptEmpCat_Employees.Report.FilterOn = True
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRefresh_Click()
Dim frm As Form, ID As Long
  
  Set frm = Me!frmEmp_EmployeesSub.Form
  ID = frm!employeeID
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "employeeID", ID)
  
End Sub

Private Sub companyID_AfterUpdate()
   Call frmFilter
End Sub

Public Sub frmFilter()
Dim frm As Form, strFilter As String

  Set frm = Me!frmEmp_EmployeesSub.Form
  strFilter = "((IsActive=" & Abs(Me!chkIsActive) & ") OR (NotIsActive=" & Abs(Me!chkNotIsActive) & "))"
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!companyID) Then
    frm.Filter = strFilter & " AND (companyID=" & Me!companyID & ")"
  Else
    frm.Filter = strFilter
  End If
  
    If Not frm.FilterOn Then frm.FilterOn = True
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdCalculateDepreciation_Click()
Dim depCalcID As Long, cmpyID As Long, Yr As Integer, resp As Integer, strWhere As String, strSQL As String

  If IsNull(Me!depreciationCalcID) Then
    MsgBox "Izberi obra un!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  depCalcID = Me!depreciationCalcID
  cmpyID = currentCompanyID()
  Yr = Me!frmFADepreciationCalcCalcs!fiscalYear
  
  If Yr < DMax("fiscalYear", "tblAccFA_DepreciationCalcs", "companyID=" & cmpyID) Then
    MsgBox "Obstajajo obra uni za kasnej a leta. Pred nadaljevanjem jih je potrebno izbrisati!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Not DCount("*", "tblAccFA_DepreciationCalcSubs", "depreciationCalcID=" & depCalcID) = 0 Then
    resp = MsgBox("Obra un  e obstaja. Pri nadaljevanju bo izbrisan. Ali naj nadaljujem?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  End If
  
  
  
  strSQL = "DELETE tblAccFA_DepreciationCalcSubs FROM tblAccFA_DepreciationCalcSubs INNER JOIN " & _
           "tblAccFA_FixedAssets ON tblAccFA_DepreciationCalcSubs.fixedAssetID = tblAccFA_FixedAssets.fixedAssetID " & _
           "WHERE (tblAccFA_FixedAssets.eliminationDate IS NULL) AND (depreciationCalcID=" & depCalcID & ");"
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempFA;")
    
  Call CreateQry1(243, cmpyID)                          'v temp tabelo doda OS in za etno stanje akumulirane amortizacije
  Call RunMySQL

  Call CreateQry1(244, cmpyID, Yr, depCalcID)           'doda obra un amortizacije za vsa aktivna sredstva za vse mesece
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry1(245, depCalcID)                       'doda odpisano vrednost
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry1(246, depCalcID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry1(247, depCalcID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Call CreateQry1(248, depCalcID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  Me!frmFADepreciationCalcCalcs.Form!calculatedAt = Now
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
Dim db As Database, rs As Recordset, Yr As Integer

  Set db = CurrentDb()
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblAccFA_DepreciationCalcs")
  
  Yr = currentFiscalYear()
  
  rs.AddNew
  rs("depreciationCalcNumber") = "Am_" & Yr
  rs("startDate") = CDate("01.01." & Yr)
  rs("endDate") = CDate("31.12." & Yr)
  rs("fiscalYear") = Yr
  rs("companyID") = currentCompanyID()
  rs.Update
  
  Me!frmFADepreciationCalcCalcs.Requery

End Sub

Private Sub cmdPosting_Click()
Dim frm As Form

  Set frm = Me!frmFADepreciationCalcCalcs.Form

  If IsNull(frm!postingID) Then
    Call RunSQL("DELETE * FROM tblTempAccGLPostings;")
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappFAPostingCredit")
    DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappFAPostingDebit")
    DoCmd.SetWarnings True
    Call CreatePosting
    frm.Requery
    Beep
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & frm!postingID
  End If
   
End Sub

Private Sub CmdPrintDepreciation_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptFADepreciation", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub CmdPrintInvestments_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptFADepreciation", acViewReport, , "Year(activationDate)=fiscalYear AND (taxRelief<>0)"
End Sub

Private Sub activationDate_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Me!activationDate = DMax("purchasedAt", "tblAccFA_FixedAssetSubs", "fixedAssetID=" & Me!fixedAssetID)

Private Sub Form_Close()

  If IsNull(Me!fixedAssetID) Then Exit Sub
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Forms!frmfaFixedassets.Form, "fixedAssetID", Me!fixedAssetID)

End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String
  
  Beep
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!fixedAssetID) Then
    resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati osnovno sredstvo " & Me!fixedAssetName & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  End If
  
  If resp = vbYes Then
    strSQL = "DELETE fixedAssetID, * FROM tblAccFA_FixedAssets " & _
             "WHERE fixedAssetID=" & Me!fixedAssetID & ";"
    Call RunSQL(strSQL)
    Me.Requery
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmFAFixedAsset", acNormal, , , acFormAdd
End Sub

Private Sub eliminationDate_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!eliminationDate) Then
    If YearIsOpened(currentFiscalYear()) = 0 Then
      MsgBox "Leto ni odprto."
      Exit Sub
    End If
    If Me!currentValue <> 0 Then
      resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  eliminirati OS? Neodpisana vrednost = " & Me!currentValue & " EUR.", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
      If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    End If
    Call RunMySQL("UPDATE tblAccFA_FixedAssets SET eliminationDate = '" & currentFiscalYear() & "-12-31' WHERE fixedAssetID=" & Me!fixedAssetID)
  Else
    If YearIsOpened(Year(Me!eliminationDate)) = 0 Then
      MsgBox "Leto ni odprto."
      Exit Sub
    End If

    resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  aktivirati OS?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
    Call RunMySQL("UPDATE tblAccFA_FixedAssets SET eliminationDate = NULL WHERE fixedAssetID=" & Me!fixedAssetID)
  End If
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(Forms!frmfaFixedassets.Form, "fixedAssetID", Me!fixedAssetID)
  Beep

End Sub

Private Sub fixedAssetName_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmFAFixedAsset", acNormal, , "fixedAssetID=" & Me!fixedAssetID, acFormEdit
End Sub

Private Sub fixedAssetNumber_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmFAFixedAsset", acNormal, , "fixedAssetID=" & Me!fixedAssetID, acFormEdit
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdAppDatatoMySQL_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, tblName As String
Dim qDef As QueryDef, strSQL As String
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstTables.ItemsSelected
    tblName = Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm)
    strSQL = "DELETE *.* FROM " & tblName & ";"
    Call RunSQL(strSQL)
    Call CreateAppQry(tblName)
  Next varItm

  Beep

End Sub

Private Sub CmdBitField_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, tblName As String
Dim qDef As QueryDef, strSQL As String

  For Each varItm In Me!lstTables.ItemsSelected
    If Me!lstTables.Column(2, varItm) = "Exists" Then Call FindBitField(Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm))
  Next varItm

  Me!lstTables.Requery
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub CmdCreateIndexes_Click()
  Call CreateIndex(Me!lstTables.Column(0))
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCreatePK_Click()
  Call CreatePrimaryKey(Me!lstTables.Column(0))
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCurrentTimestamp_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, tblName As String
Dim qDef As QueryDef, strSQL As String

  For Each varItm In Me!lstTables.ItemsSelected
    If Me!lstTables.Column(2, varItm) = "Exists" Then Call CurrentTS(Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm))
  Next varItm

  Me!lstTables.Requery
  Beep

End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeleteMySQLTable_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, tblName As String
Dim qDef As QueryDef, strSQL As String
  
  Beep
  If MsgBox("Bri em tabelo?", vbYesNo) <> vbYes Then Exit Sub

  For Each varItm In Me!lstTables.ItemsSelected
    tblName = Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm)
    Set qDef = CurrentDb.QueryDefs("qryMySQL_ActionSQL")
    strSQL = "DROP TABLE " & tblName & ";"
    qDef.SQL = strSQL
    qDef.Execute
    If Me!lstTables.Column(1, varItm) <> "" Then DoCmd.DeleteObject acTable, tblName
    Call LinkAccessTable(Me!lstTables.Column(3, varItm), IIf(Me!lstTables.Column(4, varItm) = "", Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm), Me!lstTables.Column(4, varItm)), Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm))
  Next varItm

  Me!lstTables.Requery
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub CmdExportTable_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, varItm As Variant, tblName As String, rs As DAO.Recordset, strError
  
    Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblShrdDB_Tables")
    
    For Each varItm In Me!lstTables.ItemsSelected
    tblName = Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm)
      
      If Not (Me!lstTables.Column(2, varItm) = "") Then
        Beep
        resp = MsgBox("Tabela " & tblName & " je  e bila izvo ena. Ali jo naj ponovno izvozim?", vbYesNo)
        If resp <> vbYes Then
          GoTo nextTable
        End If
      End If
      
      strError = ExportTableToMySQL(tblName)
      rs.FindFirst "destainationTableName='" & tblName & "'"
      rs.Edit
      rs("mySQLExportErrMsg") = Left(strError, 255)
      If Len(strError) = 0 Then
        Call CreatePrimaryKey(tblName)
        Call CreateIndex(tblName)
        rs("exportedToMySQLAt") = CStr(Now())
        rs.Update
      Else
        rs("exportedToMySQLAt") = Null
        rs.Update
      End If
nextTable:
  Next varItm
  
  Me!lstTables.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdLinkAccessTable_Click()
Dim varItm As Variant, tblName As String
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstTables.ItemsSelected
    tblName = Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm)
    If Me!lstTables.Column(1, varItm) <> "" Then DoCmd.DeleteObject acTable, tblName
    Call LinkAccessTable(Me!lstTables.Column(3, varItm), IIf(Me!lstTables.Column(4, varItm) = "", Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm), Me!lstTables.Column(4, varItm)), Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm))
  Next varItm

  Me!lstTables.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdLinkMySQLTables_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, varItm As Variant, tblName As String
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstTables.ItemsSelected
    tblName = Me!lstTables.Column(0, varItm)
    If Me!lstTables.Column(1, varItm) <> "" Then DoCmd.DeleteObject acTable, tblName
    If Me!lstTables.Column(2, varItm) = "" Then
      Beep
      MsgBox "Tabela " & tblName & " v mySQL bazi ne obstaja!"
      Exit Sub
    End If
    Call LinkODBCTable(tblName)
  Next varItm

  Me!lstTables.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String

  resp = MsgBox("Bri em inventuro " & Me!lstDailyInvID.Column(1) & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblProdCalcDI_DailyInv WHERE dailyInvID=" & Me!lstDailyInvID.Column(0)
  RunMySQL (strSQL)
  Me!lstDailyInvID.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdCalcDI_InventoryNew", , , , acFormAdd
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
Me!lstDailyInvID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub lstDailyInvID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdCalcDI_Inventory", , , "dailyInvID=" & Me!lstDailyInvID, acFormEdit
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strSQL As String

  resp = MsgBox("Bri em inventuro " & Me!lstDailyInvID.Column(1) & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblProdCalcDI_DailyInv WHERE dailyInvID=" & Me!lstDailyInvID.Column(0)
  RunMySQL (strSQL)
  Me!lstDailyInvID.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdCalcDI_InventoryNew", , , , acFormAdd
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRequery_Click()
Me!lstDailyInvID.Requery
End Sub

  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdCalcDI_Inventory", , , "dailyInvID=" & Me!lstDailyInvID, acFormEdit
End Sub

Private Sub CmdCalculateDeviations_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, qDef As QueryDef


  strSQL = "DELETE tblProdCalcDI_DailyInvDeviationCalcs FROM tblProdCalcDI_DailyInvDeviationCalcs INNER JOIN tblProdCalcDI_DailyInvProducts ON " & _
           "tblProdCalcDI_DailyInvProducts.dailyInvProductID = tblProdCalcDI_DailyInvDeviationCalcs.dailyInvProductID " & _
           "WHERE tblProdCalcDI_DailyInvProducts.dailyInvID=" & Me!dailyInvID & ";"

  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappProdCalcDI_DevCalc_00_AddProducts"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  
  Call DailyInventoryDeviations("qappProdCalcDI_DevCalc_01_StartInventory", "startInventoryQty")
  Call DailyInventoryDeviations("qappProdCalcDI_DevCalc_02_Purchase", "purchaseQty")
  Call DailyInventoryDeviations("qappProdCalcDI_DevCalc_03_crSales", "crSalesQty")
'  Call DailyInventoryDeviations("qappProdCalcDI_DevCalc_04_otherSales", "otherSalesQty")
'  Call DailyInventoryDeviations("qappProdCalcDI_DevCalc_05_crWriteOff", "crWriteOffQty")
'  Call DailyInventoryDeviations("qappProdCalcDI_DevCalc_06_otherWriteOff", "otherWriteOffQty")
  Call DailyInventoryDeviations("qappProdCalcDI_DevCalc_07_EndInventory", "endInventoryQty")
  
  Me!rptProdCalcDI_S.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCreateInventoryList_Click()
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset, deleteData As Boolean
Dim db As DAO.Database, qDef As QueryDef, invID As String, i As Long, D1 As Long, D2 As Long

  If IsNull(Me!StartDate) Or IsNull(Me!EndDate) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka za etni in/ali kon ni datum!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set rs = Me!frmProdCalcDI_InventoryProducts.Form.RecordsetClone
  
  If rs.RecordCount <> 0 Then
    rs.MoveFirst
    deleteData = True
    Do While Not rs.EOF
      Call FindRelatedProducts(rs("productID"), deleteData)
      If deleteData = True Then deleteData = False
      rs.MoveNext
    Loop
  Else
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set db = CurrentDb
  Set qDef = db.QueryDefs("qappProdCalcDI_CreateInventoryListDetails")
  qDef.Parameters("dailyInvID") = Me!dailyInvID
  
  D1 = CLng(CDate(Me!StartDate))
  D2 = CLng(CDate(Me!EndDate))
  
  For i = D1 To D2
    qDef.Parameters("invDate") = i
    qDef.Execute
  Next i
  
  Me!lstDailyInvProducts.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDeleteAll_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, strWhere As String, strSQL As String

  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Bri em celotno inventurno listo?", vbYesNo + vbCritical)
    If resp = vbYes Then
        
        strWhere = "WHERE dailyInvID=" & Me!dailyInvID
       
        strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblProdCalcDI_DailyInvInventoryListDetails " & strWhere
        Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
        
        Me!lstDailyInvProducts = ""
        Me!lstDailyInvProducts.Requery
        Beep
        
    End If

End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer

  Beep
  resp = MsgBox(" eli  brisati izbrani artikel?", vbCritical + vbYesNo, "Brisanje artikla:")
  
  If resp = vbYes Then
    DoCmd.SetWarnings False
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdDeleteRecord
    DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
  Forms!frmProdCalcDI_Inventory!frmProdCalcDI_InventoryProducts.Requery

Private Sub productGroupID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!productID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub productID_Click()
Dim frm As Form, invID As String, db As DAO.Database, rs As DAO.Recordset

  Set frm = Forms!frmProdCalcDI_Inventory.Form
  invID = (frm!dailyInvID)
  
  Set db = CurrentDb
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblProdCalcDI_DailyInvProducts")
  
  If Not Me!productID = "" Then
    rs.AddNew
    rs("dailyInvID") = invID
    rs("productID") = Me!productID.Column(0)
    rs("baseUnitID") = Me!productID.Column(2)
    rs.Update
  End If
  
  Me!productID.Requery
  Forms!frmProdCalcDI_Inventory!frmProdCalcDI_InventoryProducts.Requery
  rs.Close
  db.Close
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCalculateInvDeviations_Click()
Dim resp As Integer
Dim strSQL As String, str1 As String, str2 As String
  
  If IsNull(Me!startInventoryID) Or IsNull(Me!endInventoryID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Izberi za etni oz. kon ni datum!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  resp = MsgBox("Obstoje i podatki bodo izbrisani! Nadaljujejm?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblProdCalcGI_DeviationCalcSubs WHERE deviationCalcID=" & Me!deviationCalcID & ";")
  
  Call CreateQry(23, Me!costCenterID, , , , Me!deviationCalcID)
  Call RunMySQL
 
  str1 = "UPDATE tblProdCalcGI_DeviationCalcSubs INNER JOIN tblTempProd ON tblTempProd.productID = tblProdCalcGI_DeviationCalcSubs.productID SET tblProdCalcGI_DeviationCalcSubs."
  str2 = "noOfBaseUnits WHERE (deviationCalcID=" & Me!deviationCalcID & ");"
  
' GeneralInventoryDeviations(24, "startInventoryQty")

  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempProd;")
  
  Call CreateQry(24, Me!startInventoryID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  strSQL = str1 & "startInventoryQty" & " = " & str2
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
    
' qappProdCalcGI_DeviationsCalc_02_Purchase", "purchaseQty"
  
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempProd;")
  
  Call CreateQry(25, "'" & XMLDate(Me!StartDate) & "'", "'" & XMLDate(Me!EndDate) & "'", Me!costCenterID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  strSQL = str1 & "purchaseQty" & " = " & str2
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
'  "qappProdCalcGI_DeviationsCalc_03_crSales", "crSalesQty"

  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempProd;")
  
  Call CreateQry(26, "'" & XMLDate(Me!StartDate) & "'", "'" & XMLDate(Me!EndDate) & "'", Me!costCenterID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  strSQL = str1 & "crSalesQty" & " = " & str2
  
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
'  "qappProdCalcGI_DeviationsCalc_04_otherSales", "otherSalesQty"
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempProd;")
  
  Call CreateQry(27, "'" & XMLDate(Me!StartDate) & "'", "'" & XMLDate(Me!EndDate) & "'", Me!costCenterID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  strSQL = str1 & "otherSalesQty" & " = " & str2
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  
' "qappProdCalcGI_DeviationsCalc_05_crWriteOff", "crWriteOffQty"
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempProd;")
  
  Call CreateQry(28, "'" & XMLDate(Me!StartDate) & "'", "'" & XMLDate(Me!EndDate) & "'", Me!costCenterID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  strSQL = str1 & "crWriteOffQty" & " = " & str2
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)

'  "qappProdCalcGI_DeviationsCalc_06_otherWriteOff", "otherWriteOffQty"
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempProd;")
  
  Call CreateQry(29, "'" & XMLDate(Me!StartDate) & "'", "'" & XMLDate(Me!EndDate) & "'", Me!costCenterID)
  Call RunMySQL
  
  strSQL = str1 & "otherWriteOffQty" & " = " & str2
  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)

'  Call GeneralInventoryDeviations(Me!deviationCalcID, "qappProdCalcGI_DeviationsCalc_07_EndInventory", "endInventoryQty")
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempProd;")
  
  Call CreateQry(24, Me!endInventoryID)
  Call RunMySQL

  Call RunMySQL(strSQL)

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Option Compare Database

Private Sub CmdAtomize_Click()
  
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi restavracijo!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call AtomizeProducts
  Call CalculateProductPurchasePrices(Me!costCenterID)
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qupdProdCalcGI_PurchasePrices"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  Me!frmProdCalcGI_InventorySub.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, rs As DAO.Recordset

  If IsNull(Me!inventoryID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Izberi inventuro!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  brisati inventuro " & Me!inventoryID.Column(1) & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp = vbYes Then
    Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblProdCalcGI_Inventories")
    rs.FindFirst "inventoryID = " & Me!inventoryID
    rs.delete
    Call RunSQL("DELETE tblTempProdCalcGI_InventorySub.* FROM tblTempProdCalcGI_InventorySub;")
    Me!inventoryID.Requery
    Me!frmProdCalcGI_InventorySub.Form.Requery
  End If
    
End Sub

Private Sub CmdFilterRelatedProducts_Click()
Dim frm As Form, prodID As Long, db As DAO.Database, rs As DAO.Recordset, qDef As QueryDef, strFilter As String, noOfRecords, i As Integer

  Set frm = Me!frmProdCalcGI_InventorySub.Form
  prodID = frm!productID
    
  Call FindRelatedProducts(prodID, True)
  'frm.RecordSource = "qryProdCalcGI_InventoryList_RelatedProducts"
  
  Set db = CurrentDb()
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblTempProd_RelatedProducts")
    
  rs.MoveLast
  noOfRecords = rs.RecordCount
  rs.MoveFirst
  
  For i = 1 To noOfRecords
    If i = noOfRecords Then
      strFilter = strFilter & "productID=" & rs("productID")
    Else
      strFilter = strFilter & "productID=" & rs("productID") & " or "
    End If
    rs.MoveNext
  Next i
  
  frm.Filter = strFilter
  If frm.FilterOn = False Then frm.FilterOn = True
  
  rs.Close
  db.Close
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
Dim frm As Form
  
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi restavracijo!", vbInformation
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdCalcGI_InventoryNew"
    Set frm = Forms!frmProdCalcGI_InventoryNew.Form
    frm!invNumber = NewDocumentNumber("tblProdCalcGI_Inventories", "inventoryNumber", "Inv", currentFiscalYear, Me!costCenterID, False)
    If IsNull(DMax("inventoryDate", "tblProdCalcGI_Inventories", "costCenterID=" & Me!costCenterID)) Then Exit Sub
    frm!invDate = LastDayInMonth(DMax("inventoryDate", "tblProdCalcGI_Inventories", "costCenterID=" & Me!costCenterID), 1)
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub cmdPosting_Click()
Dim invID As Long, invDate As Date, qDef As QueryDef, db As Database
  
  Me!inventoryID.Requery
  
  If Me!inventoryID.Column(4) = "" Then
    Call RunSQL("DELETE * FROM tblTempAccGLPostings;")
    Set db = CurrentDb()
    invDate = CDate(Me!inventoryID.Column(2))
    invID = Me!inventoryID.Column(0)
    
    Set qDef = db.QueryDefs("qappProdCalcGI_posting_310")
    qDef.Parameters("inventoryID") = invID
    qDef.Parameters("inventoryDate") = invDate
    qDef.Execute
    
    Set qDef = db.QueryDefs("qappProdCalcGI_posting_400")
    qDef.Parameters("inventoryID") = invID
    qDef.Parameters("inventoryDate") = invDate
    qDef.Execute

    Call CreatePosting(currentCompanyID())
    Me!inventoryID.Requery
    Beep
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & Me!inventoryID.Column(4)
  End If
  
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
Dim resp As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!inventoryID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Izberi inventuro!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If

  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptProdCalcGI_InventoryList", acViewReport, , "inventoryID=" & Me!inventoryID
  
End Sub

Private Sub costCenterID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!inventoryID = Null
  Me!inventoryID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub fltrOff_Click()
Dim frmSub As Form

  Set frmSub = Me!frmProdCalcGI_InventorySub.Form
  Me!fltrProductName = Null
  Me!fltrProductGroupID = Null
  frmSub.Filter = ""
  'frmSub.FilterOn = False
  
  If frmSub.RecordSource = "qryProdCalcGI_InventoryList_RelatedProducts" Then
    frmSub.RecordSource = "qryProdCalcGI_InventoryList"
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub fltrProductGroupID_AfterUpdate()
  Call SubFormFilterOn
End Sub

Private Sub fltrProductName_AfterUpdate()
  Call SubFormFilterOn
  If IsNull(Me!fltrProductName) Then
    Me!fltrProductName.ForeColor = 12566463
  Else
    Me!fltrProductName.ForeColor = 4210752
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub SubFormFilterOn()
Dim strFilter, frmSub As Form

  Set frmSub = Me!frmProdCalcGI_InventorySub.Form

  If Not IsNull(Me!fltrProductName) Then
    strFilter = "productName Like '*" & Me!fltrProductName & "*' "

    If Not IsNull(Me!fltrProductGroupID) Then
      strFilter = strFilter & " And productGroupID = " & Me!fltrProductGroupID
    End If
    
    frmSub.Filter = strFilter
    If Not frmSub.FilterOn Then frmSub.FilterOn = True
    Exit Sub
    
  End If
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!fltrProductGroupID) Then
    strFilter = "productGroupID = " & Me!fltrProductGroupID
    frmSub.Filter = strFilter
    If Not frmSub.FilterOn Then frmSub.FilterOn = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
    Call CloseForm(Me.Name)
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  Call CreateQry(99, 0)
  Me!frmProdCalcGI_InventorySub.Form.RecordSource = "qryProdCalcGI_InventorySub"
  DoCmd.Maximize
End Sub

Private Sub inventoryID_AfterUpdate()

  If IsNull(Me!inventoryID) Then
    Call CreateQry(99, 0)
  Else
    Call CreateQry(99, Me!inventoryID)
  End If
  Me!frmProdCalcGI_InventorySub.Form.RecordSource = "qryProdCalcGI_InventorySub"

End Sub

Private Sub inventoryID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer, frm As Form

  If IsNull(Me!inventoryID) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Izberi inventuro!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If

  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdCalcGI_InventoryNew"
  Set frm = Forms!frmProdCalcGI_InventoryNew.Form
  frm!invNumber = Me!inventoryID.Column(1)
  frm!invDate = Me!inventoryID.Column(2)
  frm!chkEdit = True
  
End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
Dim resp As Integer, db As DAO.Database, rs As DAO.Recordset, invID As Long, strSQL As String, frm As Form, qDef As QueryDef, i As Integer

  If IsNull(Me!invDate) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Datum ne sme biti prazen!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Year(Me!invDate) <> currentFiscalYear Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Datum ni v aktivnem letu!", vbInformation)
    Me!invDate = Null
    Me!invDate.SetFocus
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.Hourglass True
  Call AtomizeProducts
  Call CalculateProductPurchasePrices(Forms!frmProdCalcGI_Inventory.Form!costCenterID)
  
  Set db = CurrentDb()
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblProdCalcGI_Inventories", dbOpenDynaset, dbSeeChanges)
  Set frm = Forms!frmProdCalcGI_Inventory.Form
     
  If chkEdit = True Then
    rs.FindFirst "(inventoryID) = " & (frm!inventoryID)
    rs.Edit
    rs("inventoryNumber") = Me!invNumber
    rs("inventoryDate") = Me!invDate
    rs.Update
    frm!inventoryID.Requery
  Else
    rs.AddNew
    rs("inventoryNumber") = Me!invNumber
    rs("inventoryDate") = Me!invDate
    rs("costCenterID") = frm!costCenterID
    rs("fiscalYear") = currentFiscalYear
    rs.Update
    rs.Bookmark = rs.LastModified
    invID = rs!inventoryID
    
    strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblProdCalcGI_InventorySubs ( inventoryID, productID, productName, unitID, noOfBaseUnitsInUnit, baseUnitID, baseUnitPurchasePrice ) " & vbCrLf & _
             "SELECT "
    
    strSQL = strSQL & invID & " as inv, tblProdCat_Products.productID, tblProdCat_Products.productName, tblProdCat_ProductUnits.unitID, tblProdCat_ProductUnits.noOfBaseUnitsInUnit, tblProdCat_Products.baseUnitID, " & _
             "tblProdCat_Products.baseUnitPurchasePrice " & vbCrLf & _
             "FROM ((tblProdCat_ProductGroups INNER JOIN tblProdCat_Products ON tblProdCat_ProductGroups.productGroupID = tblProdCat_Products.productGroupID) INNER JOIN (tblProdCat_Units " & _
             "INNER JOIN tblProdCat_ProductUnits ON tblProdCat_Units.unitID = tblProdCat_ProductUnits.unitID) ON tblProdCat_Products.productID = tblProdCat_ProductUnits.productID) " & _
             "LEFT JOIN tblCmpyCat_Departments ON tblProdCat_Products.ownerDepartmentID = tblCmpyCat_Departments.departmentID " & vbCrLf & _
             "WHERE (tblProdCat_Products.costCenterID="
    strSQL = strSQL & frm!costCenterID & ") AND (tblProdCat_Products.isActive=1) AND (tblProdCat_Products.deletedAt Is Null) AND (tblProdCat_Products.showOnInventoryList=1) " & _
             "AND (tblProdCat_ProductUnits.showOnInventoryList=1) " & vbCrLf & _
             "ORDER BY tblCmpyCat_Departments.sequence, tblProdCat_ProductGroups.productGroupName, tblProdCat_Products.productName, tblProdCat_Units.unitName;"
    
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
    
    Call CreateQry(98, invID)
    Call RunMySQL
    
    frm!inventoryID.Requery
    'frm!inventoryID = invID ' frm!inventoryID.Column(0, 0)
    
  End If
   
   rs.Close
   db.Close
   
   DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
DoCmd.Hourglass False

End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  Call RequeryFrmSub
End Sub

Private Sub groupGroupType_AfterUpdate()
  Call RequeryFrmSub
  Me!fltrProductGroupID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub productLevelID_AfterUpdate()
Dim frmSub As Form
  
  Me!fltrProductGroupID.Requery
  
  Call fltrOff_Click
  Call cmdUnckeckAll_Click
  
  If Me!productLevelID = 0 Then
    Me!priceHistory.visible = True
  Else
    Me!priceHistory.visible = False
  End If
  
  Call RequeryFrmSub
  Me!fltrProductGroupID.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub ChkIsActive_AfterUpdate()
    Call RequeryFrmSub
End Sub

Private Sub ChkNotIsActive_AfterUpdate()
    Call RequeryFrmSub
End Sub

Private Sub fltrProductGroupID_AfterUpdate()
  Call SubFormFilterOn
End Sub

Private Sub optMoreRecipesPerPage_AfterUpdate()
  If Me!optMoreRecipesPerPage = True Then
    Me!optSingleRecipePerPage = False
  Else
    Me!optSingleRecipePerPage = True
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub optSingleRecipePerPage_AfterUpdate()
  If Me!optSingleRecipePerPage = True Then
    Me!optMoreRecipesPerPage = False
  Else
    Me!optMoreRecipesPerPage = True
  End If
End Sub


Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
Dim frm As Form

  If IsNull(Me!groupGroupType) Or IsNull(Me!productLevelID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi vrsto artiklov!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdCatProd_Recipe", , , , acFormAdd
    Set frm = Forms!frmProdCatProd_Recipe.Form
    'frm!recipeLevel.DefaultValue = Me!productLevelID
    
    Select Case Me!productLevelID
    Case 0: frm!recipeLevel.DefaultValue = 0
            frm!cmdLevelUp.enabled = False
            frm!cmdLevelDown.enabled = False
    Case -1:
      frm!recipeLevel.DefaultValue = -1
      frm!baseUnitID.DefaultValue = DefaultUnitID(Me!groupGroupType)
      frm!cmdLevelUp.enabled = False
      frm!cmdLevelDown.enabled = False
    Case Else: frm!recipeLevel.DefaultValue = 1
    End Select
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub fltrProductName_AfterUpdate()
  Call SubFormFilterOn
  If IsNull(Me!fltrProductName) Then
    Me!fltrProductName.ForeColor = 12566463
  Else
    Me!fltrProductName.ForeColor = 4210752
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub SubFormFilterOn()
Dim strFilter, frmSub As Form

  Set frmSub = Me!frmProdCatProd_ProductsSub.Form

  If Not IsNull(Me!fltrProductName) Then
    strFilter = "ProductName Like '*" & Me!fltrProductName & "*' "

    If Not IsNull(Me!fltrProductGroupID) Then
      strFilter = strFilter & " And productGroupID = " & (Me!fltrProductGroupID)
    End If
    
    frmSub.Filter = strFilter
    If Not frmSub.FilterOn Then frmSub.FilterOn = True
    Exit Sub
    
  End If
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!fltrProductGroupID) Then
    strFilter = "ProductGroupID = " & (Me!fltrProductGroupID)
    frmSub.Filter = strFilter
    If Not frmSub.FilterOn Then frmSub.FilterOn = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub fltrOff_Click()
Dim frmSub As Form

  Me!fltrProductName = Null
  Me!fltrProductGroupID = Null
  Set frmSub = Me!frmProdCatProd_ProductsSub.Form
  frmSub.Filter = ""
  frmSub.FilterOn = False

End Sub

Private Sub cmdCheckAllShown_Click()
Dim frmSub  As Form, rsc As DAO.Recordset, rs As DAO.Recordset

  Set frmSub = Me!frmProdCatProd_ProductsSub.Form
  Set rsc = frmSub.RecordsetClone
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblProdCat_Products")
  
  If rsc.RecordCount = 0 Then Beep: Exit Sub

  Call RunSQL("UPDATE tblProdCat_Products SET isSelected = 0 WHERE isSelected=1;")

  rsc.MoveFirst
  Do While Not rsc.EOF
  
    rs.FindFirst "ProductId=" & rsc("ProductID")
    rs.Edit
    rs("isSelected") = 1
    rs.Update
    
    rsc.MoveNext
  Loop
  
  rsc.Close
  Set rsc = Nothing
  rs.Close
  Set rs = Nothing
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(frmSub, "productID", Me!productID)

End Sub

Private Sub cmdUnckeckAll_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim frmSub As Form

  Set frmSub = Me!frmProdCatProd_ProductsSub.Form
  Call RunSQL("UPDATE tblProdCat_Products SET isSelected = 0 WHERE isSelected=1;")
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(frmSub, "productID", Me!productID)
  
End Sub

Private Sub fltrIsSelectedOn_Click()
Dim strFilter, frmSub As Form

  Set frmSub = Me!frmProdCatProd_ProductsSub.Form

  strFilter = "isSelected=1"
  frmSub.Filter = strFilter
  If Not frmSub.FilterOn Then frmSub.FilterOn = True
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrintRecipe_Click()
  If productLevelID = 0 Then Beep: Exit Sub
  Call OpenProductsReport("rptProdCatProd_ProductRecipe", Me!optSingleRecipePerPage)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrintProductList_Click()
  Call OpenProductsReport("rptProdCatProd_Products", True)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrintProductListUnits_Click()
  Call OpenProductsReport("rptProdCatProd_ProductsUnits", True)
End Sub

Private Sub priceHistory_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmDocGoods_PurchaseHistory", acFormDS ', acFormDS
End Sub

Private Sub RequeryFrmSub()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim strSQL As String, frm As Form, qDef As QueryDef
Dim frmSub As Form, prodID As Long

  Set frm = Me

  If IsNull(frm!productLevelID) Then Exit Sub
  
  strSQL = "SELECT tblProdCat_Products.isSelected, tblProdCat_Products.productID, tblProdCat_Products.productName, tblProdCat_Products.productGroupID, " & _
           "tblProdCat_ProductGroups.productGroupName, tblAccVat_VatRates.vatRate, tblCR_Menus.crMenuName, tblProdCat_Products.isActive, " & _
           "tblCmpyCat_Departments.departmentName, tblPtr_Partners.name1, " & _
           "tblProdCat_Products.salesPrice, tblProdCat_Products.baseUnitPurchasePrice, ROUND(((tblProdCat_Products.baseUnitPurchasePrice/(tblProdCat_Products.salesPrice/(1+vatRate)))), 4) AS margin " & _
           "FROM (((((tblProdCat_Products LEFT JOIN tblProdCat_ProductGroups ON tblProdCat_Products.productGroupID = tblProdCat_ProductGroups.productGroupID) " & _
           "LEFT JOIN tblProdCat_ProductGroupGroups ON tblProdCat_ProductGroups.productGroupGroupID = tblProdCat_ProductGroupGroups.productGroupGroupID) " & _
           "LEFT JOIN tblAccVat_VatRates ON tblProdCat_Products.vatRateID = tblAccVat_VatRates.vatRateID) " & _
           "LEFT JOIN tblCR_Menus ON tblProdCat_Products.crMenuID = tblCR_Menus.crMenuID) " & _
           "LEFT JOIN tblCmpyCat_Departments ON tblProdCat_Products.ownerDepartmentID = tblCmpyCat_Departments.departmentID) " & _
           "LEFT JOIN tblPtr_Partners ON tblProdCat_Products.partnerID = tblPtr_Partners.partnerID " & _
           "WHERE (tblProdCat_Products.companyID=" & currentCompanyID() & ") And " & _
           "((tblProdCat_Products.IsActive=" & Abs(frm!chkIsActive) & ") Or (tblProdCat_Products.IsActive<>" & Abs(frm!chkNotIsActive) & ")) And " & _
           "((tblProdCat_ProductGroups.productLevelID=" & frm!productLevelID & ") Or (tblProdCat_ProductGroups.productLevelID Is Null)) And " & _
           "((tblProdCat_ProductGroupGroups.groupGroupType = " & frm!groupGroupType & ") Or (tblProdCat_ProductGroupGroups.groupGroupType Is Null)) And (tblProdCat_Products.deletedAt Is Null) " & _
           "ORDER BY tblProdCat_Products.productName;"
           
  Set qDef = CurrentDb.QueryDefs("qryProdCat_products")
  qDef.SQL = strSQL
  frm!frmProdCatProd_ProductsSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryProdCat_products"

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdCopyProduct_Click()
Dim newPrID As Long
  
  newPrID = CopyProductID((Me!productID))
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "productID", newPrID)
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeleteProduct_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim resp As Integer, i As Integer, iMax As Integer
  
  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Bri em artikel " & Me!productName & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo, "Brisanje artikla")
  If resp = vbYes Then
    Call RunSQL("UPDATE tblProdCat_Products SET tblProdCat_Products.deletedAt = Now() WHERE productID=" & Me!productID)
    
    Me!deletedAt = Now
    If Me.Recordset.AbsolutePosition < Me.Recordset.RecordCount - 1 Then
      DoCmd.GoToRecord , , acNext
    Else
      DoCmd.GoToRecord , , acPrevious
    End If
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "productID", Me!productID)
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdIsSelected_Click()
On Error GoTo err_exit

Dim strSQL As String
  strSQL = "UPDATE tblProdCat_Products SET isSelected =" & IIf(isSelected = 0, 1, 0) & " WHERE productID=" & Me!productID & ";"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  DoCmd.Echo False
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "productID", Me!productID)
  
err_exit:
  DoCmd.Echo True
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
  Me!prID = Me!productID
  Forms!frmProdCatProd_Products.Form!productID = CLng(Me!productID)
  
End Sub

Private Sub productName_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frm As Form, frm1 As Form

 Set frm = Forms!frmProdCatProd_Products.Form

  Select Case frm!productLevelID
  Case 1
    Call OpenFormRecipe(Me!productID, False)
  Case -1
    Call OpenFormRecipe(Me!productID, True)

Option Compare Database

Private Sub calculateInventoryDeviation_AfterUpdate()
  Me!calculateInventoryDeviation = Abs(Me!calculateInventoryDeviation)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdLevelDown_Click()
Dim resp As Integer

  If DLookup("maxLevel", "qryProdCatProd_RecipeLevelDown", "productID=" & Me!productID) < (Me!recipeLevel - 1) Then
    Me!recipeLevel = Me!recipeLevel - 1
    Me!prLevel = Me!recipeLevel
    Me!frmProdCatProd_RecipeIngredients.Form!ingredientProductID.Requery
  Else
    resp = MsgBox("Ne morem zni ati nivoja, ker so na njem artikli iz katerih je " & Me!productName & " sestavljen/a!", vbInformation)
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdLevelUp_Click()
Dim resp As Integer
 
  If DLookup("minLevel", "qryProdCatProd_RecipeLevelUp", "productID=" & Me!productID) <= Me!recipeLevel + 1 Then
    resp = MsgBox("Ne morem zvi ati nivoja, ker so na njem artikli v katerih nastopa " & Me!productName & " kot sestavina!", vbInformation)
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Me!recipeLevel = Me!recipeLevel + 1
  Me!prLevel = Me!recipeLevel
  Me!frmProdCatProd_RecipeIngredients.Form!ingredientProductID.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrintRecipe_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptProdCatProd_ProductRecipe", acViewReport, , "productID=" & Me!productID
  Reports!rptProdCatProd_ProductRecipe.Report.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRefreshPrices_Click()
  Call CalculateProductPurchasePrices(Me!costCenterID)
  Me!frmProdCatProd_RecipeIngredients.Form.Refresh
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim frm As Form, frmName As String

  If Not IsNull(Me!productID) Then
    frmName = "frmProdCatProd_Products"
    If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
        Set frm = Forms(frmName)
        Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm!frmProdCatProd_ProductsSub.Form, "productID", Me!productID)
    End If
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmDocAcc_officeInvoice"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!frmDocAcc_officeInvoiceDetails.Form!productID.Requery
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub isActive_AfterUpdate()
   Me!isActive = Abs(Me!isActive)
End Sub

Private Sub showOnInventoryList_AfterUpdate()
  Me!showOnInventoryList = Abs(Me!showOnInventoryList)
End Sub

Private Sub vatIncluded_AfterUpdate()
  Me!vatIncluded = Abs(Me!vatIncluded)
End Sub

Private Sub unitID_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim i As Integer

  If DCount("productUnitID", "tblProdCat_ProductUnits", "productID=" & (Me!ingredientProductID) & " And unitID = " & (Me!unitID)) = 0 Then
    Beep
    i = MsgBox("Izbrana enota mere pri sestavini " & Me!ingredientProductID.Column(1) & " ne obstaja!", vbInformation)
    Cancel = True
    Call unitID_DblClick(False)
  End If
  
End Sub

Option Compare Database

Private Sub CmdCurrentToNew_Click()
Dim resp As String, strSQL As String, frm As Form

  resp = MsgBox("Spremenim cene?", vbYesNo)
  If resp = vbYes Then
    strSQL = "UPDATE tblProdCat_Products SET salesPriceNew = salesPrice " & _
             "WHERE (isActive=1) AND (recipeLevel=-1) AND tblProdCat_Products.companyID=" & currentCompanyID()
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
    Beep
    Set frm = Me!frmProdCat_ChangePricesSub.Form

Private Sub lstProducts_Click()
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi dobavitelja na katerega naj prenesem artikel!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  Call RunMySQL("UPDATE tblProdCat_Products SET partnerID=" & Me!partnerID & " WHERE productID=" & Me!lstProducts)
  Call partnerID_AfterUpdate
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!lstProducts.Requery
  Me!lstPartnerProducts.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub productGroupID_AfterUpdate()
  Call partnerID_AfterUpdate
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPosting_Click()
Dim postingID, cmptrID As Long, ptrID As Long

  postingID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "(parentTableID=71) AND parentID=" & Me!writeOffID)
    
  If IsNull(postingID) Then
  
    cmptrID = computerID()
    Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempAccGL_Posting WHERE computerID=" & cmptrID & ";")

    Call CreateQry(158, Me!writeOffID, , , , cmptrID)
    Call RunMySQL

    ptrID = DLookup("partnerID", "tblCmpy_Companies", "companyID=" & currentCompanyID())
    
    Call CreateQry(159, Me!writeOffID, , , , FindGLAccountID("470000"), cmptrID, ptrID)
    Call RunMySQL

    Call CreatePostingMySQL
    Beep
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & postingID
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptProdDocWO_WriteOff", acViewReport, , "writeOffID=" & Me!writeOffID
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form

  frmName = "frmProdDocWO_WriteOffs"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    If Not IsNull(Me!writeOffID) Then Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm!frmProdDocWO_WriteOffsSub.Form, "writeOffID", Me!writeOffID)
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub partners_AfterUpdate()
Dim strSQL As String

  strSQL = "SELECT employeeID, empName FROM qryPtr_empEmployeesAll WHERE qryPtr_empEmployeesAll.isActive = 1 ORDER BY empName;"

  If Me!partners = 1 Then
    Me!partnerID.RowSource = strSQL
  Else
    Me!partnerID.RowSource = "qryPtr_ptrCmpyPartners"
  End If
  Me!partnerID.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub rawProducts_AfterUpdate()
  Me!rawProducts = Abs(Me!rawProducts)
  Me!frmProdDocWO_WriteOffSub.Form!productID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub recipeProducts_AfterUpdate()
  Me!recipeProducts = Abs(Me!recipeProducts)
  Me!frmProdDocWO_WriteOffSub.Form!productID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub salesProducts_AfterUpdate()
  Me!salesProducts = Abs(Me!salesProducts)
  Me!frmProdDocWO_WriteOffSub.Form!productID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub writeOffDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer
  If Year(Me!writeOffDate) <> currentFiscalYear() Then
    resp = MsgBox("Datum ni v aktivnem koledarskem letu!", vbExclamation)
    Cancel = True
  End If
End Sub
