Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim strSQL As String

  If MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati odpis?", vbCritical + vbYesNo) <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  strSQL = "DELETE tblDocGoods_WriteOffs.writeOffID, tblDocGoods_WriteOffs.* FROM tblDocGoods_WriteOffs " & _
           "WHERE (((tblDocGoods_WriteOffs.writeOffID)=" & Me!writeOffID & "));"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  
  Me!frmProdDocWO_WriteOffsSub.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjka stro kovno mesto!", vbInformation
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmProdDocWO_WriteOff", acNormal, , , acFormAdd
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
  Call CloseForm(Me.Name)
End Sub

Private Sub costCenterProductID_AfterUpdate()
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset, strSQL As String

  strSQL = "SELECT tblProdCostCenterProducts.purchasePrice, tblProdProducts.baseUnitID " & _
           "FROM (tblProdProducts INNER JOIN tblProdBrandProducts ON tblProdProducts.productID = tblProdBrandProducts.productID) " & _
           "INNER JOIN tblProdCostCenterProducts ON tblProdBrandProducts.brandProductID = tblProdCostCenterProducts.brandProductID " & _
           "WHERE ((costCenterProductID=" & (Me!costCenterProductID) & "));"

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
  Me!purchasePrice = rs("purchasePrice")
  Me!unitID = (rs("baseUnitID"))

End Sub

Private Sub productID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!baseUnitID = Me!productID.Column(2)
  Me!baseUnitPurchasePrice = Me!productID.Column(3)
End Sub

Private Sub bpTaxNumber_AfterUpdate()
  If Me!countryID = 1 Then
    If Left(Me!taxNumber, 2) = "SI" Then
      Me!vatStatusID = 1
    Else
      Me!vatStatusID = 0
    End If
  End If

Private Sub Form_Close()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim bpID As Long, frmName As String, frm As Form
  
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then Exit Sub
  bpID = Me!partnerID
  
  frmName = "frmPtr_BPs"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm!frmPtr_BPssub.Form, "partnerID", bpID)
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmPurchaseInvoice"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!partnerID.Requery
    If IsNull(frm!partnerID) Then frm!partnerID = (bpID)
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmPurchaseAcceptance"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!partnerID.Requery
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmAccPmtJournalsMain"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm.frmAccPmtJournalsTransactions.Form!partnerID.Requery
    If IsNull(frm.frmAccPmtJournalsTransactions.Form!partnerID) Then frm.frmAccPmtJournalsTransactions.Form!partnerID = (bpID)
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmOfficeInvoice"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!partnerID.Requery
    If IsNull(frm!partnerID) Then
      frm!partnerID = (bpID)
    End If
    frm.UpdateBPDataOnOfficeInvoice
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmAccPmtPO_PaymentOrder"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!partnerID.Requery
    If IsNull(frm!partnerID) Then
      frm!partnerID = (bpID)
    End If
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmAccGL_Posting"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm.frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form!partnerID.Requery
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer
  If (IsNull(Me!isSupplier) And IsNull(Me!isBuyer)) Or ((Me!isSupplier = 0) And (Me!isBuyer = 0)) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Poslovni partner ni niti kupec niti dobavitelj. Ali ga naj kljub temu zaprem?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Cancel = True
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub vatSettlementTypeID_AfterUpdate()
Dim strSQL As String

  strSQL = "INSERT INTO tblPtr_bpDDVOItems (PartnerID, countryID, vatBaseDDVOItemID, vatRateDDVOItemID) " & _
           "SELECT " & Me!partnerID & " AS Expr1, " & currentCountryID() & " AS Expr2, " & _
           "vatBaseDDVOItemID, vatRateDDVOItemID " & _
           "FROM tblAccVat_VatSettlementTypeSubs " & _
           "WHERE (vatSettlementTypeID=" & Me!vatSettlementTypeID & ");"
  Call RunSQL(strSQL)
  Me!frmPtr_BPDDVOItems.Requery

End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdCancel_Click()
  DoCmd.Close acForm, "frmPtr_BPAddNew"
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSaveBP_Click()
Dim strWhere As String, resp As Integer, bpID As Long, rs As DAO.Recordset, i As Integer
  
  If IsNull(Me!name1) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox("Polje naziv mora biti obvezno izpolnjeno!")
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!taxNumber) Then
    Beep
    resp = MsgBox(" e bo  nadaljeval brez vnosa dav ne  tevilke se lahko partner podvoji! Nadaljujem?", vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  Else
      strWhere = "(taxNumber='" & Me!taxNumber & "') OR (taxNumber='SI" & Me!taxNumber & "')"
      Me!taxNumber = UCase(Replace(Me!taxNumber, " ", ""))
      i = DCount("partnerID", "tblPtr_Partners", strWhere)
      If i <> 0 Then
        Beep
        resp = MsgBox("Partner z izbrano dav no  tevilko  e obstaja: " & DFirst("name1", "tblPtr_Partners", strWhere) & " " & DFirst("name2", "tblPtr_Partners", strWhere) & ".", vbInformation)
        Exit Sub
      End If
  End If
  
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblPtr_Partners", dbOpenDynaset, dbSeeChanges)
  rs.AddNew
  rs("name1") = Me!name1
  If Not IsNull(Me!name2) Then rs("name2") = Me!name2
  If Not IsNull(Me!taxNumber) Then rs("taxNumber") = Me!taxNumber
  rs("countryID") = currentCountryID
  rs.Update
  rs.Bookmark = rs.LastModified
  bpID = rs("partnerID")
  rs.Close
  Set rs = Nothing
    
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblPtr_PartnersCmpys", dbOpenDynaset, dbSeeChanges)
  rs.AddNew
    rs("partnerID") = bpID
    rs("companyID") = currentCompanyID()
    rs("isEmployee") = Abs(Me!isEmployee)
    rs.Update
  rs.Close
  Set rs = Nothing

  strWhere = "partnerID=" & bpID

  If Me!isEmployee = 0 Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BP", acNormal, , strWhere, acFormEdit
  Else
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmp_Employee", acNormal, , strWhere, acFormEdit
  End If
  
  DoCmd.Close acForm, "frmPtr_BPAddNew"
    
End Sub

  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BP", acNormal, , "partnerID=" & Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.Column(0), acFormEdit

End Sub

Private Sub cmdAddEmployee_Click()

  Call AddExistingPartner(1)
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmEmp_Employee", acNormal, , "partnerID = " & Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.Column(0), acFormEdit

End Sub

Private Sub lstFURS_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim cmpyID As Long, strWhere As String, rs As DAO.Recordset, strSQL As String
   
  strWhere = "(taxNumber='" & Me!lstFURS.Column(0) & "') OR (taxNumber='SI" & Me!lstFURS.Column(0) & "')"
  
  If DCount("*", "tblPtr_partners", strWhere) <> 0 Then
    MsgBox "Poslovni partner  e obstaja v bazi. Dodajanje ni mogo e!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
    
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappPtr_DURS_addNew1"
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qappPtr_DURS_addNew2"
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
             
  DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BP", , , strWhere, acFormEdit

End Sub

Private Sub CmdFilterOn_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, qDef As QueryDef, newPartner1 As String
  
  If IsNull(Me!newPartner) Then
    newPartner1 = "!!!!!!!!xxx"
    Beep
  Else
    newPartner1 = Me!newPartner
  End If

  Call CreateQry1(282, newPartner1)
  Call CreateQry1(283, newPartner1)
  Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.RowSource = "qryPtr_ExistingPartners"
  Me!lstAllBusinessPartners = Null
  Me!lstFURS.RowSource = "qryPtr_DURS"
  Me!lstFURS = Null
  
  If DCount("*", "qryPtr_ExistingPartners") = 0 And DCount("*", "qryPtr_DURS") = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Partner ne obstaja. Partnerja dodaj ro no.", vbInformation
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub newPartner_AfterUpdate()
  Call CmdFilterOn_Click
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()

  Me!newPartner = Null

  Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.RowSource = ""
  Me!lstFURS.RowSource = ""

End Sub

  DoCmd.Close acForm, "frmPtr_BPNew"
  
End Sub

Public Sub AddExistingPartner(isEmployee As Integer)
Dim cmpyID As Long, strWhere As String, rs As DAO.Recordset, strSQL As String
   
  cmpyID = currentCompanyID()
  
'  strWHERE = "(taxNumber='" & Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.Column(1) & "')"
'
'  If DCount("*", "tblPtr_partners", strWHERE) <> 0 Then
'    MsgBox "Partner z dav no  tevilko " & Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.Column(1) & "  e obstaja v trenutno aktivnem podjetju. Dodajanje ni mogo e!"
'    Exit Sub
'  End If
  
  strWhere = "(partnerID=" & Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.Column(0) & ") AND (companyID=" & cmpyID & ")"

  If DCount("*", "tblPtr_PartnersCmpys", strWhere) = 0 Then
    Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblPtr_PartnersCmpys")
    rs.AddNew
    rs("partnerID") = Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.Column(0)
    rs("companyID") = cmpyID
    rs("costCenterID") = currentCostCenterID()
    rs("isEmployee") = isEmployee
    rs("bpRef") = "SI00"
    rs("meansOfPaymentGroupID") = DFirst("meansOfPaymentGroupID", "tblAccPmt_MeansOfPaymentGroups", "meansOfPaymentGroupType='isBankAccount'")
    rs.Update
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
  Else
    MsgBox "Partner z ID=" & Me!lstAllBusinessPartners.Column(0) & " e obstaja v trenutno aktivnem podjetju."
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDoubledBp_Click()
  If DCount("*", "qryPtr_BPDoubledCmpyPartners") = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napake ne obstajajo!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptPtr_bpDoubledCmpyPartners", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub strFilter_AfterUpdate()
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!strFilter) Then
    Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form.Filter = "partnerName Like '*" & Me!strFilter & "*' Or taxNumber Like '*" & Me!strFilter & "*'"
    If Not Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form.FilterOn = True Then Me.frmPtr_BPssub.Form.FilterOn = True
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim resp As Integer
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset, i As Integer
  
  Beep
  resp = MsgBox("Ali  eli  izbrisati: " & Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form!partnerName & "?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
  If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblPtr_PartnersCmpys WHERE (partnerID=" & Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form!partnerID & ") AND (companyID=" & currentCompanyID & ");")
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblPtr_Partners WHERE partnerID=" & Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form!partnerID & ";")
  Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form, "partnerID", Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form!partnerID)
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
  
  Me!strFilter = Null
  Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form.Filter = ""
  Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Form.FilterOn = False
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
  
  If IsNull(Me!companyID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Izberi podjetje!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
   
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPtr_BPNew", acNormal
 
End Sub

  Me!frmPtr_BPssub.Requery
End Sub

Option Compare Database

Private Sub CmdAll_Click()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form
  
  frmName = "frmPtr_BP"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!IBAN = Me!bpIBAN
    frm!BIC = Me!bpBIC
    frm!street = Me!bpStreet
    frm!bpPlace = Me!bpPlace
    frm.SetFocus
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Else
    Beep
    MsgBox "Forma poslovni partnerji ni odprta.", vbInformation
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub CmdOnlyIBAN_Click()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form
  
  frmName = "frmPtr_BP"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    frm!IBAN = Me!bpIBAN
    frm!BIC = Me!bpBIC
    frm.SetFocus
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Else
    Beep
    MsgBox "Forma poslovni partnerji ni odprta.", vbInformation
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub CmdPlus1_Click()
  Me!partnerID2_1 = Me!partnerID1_1 - 1
  Me!partnerID2 = Me!partnerID2_1
  Me!partnerData2.Requery
  Me!partnerData2 = Me!partnerID2_1
  Me!companyData2.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdReplacePartner_Click()

  If IsNull(Me!partnerID1) Or IsNull(Me!partnerID2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Ob partnerja morata biti izbrana!"
    Exit Sub
  End If

  If (Me!partnerID1) = (Me!partnerID2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Partnerja morata biti razli na!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
 
  Call RunMySQL("CALL P_ShrdBP_ReplaceBP(" & Me!partnerID1 & ", " & Me!partnerID2 & ");")
  
  Me!partnerID1_1 = Null
  Me!partnerID2_1 = Null
  Call partnerID1_1_AfterUpdate
  Call partnerID2_1_AfterUpdate
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID1_1_AfterUpdate()
  Me!partnerID1 = Me!partnerID1_1
  Me!partnerData1.Requery
  Me!partnerData1 = Me!partnerID1_1
  Me!companyData1.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub partnerID1_1_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form
  
  frmName = "frmAccARAP"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    Me!partnerID1_1 = frm!frmAccARAP_Sums.Form!partnerID
    Call partnerID1_1_AfterUpdate
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub canceledAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  
  If Me!documentStatusID = 3 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Stornirati je mo no samo predra une.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Not IsNull(Me!canceledAt) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Stornirati je mo no samo predra une.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
    
  If IsNull(Me!canceledAt) Then
    Me!canceledAt = Now
    RunMySQL ("DELETE FROM tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders WHERE (exportedAt IS NULL) AND documentID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID)
    Me!frmPurchaseInvoicePaymentOrders.Form.Requery
  Else
    Me!canceledAt = Null
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub lockedAt_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer

  If Not IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    If DDVOisLocked(Me!purchaseInvoiceID) = True Then
      Beep
      MsgBox "Ra un je vklju en v obra un DDV. Odklepanje ni mogo e.", vbInformation
      Exit Sub
    End If
    If Not IsNull(DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "parentTableID=67 AND parentID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID)) Then
      Beep
      resp = MsgBox("Pred odklepanjem bo izbrisana knji ba v GK. Nadaljujem?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
      If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
      Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoicePostingDetails WHERE purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID)
      Me!frmPurchaseInvoicePostingDetails.Requery
      Call DeletePurchaseInvoicePostings(Me, Me!purchaseInvoiceID)
      Me!lockedAt = Null
    Else
      Me!lockedAt = Null
    End If
  Else
    'If Not (Abs(n(DLookup("diff", "qryTourSales_unlockedPurchaseInvoicesSub2", "purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID))) < 1) Then
    '  Beep
    '  MsgBox "Razporejeni znesek se ne ujema z zneskom ra una.", vbInformation
    '  Exit Sub
    'Else
      Me!lockedAt = Now()
    'End If
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdCreatePosting_Click()
  If (Me!postingTypeID = 4 Or Me!postingTypeID = 5) And IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
    MsgBox "Ra un mora biti zaklenjen!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If (Me!documentStatusID <> 3) Then
    MsgBox "Knji iti je mo no samo ra un!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  Call CreatePurchaseInvoicePosting(Me!purchaseInvoiceID, True, Me!postingTypeID, Me!documentTypeID)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFillPostingDetails_Click()
Dim qDef As QueryDef, resp As Integer

  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
  Call CheckGLAccounts(Me)
  Call CheckDates(Me)
    
  If IsVatOK(Me) = False Then
      Beep
      resp = MsgBox("Preveri DDV. Ali naj nadaljujem?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
      If resp <> vbYes Then End
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!postingTypeID) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox " asovna porazdelitev stro kov ni izbrana!", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoicePostingDetails WHERE purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID)

  DoCmd.SetWarnings False
  Select Case Me!postingTypeID
    Case 1:
      Set qDef = CurrentDb.QueryDefs("qappPurchaseInvoicePostingDetails_S2")
      qDef.Parameters("invID") = Me!purchaseInvoiceID
      qDef.Execute
    Case 2:
      Call PreparePurchaseInvPostingDetails_Months(Me!purchaseInvoiceID, Me!serviceFirstDate, Me!serviceLastDate, Me!purchaseInvoiceAmount)
    Case 3:
      Call PreparePurchaseInvPostingDetails_Days(Me!purchaseInvoiceID, Me!serviceFirstDate, Me!serviceLastDate, Me!purchaseInvoiceAmount)
    Case Is > 3:
      If IsNull(Me!lockedAt) Then
        MsgBox "Ra un mora biti zaklenjen!"
        Exit Sub
      End If
        
      If Not (Abs(n(DLookup("diff", "qryTourSales_unlockedPurchaseInvoicesSub2", "purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID))) < 1) Then
        Beep
        MsgBox "Razporejeni znesek se ne ujema z zneskom ra una.", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
      End If
  
      Call CreateQry1(126, Me!purchaseInvoiceID, currentCompanyID(), currentCountryID())
      Call RunMySQL
      Call CreateQry1(210, Me!purchaseInvoiceID, currentCompanyID())
      Call RunMySQL
      
  End Select
  DoCmd.SetWarnings True
  
  Me!frmPurchaseInvoicePostingDetails.Requery
  Me!PostingDetailsSum.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFillPostingDetailsDelete_Click()
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoicePostingDetails WHERE purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID)
  Me!frmPurchaseInvoicePostingDetails.Requery
  Me!PostingDetailsSum.Requery
  Beep
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFillVAT_Click()
  
  If Me!excludedFromDDVO = 1 Then Exit Sub

  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  Call CheckDates(Me)
  
  If DCount("*", "tblPtr_bpDDVOItems", "partnerID=" & Me!partnerID) = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox ("Na poslovnem partnerju ne obstajajo podatki o vrsti obra una DDV! DDV je potrebno dodati ro no! Vstopni DDV ima predznak minus!")
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call CreateQry1(302, Me!purchaseInvoiceID, currentCountryID)
  Call RunMySQL
   
  Me!frmPurchaseInvoiceVat.SetFocus
  Me!frmPurchaseInvoiceVat.Requery
  
  Call IsVatOK(Me)

End Sub

Private Sub cmdCreatePaymentOrders_Click()

  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  
  If Me!documentTypeID = 23 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Kreiranje pla ilnih nalogov ni mogo e - Execution Costs.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If

  If IsNull(Me!meansOfPaymentGroupID) Then
    Me!partnerID.Requery
    Call PurchaseInvoiceBPidAfterUpdate(Me)
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!meansOfPaymentGroupID) Then
    MsgBox "Pla ilni nalog ne bo kreiran, ker je polje na in pla ila prazmo.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Me!meansOfPaymentGroupID.Column(2) <> "isBankAccount" Then
    MsgBox "Pla ilni nalog ne bo kreiran, ker ni izbran na in pla ila TRR.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call CreatePurchaseInvoicePaymentOrder(Me!purchaseInvoiceID, Me)
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form, rowIndex As Integer
  
  If IsNull(Me!purchaseInvoiceID) Then Exit Sub
  frmName = "frmPurchaseInvoices"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(frm, "purchaseInvoiceID", Me!purchaseInvoiceID)
  End If
  
  frmName = "frmAccARAP"
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Set frm = Forms(frmName)
    rowIndex = frm!lstDocuments.ListIndex
    frm!lstDocuments.Requery
    frm!lstDocuments.Selected(rowIndex + 1) = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub purchaseInvoiceDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer

  If Year(Me!purchaseInvoiceDate) <> currentFiscalYear() Then
    resp = MsgBox("Datum ra una ni v letu " & currentFiscalYear() & ", ki je trenutno aktivno! Ali naj nadaljujem?", vbExclamation + vbYesNo)
    If resp = vbNo Then Cancel = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub purchaseInvoiceDate_AfterUpdate()
Dim d
  d = DLookup("paymentDelay", "tblPtr_bpCmpyPaymentTerms", "partnerID=" & Me!partnerID)
  
  If IsNull(d) Then d = 0
  
  If Me!purchaseInvoiceDate + d < Date Then
    Me!dueDate = Date
  Else
    Me!dueDate = Me!purchaseInvoiceDate + d
  End If
    
  If MonthIsOpened(Me!purchaseInvoiceDate) = 1 Then
    Me!vatDate = Me!purchaseInvoiceDate
  End If
  
  If YearIsOpened(Year(Me!purchaseInvoiceDate)) Then
     Me!serviceFirstDate = Me!purchaseInvoiceDate
     Me!serviceLastDate = Me!purchaseInvoiceDate
  Else
    MsgBox "Leto je zaklju eno! Ra un je potrebno knji iti na izredne odhodke (in ne stro ke). Spremeni konto."
    Me!serviceFirstDate = Date
    Me!serviceLastDate = Date
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub serviceFirstDate_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)

  If IsNull(Me!purchaseInvoiceDate) Then
    MsgBox "Manjka datum ra una.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If YearIsOpened(Year(LastDayInMonth(Me!purchaseInvoiceDate, -1))) Then
     Me!serviceFirstDate = LastDayInMonth(Me!purchaseInvoiceDate, -1)
     Me!serviceLastDate = LastDayInMonth(Me!purchaseInvoiceDate, -1)
  Else
    MsgBox "Leto je zaklju eno! Ra un je potrebno knji iti na izredne odhodke. Spremeni konto."
    Me!serviceFirstDate = Date
    Me!serviceLastDate = Date
  End If
  
End Sub

End Sub

Private Sub vatDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
  
  If IsNull(Me!vatDate) Then Exit Sub
  If MonthIsOpened(Me!vatDate) = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Mesec ni odprt. Vnos ni mo en.", vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Year(Me!vatDate) <> currentFiscalYear() Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Datum prejema ra una ni v letu " & currentFiscalYear() & ", ki je trenutno aktivno! Preveri vnos.", vbExclamation
  End If
  
End Sub


Private Sub serviceFirstDate_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
  
  If Year(Me!serviceFirstDate) <> currentFiscalYear() Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Datum storitve 1 ni v letu " & currentFiscalYear() & ", ki je trenutno aktivno! Vnos ni mo en.", vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub serviceFirstDate_AfterUpdate()
  If IsNull(Me!serviceLastDate) Then Me!serviceLastDate = Me!serviceFirstDate
End Sub

Private Sub serviceLastDate_AfterUpdate()

  If Year(Me!serviceLastDate) <> currentFiscalYear() Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Datum storitve 2 ni v letu " & currentFiscalYear() & ", ki je trenutno aktivno! Preveri vnos.", vbExclamation
  End If
  
  If (Month(Me!serviceLastDate) <> Month(Me!serviceFirstDate)) Or (Year(Me!serviceLastDate) <> Year(Me!serviceFirstDate)) Then
    Me!postingTypeID = 2
  End If
  
End Sub

Public Function DDVOisLocked(invID As Long) As Boolean
Dim strSQL As String, rs As DAO.Recordset

  DDVOisLocked = False

  strSQL = "SELECT tblAccVat_DDVODetails.ddvoDetailID " & _
           "FROM (tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs INNER JOIN tblTourPurchase_PurchaseSalesLinks ON tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs.purchaseInvoiceSubID = tblTourPurchase_PurchaseSalesLinks.purchaseInvoiceSubID) " & _
           "INNER JOIN tblAccVat_DDVODetails ON tblTourPurchase_PurchaseSalesLinks.purchaseSalesLinkID = tblAccVat_DDVODetails.purchaseSalesLinkID " & _
           "WHERE (((tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs.purchaseInvoiceID)=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID & "));"
  
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
  If rs.RecordCount = 0 Then Exit Function
  
  If rs.RecordCount <> 0 Then
    DDVOisLocked = True
  End If
  
  
End Function

Private Sub CmdOpenFinishedAt_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccPI_CreateInvoicesFromPrepaired"
End Sub

  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptDocAcc_PI_1", acViewReport
End Sub

  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptDocAcc_PI", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub CmdPrintVatBook_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptDocAcc_PI_vatBook", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub documentStatusID_AfterUpdate()

  Call documentTypeID_AfterUpdate
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
  
  DoCmd.MoveSize 500, 500, 28000, 15000
  If YearIsOpened(currentFiscalYear()) = 0 Then
    Me!cmdNew.enabled = False
    Me!cmdPostAll.enabled = False
  End If
  Me.RecordSource = "qryAccPI"
  
End Sub

Private Sub documentTypeID_AfterUpdate()
Dim qryID As Long

  If Me!documentTypeID = 23 Then
    qryID = 232
  Else
    qryID = 1
  End If
  
  Call CreateQry1(qryID, currentCompanyID(), currentFiscalYear(), Me!documentTypeID, Me!documentStatusID)
  
  Me.RecordSource = "qryAccPI"
  
  If Me!documentTypeID = 6 Or Me!documentTypeID = 23 Then
    Me!cmdPostAll.visible = True
  Else
    Me!cmdPostAll.visible = False
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPostAll_Click()
  
  Call AutoGGPurchaseInvoicePosting
  Me!status = Null
  Me.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdNew_Click()
  
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPurchaseInvoice", acNormal, , , acFormAdd

End Sub

Private Sub CmdDelete_Click()
Dim strSQL As String

  Call DeletePurchaseInvoice(Me, Me!purchaseInvoiceID)
  
  Me.RecordSource = "qryAccPI"
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPI_Err_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qryAccVat_Errors"
End Sub

Private Sub noOfScans_Click()

If Me!documentTypeID = 23 Then
  Call OpenScan(261, Me!purchaseInvoiceSubID)
Else
  Call OpenScan(67, Me!purchaseInvoiceID)
End If

End Sub

Private Sub purchaseInvoiceNumber_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frm As Form

  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPurchaseInvoice", acNormal, , "purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID, acFormEdit
  Set frm = Forms!frmPurchaseInvoice.Form
  If Me!documentTypeID = 4 Then
    frm!cmdCreateAllChildren.visible = False
    frm!cmdFillVAT.visible = False
    frm!cmdFillPostingDetails.visible = False
    frm!cmdCreatePosting.visible = False
  End If
  
  If frm!vatTaxationTypeID = 3 Or frm!vatTaxationTypeID = 3 Then
    frm!cmdFillVAT.visible = False
  Else
    frm!cmdFillVAT.visible = True
  End If
  
  frm!frmAccGL_PostingSub.Form!postName.ColumnWidth = 2000
  Call IsVatOK(frm)
  
End Sub

Private Sub strFilter_AfterUpdate()
  If Not IsNull(Me!strFilter) Then
    Me.Filter = "purchaseInvoiceNumber Like '*" & Me!strFilter & "*' Or bpName Like '*" & Me!strFilter & "*'"
    If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
 
 Me!strFilter = Null
 Me.Filter = ""
 Me.FilterOn = False
 
End Sub

Private Sub vatBase_AfterUpdate()
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
  
  'Set rs = Me.RecordsetClone
  If Not IsNull(Me!vatRateDDVOItemID.Column(2)) Then
    Me!vatAmount = Round(Me!vatBase * Me!vatRateDDVOItemID.Column(2), 2)
  End If

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdPostCRSales_Click()
Dim strWhere, computID As Long, postingID, resp As Integer, ptrID As Long, strSQL As String

  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Then
     Beep
     MsgBox ("Izberi restavracijo!")
     Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!m) Then
     Beep
     MsgBox ("Izberi mesec!")
     Exit Sub
  End If
  
  strWhere = "Prod" & Me!costCenterID.Column(2) & "_" & Format(Me!m, "00") & "." & Me!Yr
  postingID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "postingName='" & strWhere & "'")
  
  If IsNull(postingID) Then
      computID = computerID()
      DoCmd.Hourglass True
      
      Call RunSQL("DELETE * FROM tblTempAccGL_Posting;")
      
      Call CreateQry(78, Me!costCenterID, Me!m, Me!companyID, , computID)               'terjatve
      Call RunMySQL
      
      Call CreateQry(211, Me!costCenterID, Me!m, Me!companyID, , computID)               'terjatve - KK provizija
      Call RunMySQL

      Call CreateQry(155, Me!costCenterID, , , , Format(Me!m, "00"), Me!Yr, computID)   'DDV
      Call RunMySQL

      Call CreateQry(79, Me!costCenterID, Me!m, , , computID)                           'prihodki
      Call RunMySQL
      
      Call CreateQry(156, Me!costCenterID, Me!m, , , computID)                          'odpis
      Call RunMySQL

      ptrID = DLookup("partnerID", "tblCmpy_Companies", "companyID=" & currentCompanyID())
      Call CreateQry(157, Me!costCenterID, Me!m, , , computID, FindGLAccountID("470000"), ptrID)    'odpis
      Call RunMySQL

      Call CreatePostingMySQL

      Beep
      DoCmd.Hourglass False
      
      strSQL = "UPDATE tblAccGL_PostingSubs INNER JOIN tblAccGL_Postings ON tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingID = tblAccGL_Postings.postingID SET tblAccGL_PostingSubs.documentID = tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingSubID " & _
               "WHERE (Left(tblAccGL_Postings.postingName,4) = 'prod') AND (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.documentID=0);"
      Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  End If
      
  If IsNull(postingID) Then
    postingID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "postingName='" & strWhere & "'")
  End If
  
  If Not IsNull(postingID) Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & postingID
  Else
    MsgBox "Ne najdem temeljnice!"
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPrint_Click()
Dim rpt As Report
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSelectRecord
  
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Or IsNull(m1) Or IsNull(m2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjkajo parametri!", vbInformation
  End If
  
  Call CreateQry(38, Me!costCenterID, Me!m1, Me!m2)
  
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptSalesCR_SalesPerMonth", acViewReport
  Set rpt = Reports("rptSalesCR_SalesPerMonth")
  
  If Me!rptName = 1 Then
    rpt.Detail.visible = True
  Else
    rpt.Detail.visible = False
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdQry_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qrySalesCR_SalesPerMonth"
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRefresh_Click()
Dim rpt As Report
  DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSelectRecord
  
  If IsNull(Me!costCenterID) Or IsNull(m1) Or IsNull(m2) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Manjkajo parametri!", vbInformation
  End If
  
  Call CreateQry(38, Me!costCenterID, Me!m1, Me!m2)
  Me!rptSalesCR.SourceObject = "Report.rptSalesCR_SalesPerMonth"
'  Set rpt = Reports("rptSalesCR_SalesPerMonth")
  
  If Me!rptName = 1 Then
    Me!rptSalesCR.Report.Detail.visible = True
  Else
    Me!rptSalesCR.Report.Detail.visible = False
  End If

End Sub

Private Sub costCenterID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!companyID = Me!costCenterID.Column(2)
End Sub

Option Compare Database

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
'On Error Resume Next
Dim i

  If IsNull(Forms.frmOfficeInvoice.Form!officeInvoiceID) Then
    Cancel = True
    Beep
    MsgBox "Najprej izpolni podatke v glavi ra una!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  i = DMax("sequence", "tblOfficeInvoiceDetails", "officeInvoiceID = " & (Forms.frmOfficeInvoice.Form!officeInvoiceID))
  If IsNull(i) Then sequence = 1 Else sequence = i + 1
  
End Sub

Private Sub productID_AfterUpdate()
  Me!productName = Me!productID.Column(1)
  Me!purchasePrice = Me!productID.Column(2)
  If Me!productID.Column(5) = True Then Me!salesPrice = Me!productID.Column(3) / (1 + Me!productID.Column(6)) Else Me!salesPrice = Me!productID.Column(3)
  Me!vatRateID = Me!productID.Column(4)
End Sub

  Me!lstEmploymentTypeTaxID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub lstEmploymentTypeTaxID_Click()
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset

  Beep
  If IsNull(Me!lstEmploymentTypeTaxID) Or Me!lstEmploymentTypeTaxID = "" Then Exit Sub

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblShrdEmpemploymentTypeTaxes", dbOpenDynaset)
  
  rs.FindFirst "(employmentTypeTaxID)=" & (Me!lstEmploymentTypeTaxID)
  rs.delete
  
  Me!lstUnassignedTaxID.Requery
  Me!lstEmploymentTypeTaxID.Requery
  
End Sub

Private Sub lstUnassignedTaxID_Click()
Dim rs As DAO.Recordset

  Beep
  If IsNull(Me!lstUnassignedTaxID) Or Me!lstUnassignedTaxID = "" Then Exit Sub

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("tblShrdEmpemploymentTypeTaxes")
  rs.AddNew
  rs("employmentTypeID") = Me!employmentTypeID
  rs("wageTaxID") = Me!lstUnassignedTaxID
  rs("toBePayed") = Me!payed
  rs.Update
  
  Me!lstUnassignedTaxID.Requery
  Me!lstEmploymentTypeTaxID.Requery

End Sub

           "WHERE (((tblShrdEmpWageTypeSubSubMultipliers.wageTypeSubSubMultiplierID) Is Null));"

Private Sub CmdChangeNoOfPurchases_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
Dim varItm As Variant

  If Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox " t. izbranih vrstic je ni !"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!newNoOfPurchases) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napa no  t. nabav!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
   strSQL = "UPDATE tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs SET noOfPurchases = " & Me!newNoOfPurchases & " WHERE ggInvoiceSubID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm)
   Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Next varItm
  
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDeleteLine_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
Dim varItm As Variant
Dim purchAm As Double
Dim vat
  If IsNull(Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0)) Then
    MsgBox "Izberi vrstico!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    If Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(14, varItm) <> 0 Then
      MsgBox "Brisati je mo no samo vrstice z nabavno vrednostjo 0!"
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next varItm
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    vat = DLookup("ABS(vatBaseAmount)+ABS(vatAmount)", "tblAccVat_DDVODetails", "purchaseSalesLinkID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm))
    If vat = 0 Or IsNull(vat) Then
      If vat = 0 Then
        strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblAccVat_DDVODetails WHERE (vatBaseAmount=0) AND (vatAmount=0) AND purchaseSalesLinkID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm)
        Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
      End If
      strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblTourPurchase_PurchaseSalesLinks WHERE purchaseSalesLinkID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm)
      Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
    Else
      MsgBox "Vrstica linkID: " & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm) & "je vklju ena v obra un DDV. Brisnaje ni mogo e."
    End If
  Next varItm
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRefresh_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
    
  strSQL = "qryTourPurchase_ChangeNoOfExpPurchaseLinks"
  If IsNull(Me!D1) And IsNull(Me!D2) Then

  Else
    If IsNull(Me!D1) Or IsNull(Me!D2) Then
      MsgBox "Izbrana morata biti oba datuma!"
      Exit Sub
    Else
      strSQL = "SELECT qryTourPurchase_ChangeNoOfExpPurchaseLinks.* FROM qryTourPurchase_ChangeNoOfExpPurchaseLinks WHERE Int(CDate(invDate)) Between Int(CDate('" & Me!D1 & "')) and Int(CDate('" & Me!D2 & "'));"
    End If
  End If

  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.RowSource = strSQL
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdUnhide1_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
Dim varItm As Variant
Dim resp As String
Dim i As String
  
'  resp = InputBox("Geslo:")
'  If resp <> "271898" Then
'    MsgBox ("Napa no geslo.")
'    Exit Sub
'  End If
'
  
  If IsNull(Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0)) Then
    MsgBox "Izberi vrstico!"
    Exit Sub
  End If

  i = Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(4)
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    If Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(4, varItm) <> i Then
      MsgBox "Razkriti je mo no vrstice samo na enem ra unu hkrati!"
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next varItm

  If Me!sum <> 0 Then
      MsgBox "Vrednost polja sum mora biti 0!"
      Exit Sub
  End If
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    strSQL = "UPDATE tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs SET hide=0 WHERE ggInvoiceSubID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(1, varItm)
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Next varItm
  Me!sum = 0
  
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub lstggInvoiceSubID_AfterUpdate()
Dim varItm As Variant

  Me!sum = 0
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    Me!sum = Me!sum + Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(10, varItm) * Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(11, varItm)
  Next varItm

End Sub

Private Sub qryName_AfterUpdate()
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.RowSource = Me!qryName.Column(0)
End Sub

  Me!sum = 0
End Sub

Private Sub CmdCreateInvoice_Click()
Dim i As Integer
Dim resp As Integer
Dim strSQL As String
Dim strWhere
Dim varItm As Variant

  i = Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.ItemsSelected.Count
  If i = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Izberi vsaj en ra un!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  strWhere = "(documentTypeID=6 OR documentTypeID=23) AND documentStatusID=3 AND companyID=" & currentCompanyID
  For Each varItm In Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.ItemsSelected
      If Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.Column(4, varItm) = "" Then
        strSQL = "UPDATE tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices SET purchaseInvoiceNumber = 'PR-11-" & Format(Right(DMax("purchaseInvoiceNumber", "tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices", strWhere), 6) + 1, "000000") & "', documentStatusID = 3, vatDate=Date(Now()), lockedAt = Now(), finishedAt = Now() " & _
                "WHERE purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.Column(0, varItm)
        Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
      End If
      
  Next varItm
  
  Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
  Me!countryID = Null
  Call qryName_AfterUpdate
End Sub

Private Sub countryID_AfterUpdate()
  If IsNull(Me!countryID) Then
    Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.RowSource = Me!qryName.Column(0)
  Else
    If Right(Me!qryName, 1) < 2 Then
      Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.RowSource = "SELECT " & Me!qryName & ".* FROM " & Me!qryName & " WHERE countryID=" & Me!countryID & ";"
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub lstPurchaseInvoiceID_AfterUpdate()
  If Right(Me!qryName, 1) = 0 Then
    Call CreateQry1(301, Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.Column(0))
    Me.lstSub1.Requery
  End If
End Sub

Private Sub qryName_AfterUpdate()

  Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.RowSource = Me!qryName.Column(0)
  Me!countryID = Null
  If Right(Me!qryName.Column(0), 1) < 2 Then
    Me!countryID.visible = True
  Else
    Me!countryID.visible = False
  End If
    Call CreateQry1(301, 0)
    Me.lstSub1.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDeleteInvoice_Click()
Dim i As Integer
Dim resp As Integer
Dim strSQL As String
Dim varItm As Variant

  i = Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.ItemsSelected.Count
  If i = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Izberi vsaj en ra un!"
    Exit Sub
  Else
    resp = MsgBox("Izbri em izbrane ra un (" & i & ")?", vbCritical + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  End If
  For Each varItm In Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.ItemsSelected
  
    If Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.Column(8, varItm) = 0 Then
      strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices WHERE purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.Column(0, varItm)
      Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
     Else
       MsgBox "Ra un je vklju en v obra un DDV. Brisanje ni mogo e!"
     End If
  Next varItm
  Me!lstPurchaseInvoiceID.Requery

End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdChangeNoOfPurchases_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
Dim varItm As Variant

  If Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox " t. izbranih vrstic je ni !"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!newNoOfPurchases) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "V kaj naj spremenim?"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
   strSQL = "UPDATE tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs SET noOfPurchases = " & Me!newNoOfPurchases & " WHERE ggInvoiceSubID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm)
   Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Next varItm
  
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdClearFilter_Click()
  Me!diff = 1
  Me!productID = Null
  Me!countryID = Null
  Call cmdRequery1_Click
End Sub

Private Sub CmdQry_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qry1"
End Sub

Private Sub CmdQry2_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qry2"
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRequery1_Click()
Dim pmt04, pmt05, pmt06
  Select Case Me!diff
    Case 1: pmt04 = "diff<>0"
    Case 2: pmt04 = "diff=0"
    Case 3: pmt04 = "1=1"
  End Select
  If IsNull(Me!productID) Then pmt05 = "1=1" Else pmt05 = "productID=" & Me!productID
  If IsNull(Me!countryID) Then pmt06 = "1=1" Else pmt06 = "countryID=" & Me!countryID
  Call CreateQry1(298, currentCompanyID, SQLDate(D1), SQLDate(D2), pmt04, pmt05, pmt06)
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.RowSource = "qryTourPurchaseErr_WrongNoOfPurchases"
End Sub

Private Sub CmdResetDates_Click()
  Me!D1 = IIf(Month(Date) < 7, CDate("01.07." & Year(Date) - 1), CDate("01.07." & Year(Date)))
  Me!D2 = IIf(Month(Date) < 7, CDate("30.06." & Year(Date)), CDate("30.06." & Year(Date) + 1))
  Call cmdRequery1_Click
End Sub

Private Sub diff_AfterUpdate()
  Me!productID = Null
  Call cmdRequery1_Click
End Sub

Private Sub lstggInvoiceSubID_AfterUpdate()
  productID = Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(8)
  newNoOfPurchases = Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(13) + 1
End Sub


Private Sub lstggInvoiceSubID_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frm As Form
    Call CreateQry1(299, Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(17))
    Call CreateQry1(292, Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(17), "AND (tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs.hide=0)")
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmTourSales_ggInvoice", acNormal
    Set frm = Forms!frmTourSales_ggInvoice.Form
    frm.Caption = "Invoice: " & frm!ggInvoiceNumber
End Sub

Private Sub CmdChangeNoOfPurchases_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
Dim varItm As Variant

  If Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox " t. izbranih vrstic je ni !"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!newNoOfPurchases) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napa no  t. nabav!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
   strSQL = "UPDATE tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs SET noOfPurchases = " & Me!newNoOfPurchases & " WHERE ggInvoiceSubID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm)
   Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Next varItm
  
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDeleteLine_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
Dim varItm As Variant
  If IsNull(Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0)) Then
    MsgBox "Izberi vrstico!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    strSQL = "DELETE FROM tblTourPurchase_PurchaseSalesLinks WHERE purchaseSalesLinkID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm)
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Next varItm
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub cmdDeleteDates_Click()
  Me!D1 = Null
  Me!D2 = Null
  Call CmdRefresh_Click
End Sub

Private Sub CmdRefresh_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
    
  strSQL = "qryTourPurchase_ChangeNoOfExpPurchaseLinks"
  If IsNull(Me!D1) And IsNull(Me!D2) Then

  Else
    If IsNull(Me!D1) Or IsNull(Me!D2) Then
      MsgBox "Izbrana morata biti oba datuma!"
      Exit Sub
    Else
      strSQL = "SELECT qryTourPurchase_ChangeNoOfExpPurchaseLinks.* FROM qryTourPurchase_ChangeNoOfExpPurchaseLinks WHERE Int(CDate(" & Me!fltrDate & ")) Between Int(CDate('" & Me!D1 & "')) and Int(CDate('" & Me!D2 & "'));"
    End If
  End If
  
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.RowSource = strSQL
  
End Sub

  Me!newNoOfPurchases = Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(14) + 1

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub CmdChangeNoOfPurchases_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
Dim varItm As Variant

  If Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected.Count = 0 Then
    Beep
    MsgBox " t. izbranih vrstic je ni !"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!newNoOfPurchases) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Napa no  t. nabav!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  For Each varItm In Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    strSQL = "UPDATE tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs SET noOfPurchases = " & Me!newNoOfPurchases & " WHERE ggInvoiceSubID=" & Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm)
    Call RunMySQL(strSQL)
  Next varItm
  
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Requery
  Beep
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdCreateNewPI_Click()

Dim varItm As Variant, frm As Form, computID As Long
Dim db As Database, rs As DAO.Recordset, rs1 As DAO.Recordset
Dim invID As Long, strSQL As String, D1 As Date, D2 As Date
  
  Set frm = Me
  computID = computerID()
  Set db = CurrentDb
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTemp WHERE computerID=" & computID)
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblTemp", dbOpenDynaset)
  For Each varItm In frm!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    rs.AddNew
    rs("id") = frm!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(0, varItm)
    rs("id1") = Format(frm!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(3, varItm), "yyyymm")
    rs("amount") = frm!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(10, varItm)
    rs("computerID") = computID
    rs.Update
  Next varItm
  rs.Close
  
  strSQL = "SELECT id1, Sum(amount) AS am FROM tblTemp WHERE computerID = " & computID & " GROUP BY id1 ORDER BY id1;"
  Set rs1 = db.OpenRecordset(strSQL, dbOpenDynaset)
  rs1.MoveFirst
  
  If IsNull(Me!partnerID) Then
    MsgBox "Manjka dobavitelj.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
'  If IsNull(Me!supplierRefInformation) Then
'    MsgBox "Manjka referenca.", vbInformation
'    Exit Sub
'  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!supplierInvoiceNumber) Then
    MsgBox "Manjka dobaviteljeva  tevilka ra una.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices", dbOpenDynaset)
  Do While Not rs1.EOF
      D1 = CDate("01." & Right(rs1("id1"), 2) & "." & Left(rs1("id1"), 4))
      D2 = LastDayInMonth(CDate("01." & Right(rs1("id1"), 2) & "." & Left(rs1("id1"), 4)), 0)
      
      rs.AddNew
      rs("purchaseInvoiceNumber") = NewDocumentNumber("tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices", "purchaseInvoiceNumber", "PR", currentFiscalYear(), currentCompanyID(), True)
      rs("documentTypeID") = 6
      rs("documentStatusID") = Me!documentStatusID
      rs("purchaseInvoiceAmount") = rs1("am")
      rs("partnerID") = Me!partnerID
      rs("purchaseInvoiceDate") = Me!purchaseInvoiceDate
      rs("vatDate") = D2
      rs("serviceFirstDate") = D1
      rs("serviceLastDate") = D2
      rs("supplierInvoiceNumber") = Me!supplierInvoiceNumber
      rs("partnerID") = Me!partnerID
      rs("supplierRef") = "SI00"
      rs("supplierRefInformation") = "1"
      rs("excludedFromDDVO") = 1
      rs("templateNumber") = 1
      rs("postingTypeID") = 4
      rs("fltCustomID") = rs1("id1")
      rs("fiscalYear") = currentFiscalYear()
      rs("companyID") = currentCompanyID()
      rs.Update
      invID = DMax("purchaseInvoiceID", "tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices", "companyID=" & currentCompanyID())
      
    rs1.MoveNext
  Loop
  rs.Close
  
  DoCmd.SetWarnings (False)
  DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qupdTourPurch_CreatePurchaseSalesLinksSub")
  DoCmd.OpenQuery ("qappTourPurch_CreatePurchaseSalesLinks")
  DoCmd.SetWarnings (True)
  
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTemp WHERE computerID=" & computID)

  Call CmdFilterOn_Click
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdFilterOn_Click()
Dim strSQL As String
    
  strSQL = "qryTourPurchase_PurchaseSalesLinks"
  Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.RowSource = strSQL
  

End Sub

Private Sub lstggInvoiceSubID_AfterUpdate()
  'Me!newNoOfPurchases = Me!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(9) + 1
Dim varItm As Variant, frm As Form, frmsum As Form
Dim strSQL As String, rowIndex As Integer, Yr As Long

  Set frm = Me
  
  frm!salesSum = 0
  frm!expPurchaseSum = 0

  For Each varItm In frm!lstggInvoiceSubID.ItemsSelected
    frm!salesSum = frm!salesSum + frm!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(9, varItm)
    frm!expPurchaseSum = frm!expPurchaseSum + frm!lstggInvoiceSubID.Column(10, varItm)
  Next varItm
  
End Sub

Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub ComboHide_AfterUpdate()
  If ComboHide = 0 Then
    Call CreateQry1(292, Me!ggInvoiceID, "AND (tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs.hide=0)")
  Else
    Call CreateQry1(292, Me!ggInvoiceID, "")
  End If
  Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryTourSales_ggInvoiceSubDetails"
End Sub

Private Sub ComboHide_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim pass As String, frm As Form

  pass = InputBox("Geslo (eg):")
  If pass <> "271898" Then Exit Sub
  Set frm = Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form
  frm.AllowEdits = True
  frm!qty.Locked = False
  frm!salesPrice.Locked = False
  frm!salesDiscount.Locked = False
  frm!salesCommission.Locked = False
  
End Sub

Private Sub ggInvoiceNumber_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
  Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form.AllowEdits = True
End Sub

Private Sub ToggleSum_Click()


  If Me!ToggleSum.Value = False Then
    
    Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryTourSales_ggInvoiceSubDetails"
    Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form!actualNoOfPurchases.ColumnHidden = True
    Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form!partnerName.ColumnHidden = False
    Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form!partnerName.ColumnWidth = 2000

  Else
    
    Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form.RecordSource = "qryTourSales_ggInvoiceSubSums"
    
    Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form!actualNoOfPurchases.ColumnHidden = False
    Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form!actualNoOfPurchases.ColumnWidth = 900
    Me!frmTourSales_ggInvoiceSub.Form!partnerName.ColumnHidden = True
  
  End If

End Sub

CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub bookingNumber_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)

  If computerName() <> "ntbmitja4" Then Exit Sub
  
  If Me!documentStatusID = 3 Then
    MsgBox "Napa en status dokumenta !"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
    If currentCompanyID <> 1004 Then
    MsgBox "Napa no  podjetje!"
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmTourSales_MoveBookingTo11", acNormal
  
End Sub

Private Sub CmdDrnovsek_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenQuery "qryTourSales_DrnovsekMikolavcic"
End Sub

Private Sub CmdInvList_Click()
  DoCmd.OpenReport "rptSalesGG_InvoiceList", acViewReport
End Sub

Private Sub CmdPostVat_Click()
Dim postID, resp As Integer
  postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "postingName='DDV_T_" & currentFiscalYear() & "' AND companyID=" & currentCompanyID)
  If Not IsNull(postID) Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", acNormal, , "postingID=" & postID
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  Call RunMySQL("DELETE FROM tblTempAccGL_Posting WHERE computerID=" & computerID())
  Call CreateQry1(296, currentCompanyID, currentFiscalYear)
  DoCmd.SetWarnings False

Private Sub OpenARAP_Click()

  If Not Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
    Call OpenFormARAP
  End If

  DoCmd.Echo False

  DoCmd.Echo True

End Sub

Private Sub opened_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim resp As Integer, rs As DAO.Recordset, paymentDescription As String, frm As Form, lastPOID As Long, strSQL As String, GLAccountID As Long, poID
  
Set frm = Me

  If (n(frm!opened) > 0) Then
    resp = MsgBox("Znesek pla ilnega naloga je manj i od ni  oz. enak ni . Nadaljujem?", vbInformation + vbYesNo)
    If resp <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  End If
  
  poID = DLookup("paymentOrderID", "tblAccPmt_PaymentOrders", "parentTableID = 130 and parentID=" & frm!ggInvoiceID)
  
  If Not IsNull(poID) Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmaccPmtPO_paymentOrder", acNormal, , "paymentOrderID=" & poID
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  paymentDescription = "Vra ilo " & Me!bookingNumber & "/" & frm!ggInvoiceNumber
  strSQL = "SELECT tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts.receivablesGLAccountID " & _
           "FROM ((tblPtr_Partners INNER JOIN tblShrdGeo_Countries ON tblPtr_Partners.countryID = tblShrdGeo_Countries.countryID) INNER JOIN " & _
           "tblShrdGeo_CountryGroups ON tblShrdGeo_Countries.countryGroupID = tblShrdGeo_CountryGroups.countryGroupID) INNER JOIN " & _
           "tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts ON tblShrdGeo_CountryGroups.countryGroupID = tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts.countryGroupID " & _
           "WHERE (((tblPtr_Partners.partnerID) = " & frm!partnerID & ") And ((tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts.companyID) = currentCompanyID())) " & _
           "GROUP BY tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts.receivablesGLAccountID;"
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
  GLAccountID = rs("receivablesGLAccountID")
  
  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT tblPtr_Partners.* FROM tblPtr_Partners WHERE tblPtr_Partners.partnerID=" & frm!partnerID)
  lastPOID = NewPOID(frm!ggInvoiceID, 130, "REFU", paymentDescription, Date, -n(frm!opened), frm!partnerID, rs("name1") & " " & rs("name2"), rs("street"), rs("place"), rs("BIC"), rs("IBAN"), "SI00", "1", GLAccountID, "", frm!ggInvoiceID)
  If lastPOID = 0 Then Exit Sub
  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmaccPmtPO_paymentOrder", acNormal, , "paymentOrderID=" & lastPOID
  Call RequeryMe
End Sub

Private Sub strFilter_AfterUpdate()

  If Not IsNull(Me!strFilter) Then
    Me.Filter = "ggInvoiceNumber Like '*" & Me!strFilter & "*' Or bookingNumber Like '*" & Me!strFilter & "*' Or partnerName Like '*" & Me!strFilter & "*'"
    If Not Me.FilterOn Then Me.FilterOn = True
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFilterOff_Click()
  Me!strFilter = Null
    Me.Filter = ""
    Me.FilterOn = False
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPosting_Click()
Dim postID

  postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "parentTableID=130 AND parentID=" & Me!ggInvoiceID)
  
  If Not IsNull(postID) Then
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", acNormal, , "postingID=" & postID
    Exit Sub
  End If
      
  If Me!documentStatusID <> 3 Then
    MsgBox "Knji ba ponudbe oz. preddokumenta ni mogo a.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
  
  If Me!documentTypeID = 18 Then
      postID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "postingName=  'MojSkiPass_" & Year(Me!invoiceDate) & "." & Format(Month(Me!invoiceDate), "00") & "'")
      If IsNull(postID) Then
        MsgBox "Posamezna knji ba ni mogo a.", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
      Else
        MsgBox "Knji ba se nana a na obdobje: " & Year(Me!invoiceDate) & "." & Format(Month(Me!invoiceDate), "00"), vbInformation
        DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & postID
      End If
      Exit Sub

  End If
  
  If IsNull(Me!invoiceDate) Or IsNull(Me!serviceLastDate) Or IsNull(Me!costCenterAbb) Then
    Beep
    MsgBox "Na ra unu " & Me!ggInvoiceNumber & " manjka datum ra una, DS2 ali cost center. Knji ba ni mogo a.", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
  End If
    
  If IsNull(Me!invoiceAmount) Or Me!invoiceAmount = 0 Then
      Beep
      MsgBox "Znesek ra una je 0. Knji ba ni mogo a.", vbInformation
      Exit Sub
  End If
      
  Call PostGagarinInvoice(Me!ggInvoiceID, Me!documentTypeID, False)
  Call RequeryMe
  Beep

End Sub

Private Sub cmdPostInvoices_Click()
Dim strSQL As String, rs As DAO.Recordset, iMax As Integer, i As Integer, mnth, Yr, ID
  
  If Me!documentTypeID = 18 Then
      mnth = InputBox("Mesec (mm):")
      Yr = InputBox("Leto (yyyy):")
      If mnth = "" Or Yr = "" Then Exit Sub
      ID = DLookup("postingID", "tblAccGL_Postings", "postingName=  'MojSkiPass_" & Yr & "." & Format(mnth, "00") & "'")
      If IsNull(ID) Then
        If CLng(Yr & Format(mnth, "00")) < CLng(Year(Date) & Format(Month(Date), "00")) Then
          Call PostGagarinInvoice(0, 18, mnth, Yr)
          Beep
        Else
          MsgBox "Knji enje ra unov MojSkiPass je mo no samo po preteku meseca na katerega se knji ba nana a. Program bo prekninje.", vbInformation
        End If
        Exit Sub
      Else
        DoCmd.OpenForm "frmAccGL_Posting", , , "postingID=" & ID
      End If
      Exit Sub
  End If
         
  DoCmd.Hourglass True
  Call PostGGInvoices(Me, Me!documentTypeID)
  Call RequeryMe
  Beep
  DoCmd.Hourglass False
  
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
On Error Resume Next
Dim frm As Form
  If IsNull(Me!ggInvoiceID) Then Exit Sub
  Me!invID = Me!ggInvoiceID
  
  If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, "frmTourSales_ggInvoice") Then
    Set frm = Forms!frmTourSales_ggInvoice.Form
    frm.Caption = "Invoice: " & Me!ggInvoiceNumber
    frm.Requery
  End If

End Sub

Public Sub RequeryMe()
On Error Resume Next
Dim rs As Recordset
  
  Set rs = Me.RecordsetClone
  If rs.RecordCount <> 0 Then
    Call StayOnRecordRequery(Me, "ggInvoiceID", Me!ggInvoiceID)
  Else
    Me.Requery
  End If
  
'  If DCount("*", "qrySalesGG_PostingErrors") = 0 Then
'    Me!cmdPost_Err.visible = False
'  Else
'    Me!cmdPost_Err.visible = True
'  End If
  
End Sub

    Me!partnerName.ColumnHidden = False
    Me!partnerName.ColumnWidth = 2000

Private Sub purchaseInvoiceNumber_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
Dim frm As Form

  If IsNull(Me!purchaseInvoiceID) Then Beep: Exit Sub

  DoCmd.OpenForm "frmPurchaseInvoice", acNormal, , "purchaseInvoiceID=" & Me!purchaseInvoiceID, acFormEdit
  Set frm = Forms("frmPurchaseInvoice")
  If frm!documentTypeID = 4 Then
    Set frm = Forms!frmPurchaseInvoice.Form
    frm!cmdCreateAllChildren.visible = False
    frm!cmdFillVAT.visible = False
    frm!cmdFillPostingDetails.visible = False
    frm!cmdCreatePosting.visible = False
  End If
End Sub
